开发者：了解 OpenTelemetry 生态和最佳实践。

en.tag: Official OpenTelemetry website and documentation source
en.what: This is the source repository for the OpenTelemetry website, project documentation, and blog. The site is built with Hugo and hosted on Netlify, with contribution guides and development setup.
en.content: The repository contains website content (Markdown files), Hugo configuration, theme files, blog posts, registry data, and contribution guides.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript for build tooling, based on Hugo static site generator, deployed on Netlify.
en.hot: As the official documentation hub for OpenTelemetry, it gains attention with the observability trend. Despite 0 stars today, it has 945 total stars and ranks #14 on the daily JavaScript trending list.
uses: OpenTelemetry users: access official docs and learn how to use and deploy.
Contributors: improve docs, submit blog posts, or update the registry.
Developers: understand the OpenTelemetry ecosystem and best practices.

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理与协作应用的有状态工作负载原语
zh.what: Rivet 提供轻量级、长期运行的 Actor 进程，专为有状态工作负载设计。状态保存在内存中并自动持久化，每个代理、会话或用户可创建一个 Actor，内置工作流、队列和调度功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的核心运行时、TypeScript SDK（用于后端和客户端）、文档和示例。支持 WebSockets、工作流、队列和定时任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供 TypeScript SDK，依赖 SQLite 或自带数据库进行持久化，支持全局边缘网络部署。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理和协作应用的兴起，开发者需要简单可靠的有状态执行方案。Rivet 以 5961 颗星迅速走红，今日新增 111 星，位列 Rust 趋势榜第五。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为每个代理创建独立 Actor，管理持久上下文和工具调用调度。
协作应用开发者：利用 WebSockets 实现实时双向通信和状态同步。
需要可靠异步处理的团队：使用内置队列和工作流简化任务编排。
追求成本效益的部署：利用自动休眠和缩容到零的特性节省资源。

en.tag: The primitive for stateful workloads, built for AI agents, collaborative apps, and durable execution.
en.what: Rivet provides lightweight, long-running Actor processes designed for stateful workloads. State lives in memory with automatic persistence, and you can create one Actor per agent, session, or user, with built-in workflows, queues, and scheduling.
en.content: The repository contains the core runtime implemented in Rust, TypeScript SDKs for backend and client, documentation, and examples. It supports WebSockets, workflows, queues, and scheduling.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, with TypeScript SDKs, uses SQLite or BYO database for persistence, and supports global edge network deployment.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents and collaborative apps, developers need a simple and reliable solution for stateful execution. Rivet has gained traction with 5,961 stars, adding 111 today, ranking #5 on the Rust trending list.
uses: AI agent developers: create a dedicated Actor per agent to manage persistent context and schedule tool calls.
Collaborative app developers: leverage WebSockets for real-time bidirectional communication and state sync.
Teams needing reliable async processing: use built-in queues and workflows to simplify task orchestration.
Cost-conscious deployments: benefit from auto-hibernation and scale-to-zero to save resources.

zh.tag: 一站式开发环境管理工具
zh.what: mise 是一个开发工具、环境变量和任务运行器的统一 CLI。它通过一个 mise.toml 文件管理项目工具、环境变量和任务，确保新 shell、检出和 CI 作业从相同的设置开始。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、演示 GIF 和配置文件。核心功能包括安装和切换数百种开发工具、按项目目录加载环境变量（包括 .env 文件），以及定义和运行构建、测试、lint 和部署任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 生态。支持多种后端，如 npm、pip、go 等，用于安装工具。
zh.hot: mise 在 Rust 社区中热度高，今日新增 258 星，总星数达 31926。它解决了开发环境配置的痛点，将多个工具整合为一个 CLI，受到开发者的欢迎。
uses: 开发者：需要管理多个项目工具版本和环境的个人开发者
团队：希望统一开发环境配置，减少新成员上手成本的团队
CI/CD：需要确保 CI 作业与本地环境一致的持续集成场景
多语言开发者：频繁切换 Node、Python、Go 等语言的开发者

en.tag: All-in-one dev environment manager
en.what: mise is a unified CLI for dev tools, environment variables, and task runner. It manages project tools, env vars, and tasks in one mise.toml file, ensuring new shells, checkouts, and CI jobs start from the same setup.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, demo GIFs, and configuration files. Core features include installing and switching between hundreds of dev tools, loading environment variables per project directory (including .env files), and defining and running tasks for building, testing, linting, and deploying.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem. Supports various backends like npm, pip, go, etc., for installing tools.
en.hot: mise is trending in the Rust community with 258 stars today and 31,926 total. It solves the pain point of dev environment setup by consolidating multiple tools into one CLI, gaining popularity among developers.
uses: Developers: individuals managing multiple project tool versions and environments
Teams: teams wanting to unify dev environment config and reduce onboarding cost
CI/CD: continuous integration scenarios needing consistency with local environments
Polyglot developers: those frequently switching between Node, Python, Go, etc.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 构建的开源 CAD 应用，支持 DWG/DXF 与 GPU 渲染
zh.what: OpenCAD Studio (OCS) 是一个用 Rust 编写的 CAD 应用，用于 2D 制图和 3D 建模。它原生读写 DWG 和 DXF 文件，并提供 GPU 加速渲染，还推出了可在浏览器中运行的 Web 版本。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CAD 功能集：2D 绘图命令（LINE、CIRCLE、HATCH 等）、3D 建模（EXTRUDE、REVOLVE、LOFT 等）、标注与尺寸、图纸空间布局，以及 DWG/DXF/STL/STEP/OBJ/PDF 等文件格式支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 GPU 加速渲染（可能通过 wgpu 或类似库），并支持编译为 WebAssembly 以提供 Web 版本。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 194 星，总星数达 577，登上 Rust 语言日榜第 2。其亮点在于用 Rust 实现专业级 CAD 功能，且提供 Web 版，吸引开发者关注。
uses: CAD 爱好者或专业人士，希望使用开源、跨平台的 2D/3D 设计工具
Rust 开发者，对图形编程、CAD 内核或 WebAssembly 感兴趣
需要处理 DWG/DXF 文件的工程师或设计师，寻找免费替代方案
教育场景，用于学习 CAD 概念或 Rust 在复杂应用中的实践

en.tag: An open-source CAD application built with Rust, supporting DWG/DXF and GPU-accelerated rendering
en.what: OpenCAD Studio (OCS) is a CAD application written in Rust for 2D drafting and 3D modeling. It natively reads and writes DWG and DXF files, offers GPU-accelerated rendering, and also has a web version that runs in the browser.
en.content: The repository includes a full-featured CAD suite: 2D drafting commands (LINE, CIRCLE, HATCH, etc.), 3D modeling (EXTRUDE, REVOLVE, LOFT, etc.), annotations and dimensions, paper space layouts, and support for file formats like DWG/DXF/STL/STEP/OBJ/PDF.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, leveraging GPU-accelerated rendering (likely via wgpu or similar), and compiles to WebAssembly for the web version.
en.hot: It's gaining rapid traction on GitHub, with 194 stars added today and a total of 577, ranking #2 on the Rust daily trending list. Its appeal lies in delivering professional CAD features in Rust with a web version, drawing developer attention.
uses: CAD enthusiasts or professionals seeking an open-source, cross-platform 2D/3D design tool
Rust developers interested in graphics programming, CAD kernels, or WebAssembly
Engineers or designers who need to work with DWG/DXF files and want a free alternative
Educational use, to learn CAD concepts or Rust in complex applications

zh.tag: 自托管分布式 Durable Objects 运行时
zh.what: celld 是一个开源守护进程，让你在自己的机器上运行 Cloudflare Workers 和 Durable Objects。每个对象都是一个独立的 SQLite 数据库，按名称寻址，并复制到你拥有的 S3 兼容存储桶中；节点仅通过该存储桶协调，无需控制平面或共识。
zh.content: 仓库包含 celld 的 Rust 源码、安装脚本、Docker 镜像配置以及文档。它嵌入 V8 引擎执行 Wrangler 构建的 Worker 包，并通过 S3 存储桶实现状态复制和所有权协调。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 V8 引擎和 S3 兼容对象存储（如 AWS S3、Cloudflare R2）。使用 esbuild 打包 Worker 项目。
zh.hot: 今日新增 516 星，总星数 2202，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。它解决了分布式 Durable Objects 的痛点，通过去中心化设计简化了部署和运维。
uses: 希望在自有基础设施上运行 Cloudflare Workers 的开发者
需要分布式持久化状态且不想依赖云厂商锁定的团队
对边缘计算和 Durable Objects 感兴趣的研究者
寻求低成本、可扩展的分布式应用架构的架构师

en.tag: Self-hosted distributed Durable Objects runtime
en.what: celld is an open-source daemon that runs Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects on your own machines. Each object is its own SQLite database, addressed by name and replicated to an S3-compatible bucket you own; nodes coordinate through that bucket alone, with no control plane or consensus.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust source code, installation scripts, Docker image config, and docs. It embeds V8 to execute Wrangler bundles and coordinates state and ownership via an S3 bucket.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging V8 and S3-compatible object storage (e.g., AWS S3, Cloudflare R2). Uses esbuild for bundling Worker projects.
en.hot: Gained 516 stars today, reaching 2202 total, trending on GitHub. It addresses the pain point of distributed Durable Objects with a decentralized design that simplifies deployment and operations.
uses: Developers who want to run Cloudflare Workers on their own infrastructure
Teams needing distributed persistent state without vendor lock-in
Researchers interested in edge computing and Durable Objects
Architects seeking low-cost, scalable distributed application architectures

zh.tag: 用WiFi穿墙感知人体与生命体征的AI平台
zh.what: RuView利用普通WiFi信号（CSI）实现穿墙的人体检测、呼吸心率监测和存在感知，无需摄像头或穿戴设备。它通过ESP32传感器捕获信号扰动，并转化为空间智能，支持多种智能家居生态。
zh.content: 仓库包含Rust编写的核心平台、ESP32固件、Home Assistant集成（MQTT发布器）、Apple Home/Google Home/Alexa的桥接（HAP-1.1和Matter）、21个实体（11个原始信号+10个推断语义状态）以及3个HA蓝图。
zh.stack: 主要语言为Rust，依赖ESP32的CSI数据，支持MQTT、HAP-1.1、Matter协议，与Home Assistant、Apple Home、Google Home、Alexa等集成。
zh.hot: 星数高达8.9万，今日新增156，因其创新性地将普通WiFi转化为穿墙感知能力，隐私友好且无需额外硬件，在智能家居和AI领域引发广泛关注。
uses: 智能家居爱好者：无需摄像头即可实现房间级存在检测和生命体征监测，集成Home Assistant等平台。
老人护理与健康监测：检测跌倒风险、睡眠状态、异常静止等，用于远程照护。
安全与安防：穿墙感知入侵或异常活动，适用于夜间或隐私敏感场景。
研究人员与开发者：探索WiFi感知技术，基于Rust和ESP32进行二次开发。

en.tag: AI platform turning WiFi into through-wall human & vital sensing
en.what: RuView turns commodity WiFi signals (CSI) into through-wall human detection, breathing/heart-rate monitoring, and presence sensing without cameras or wearables. It captures signal disturbances via low-cost ESP32 sensors and converts them into spatial intelligence, integrating with major smart-home ecosystems.
en.content: The repo includes the Rust-based core platform, ESP32 firmware, Home Assistant integration (MQTT publisher), bridges for Apple Home/Google Home/Alexa (HAP-1.1 and Matter), 21 entities (11 raw signals + 10 inferred semantic states), and 3 HA Blueprints.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, leveraging ESP32 CSI data, supporting MQTT, HAP-1.1, and Matter protocols, integrating with Home Assistant, Apple Home, Google Home, and Alexa.
en.hot: With 89k stars and +156 today, it's hot for its innovative use of commodity WiFi for through-wall sensing, privacy-friendly and hardware-free, sparking wide interest in smart-home and AI.
uses: Smart-home enthusiasts: room-level presence and vital monitoring without cameras, integrating with Home Assistant and others.
Elderly care & health monitoring: detect fall risk, sleep state, inactivity anomalies for remote care.
Security & surveillance: through-wall intrusion or anomaly detection, ideal for night or privacy-sensitive areas.
Researchers & developers: explore WiFi sensing, extend with Rust and ESP32.

zh.tag: 多模态 AI 数据湖仓，开发者友好的嵌入式向量检索库
zh.what: LanceDB 是一个开源的多模态 AI 数据湖仓，专为 AI/ML 应用设计，支持快速、可扩展、生产级的向量搜索。它基于 Lance 列式格式，可以轻松存储、索引和搜索 PB 级的多模态数据和向量。开发者可以用它来构建、训练和分析 AI 工作负载。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 实现、Python/JS 客户端、文档、教程和示例。提供向量搜索、全文搜索和 SQL 支持，以及多模态数据存储和版本管理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，底层基于 Lance 列式格式，支持 GPU 加速索引构建，提供 Python 和 JavaScript 客户端。
zh.hot: 随着多模态 AI 的兴起，LanceDB 提供了统一的检索方案，简化了数据管理。Star 数已超 1.1 万，今日新增 8，位列 Rust 日榜第 6，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: AI 应用开发者：需要快速构建多模态搜索功能，如图像、文本、视频检索。
数据工程师：希望简化 AI 数据管道，利用版本管理和零拷贝特性。
机器学习工程师：需要大规模向量索引和 GPU 加速训练数据管理。
初创团队：寻求开源、无供应商锁定的向量数据库解决方案。

en.tag: Developer-friendly embedded vector retrieval for multimodal AI, built on Lance columnar format
en.what: LanceDB is an open-source multimodal AI lakehouse designed for AI/ML applications, offering fast, scalable, production-ready vector search. Built on the Lance columnar format, it stores, indexes, and searches petabytes of multimodal data and vectors with ease. Developers use it to build, train, and analyze AI workloads.
en.content: The repository includes core Rust implementation, Python/JS clients, docs, tutorials, and examples. It supports vector search, full-text search, SQL, multimodal data storage, and versioning.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the Lance columnar format, with GPU support for index building, and Python/JS clients.
en.hot: With the rise of multimodal AI, LanceDB offers a unified retrieval solution that simplifies data management. With over 11k stars and 8 new today, it ranks #6 on the Rust daily trending, gaining continuous developer attention.
uses: AI app developers: need to build multimodal search features like image, text, video retrieval quickly.
Data engineers: want to simplify AI data pipelines with versioning and zero-copy features.
ML engineers: need large-scale vector indexing and GPU-accelerated training data management.
Startups: looking for open-source, vendor-neutral vector database solutions.

zh.tag: 模块化 HTML/CSS 渲染引擎
zh.what: Blitz 是一个用 Rust 编写的 HTML/CSS 渲染引擎，旨在提供高度模块化的设计，让开发者可以按需集成渲染功能。它目前处于预 alpha 阶段，但已经具备强大的渲染能力，适合用于原生应用中的 UI 渲染。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心渲染引擎、浏览器示例包（browser）、多个示例应用（如 todomvc、markdown 渲染器、WGPU 集成示例），以及文档和架构说明。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust，并依赖 Stylo（Mozilla 的 CSS 引擎）进行样式计算，支持 AccessKit 辅助功能，可集成 WGPU 进行底层渲染。
zh.hot: Blitz 因其模块化设计和对现代 HTML/CSS 布局的支持而受到关注，在 GitHub 上获得近 4000 星，今日新增 21 星，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 7。
uses: Rust 开发者希望为原生应用嵌入 HTML/CSS 渲染能力
需要高性能、可定制渲染引擎的 GUI 框架开发者
对浏览器功能臃肿不满，寻求轻量级替代方案的技术团队

en.tag: A radically modular HTML/CSS rendering engine
en.what: Blitz is a Rust-based HTML/CSS rendering engine designed with radical modularity, allowing developers to integrate rendering features as needed. It is currently in pre-alpha but already has a capable renderer, suitable for UI rendering in native applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core rendering engine, a browser example package, several example apps (e.g., todomvc, markdown renderer, WGPU integration), along with documentation and architecture notes.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, leveraging Stylo (Mozilla's CSS engine) for style computation, supporting AccessKit for accessibility, and integrating with WGPU for low-level rendering.
en.hot: Blitz has gained attention for its modular design and support for modern HTML/CSS layout, amassing nearly 4,000 stars with 21 new stars today, ranking #7 on GitHub Trending for Rust.
uses: Rust developers looking to embed HTML/CSS rendering in native apps
GUI framework developers needing a high-performance, customizable rendering engine
Teams seeking a lightweight alternative to bloated browser features

zh.tag: 用 Rust 构建的高性能并行浏览器引擎
zh.what: Servo 是一个用 Rust 语言编写的原型 web 浏览器引擎，旨在为开发者提供轻量级、高性能的嵌入式 Web 技术替代方案。它支持多平台（macOS、Linux、Windows、OpenHarmony、Android），并利用并行架构提升渲染效率。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的浏览器引擎实现，包括布局、渲染、CSS 解析、JavaScript 引擎集成等模块，以及构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Cargo 构建系统，支持通过 mach 工具链进行跨平台编译。
zh.hot: 作为 Rust 生态中标志性的浏览器引擎项目，Servo 持续吸引关注，本月新增 347 星，位列 Rust 月榜第 23 名，体现了开发者对高性能、安全浏览器技术的兴趣。
uses: 浏览器引擎开发者 —— 研究并行渲染和 Rust 在浏览器中的应用
嵌入式 Web 技术用户 —— 在应用中集成轻量级浏览器引擎
Rust 爱好者 —— 学习大型 Rust 项目架构与性能优化

en.tag: A high-performance parallel browser engine written in Rust
en.what: Servo is a prototype web browser engine written in Rust, aiming to provide developers with a lightweight, high-performance alternative for embedding web technologies. It supports multiple platforms (macOS, Linux, Windows, OpenHarmony, Android) and leverages a parallel architecture for efficient rendering.
en.content: The repository contains a full browser engine implementation, including layout, rendering, CSS parsing, JavaScript engine integration, along with build scripts and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, uses Cargo build system, and supports cross-platform compilation via the mach toolchain.
en.hot: As a landmark browser engine project in the Rust ecosystem, Servo continues to attract attention, gaining 347 stars this month and ranking 23rd on the Rust monthly list, reflecting developer interest in high-performance, safe browser technology.
uses: Browser engine developers — researching parallel rendering and Rust in browsers
Embedded web technology users — integrating a lightweight browser engine into applications
Rust enthusiasts — learning large-scale Rust project architecture and performance optimization

zh.tag: 面向实时 Web 的可扩展分布式文档图数据库
zh.what: SurrealDB 是一个用 Rust 编写的多模型数据库，结合了文档、图和关系数据库的特性。它支持实时协作、细粒度权限控制和跨数据中心复制，旨在简化现代应用的开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SurrealDB 的完整源代码，包括核心数据库引擎、SQL 查询语言、REST/WebSocket API、命令行工具以及 Docker 部署配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Tokio 异步运行时、RocksDB 存储引擎，并提供多种语言客户端（JavaScript、Python、.NET 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 32.8k 星标和活跃的社区，SurrealDB 因其创新的多模型设计和实时能力而备受关注，成为构建现代应用的热门选择。
uses: 开发者：构建需要实时数据同步和灵活数据模型的应用
初创公司：快速原型和迭代，减少后端复杂度
数据密集型应用：需要图查询和文档存储的场景
边缘计算：支持离线优先和分布式部署

en.tag: Scalable, distributed, collaborative document-graph database for the realtime web
en.what: SurrealDB is a multi-model database written in Rust, combining features of document, graph, and relational databases. It supports real-time collaboration, fine-grained permissions, and cross-datacenter replication, aiming to simplify modern application development.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of SurrealDB, including the core database engine, SQL query language, REST/WebSocket APIs, command-line tools, and Docker deployment configurations.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging Tokio async runtime and RocksDB storage engine, with official clients for JavaScript, Python, .NET, and more.
en.hot: With 32.8k stars and an active community, SurrealDB has gained attention for its innovative multi-model design and real-time capabilities, making it a popular choice for building modern applications.
uses: Developers: building apps needing real-time data sync and flexible data models
Startups: rapid prototyping and iteration with reduced backend complexity
Data-intensive apps: scenarios requiring graph queries and document storage
Edge computing: supporting offline-first and distributed deployments

zh.tag: 用 Rust 实现的 Python 3 解释器
zh.what: RustPython 是一个用 Rust 语言编写的 Python 3 解释器，支持 CPython >= 3.14.0 的语法。它可以嵌入到 Rust 应用中，也可以作为独立的解释器运行，甚至能编译为 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的解释器源代码，包括解析器、编译器、虚拟机、标准库（部分）以及用于构建和测试的 Cargo 配置。还提供了在线演示和交互式 shell。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Cargo 进行构建管理。支持 WebAssembly 编译，并使用了 symlinks 管理 Python 库。
zh.hot: RustPython 在 GitHub 上拥有 22260 颗星，因其将 Python 的易用性与 Rust 的性能和安全性结合，吸引了大量对语言实现和嵌入式脚本感兴趣的开发者。
uses: 对语言实现感兴趣的开发者，可以学习如何用 Rust 构建解释器
需要在 Rust 应用中嵌入 Python 脚本的开发者
希望在浏览器中运行 Python 的 Web 开发者
教育用途，用于教学解释器工作原理

en.tag: A Python 3 interpreter written in Rust
en.what: RustPython is a Python 3 interpreter written in Rust, supporting CPython >= 3.14.0 syntax. It can be embedded in Rust applications, run as a standalone interpreter, or compiled to WebAssembly for browser execution.
en.content: The repository contains the full interpreter source code, including parser, compiler, virtual machine, standard library (partial), and Cargo configuration for building and testing. It also provides an online demo and interactive shell.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, with Cargo for build management. Supports WebAssembly compilation, and uses symlinks to manage Python libraries.
en.hot: RustPython has 22,260 stars on GitHub, attracting developers interested in language implementation and embedded scripting due to its combination of Python's ease of use with Rust's performance and safety.
uses: Developers interested in language implementation, to learn how to build an interpreter in Rust
Developers needing to embed Python scripts in Rust applications
Web developers wanting to run Python in the browser
Educational purposes, for teaching how interpreters work

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写 Postgres，性能超越原版与 ClickHouse
zh.what: pgrust 是 Postgres 的 Rust 重写版本，旨在展示如果 Postgres 在 2026 年构建会是什么样子。它与 Postgres 完全兼容（包括 wire 协议和 SQL 方言），并通过了 Postgres 的全部 46,066 个回归测试。它引入了向量化执行、JIT 编译、线程并发模型和内置 OOM killer 等新架构，性能优于 Postgres 和 ClickHouse。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Rust 源码，实现了 Postgres 的核心功能，并附有回归测试套件、文档和在线试用链接。当前版本 v0.2，尚未生产就绪，但已通过全部回归测试。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，针对 Graviton4 进行优化，JIT 编译器仅支持 Graviton4。依赖包括 SIMD 指令集和向量化执行引擎。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 173 星，总星数达 4227，位列 Rust 趋势榜第三。其宣称的性能超越和 100% 回归测试通过率吸引了大量关注。
uses: 对数据库内核感兴趣的开发者，想了解如何用 Rust 重写 Postgres 并优化性能
需要高性能分析查询的团队，可评估 pgrust 作为 Postgres 的替代方案
希望参与开源项目，为 Postgres 生态贡献 Rust 实现的开发者

en.tag: A Rust rewrite of Postgres that's faster than Postgres and ClickHouse
en.what: pgrust is a Rust rewrite of Postgres, aiming to show what Postgres would look like if built in 2026. It is wire and SQL dialect compatible with Postgres, passing all 46,066 regression tests. It introduces a vectorized push-based JIT-compiled executor, thread-based concurrency, a query scheduler, and a built-in OOM killer, making it faster than Postgres and ClickHouse.
en.content: The repo contains the full Rust source code implementing Postgres core features, along with a regression test suite, documentation, and a browser-based demo. Current version v0.2, not production-ready but passing all regression tests.
en.stack: Written in Rust, tuned for Graviton4, with JIT compiler targeting only Graviton4. Dependencies include SIMD instructions and a vectorized execution engine.
en.hot: The project gained rapid popularity on GitHub, with 173 stars today and 4,227 total, ranking #3 on the Rust trending list. Its claimed performance superiority and 100% regression test pass rate have attracted significant attention.
uses: Developers interested in database internals, to learn how to rewrite Postgres in Rust and optimize performance
Teams needing high-performance analytical queries, to evaluate pgrust as a Postgres alternative
Open-source contributors wanting to participate in a Rust implementation of Postgres

zh.tag: B站视频下载器：图形界面、弹幕字幕、NFO刮削
zh.what: 这是一个功能全面的哔哩哔哩视频下载工具，支持普通视频、番剧、课程等所有类型。它提供图形界面，并集成了NFO刮削、广告标记、字幕和弹幕下载，方便用户将视频导入Emby等媒体库。

zh.stack: 技术栈为Rust和Tauri v2，前端使用Node和pnpm。依赖包括Rust、Node、pnpm，支持跨平台构建。

Emby/Jellyfin等媒体库用户，需要自动刮削和整理B站内容。
需要下载弹幕和字幕进行二次创作或研究的用户。
对广告标记和章节导航有需求的视频收藏者。

en.tag: Bilibili video downloader with GUI, danmaku, subtitles, and NFO scraping
en.what: A comprehensive Bilibili video downloader supporting all content types like videos, series, and courses. It features a GUI, NFO scraping, ad marking, subtitle and danmaku download, making it easy to add videos to media libraries like Emby.
en.content: The repo contains a Tauri v2-based GUI, Rust backend, plugin system examples, and build docs. Key features include segmented downloads, custom naming, video search, account operations, audio/video downloads, subtitle/cover/danmaku downloads, NFO scraping, chapter and ad marking, and more.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Tauri v2, with a Node/pnpm frontend. Dependencies include Rust, Node, and pnpm, enabling cross-platform builds.
en.hot: With comprehensive features and active updates, it has gained 1816 stars on GitHub Trending, +9 today. Its robust media library integration and ease of use attract many Bilibili content collectors.

Media library users (Emby/Jellyfin) needing automatic scraping and organization of Bilibili content.
Users who need danmaku and subtitles for remixing or research.
Collectors who want ad marking and chapter navigation features.

zh.tag: 微软开源跨平台沙箱执行容器，策略驱动隔离
zh.what: MXC 是一个用于运行不受信任代码（如模型输出、插件、工具）的沙箱执行系统，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。它提供从操作系统原生进程沙箱到完整虚拟机的多种隔离后端，并通过统一的 JSON 配置和 TypeScript SDK 进行管理。
zh.content: 仓库包含原生容器包装器（Rust 实现）和 TypeScript SDK，支持多种后端如 ProcessContainer、Windows Sandbox、LXC、Bubblewrap、Seatbelt、MicroVM 等。提供文件系统、网络、UI 策略控制以及多步骤生命周期管理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写原生组件，提供 TypeScript SDK（npm 包 @microsoft/mxc-sdk）。依赖各平台原生沙箱技术，如 Windows Sandbox、LXC、Bubblewrap、Seatbelt 等。
zh.hot: 微软官方出品，解决 AI 时代运行不可信代码的安全痛点，跨平台且策略驱动，引发开发者关注。尽管 star 数不高（1212），但作为早期预览，其潜力巨大。
uses: AI 应用开发者：安全执行模型输出、插件和工具代码
安全研究人员：研究沙箱隔离策略和绕过技术
平台工程师：构建多租户代码执行环境
云服务提供商：提供安全的代码运行服务

en.tag: Microsoft's cross-platform sandboxed code execution container with policy-driven isolation
en.what: MXC is a sandboxed code execution system for running untrusted code (model output, plugins, tools) on Windows, Linux, and macOS. It provides multiple containment backends, from OS-native process sandboxes to full VMs, managed via a unified JSON configuration and TypeScript SDK.
en.content: The repo contains a native container wrapper (Rust) and a TypeScript SDK, supporting backends like ProcessContainer, Windows Sandbox, LXC, Bubblewrap, Seatbelt, MicroVM, etc. It offers filesystem, network, and UI policy controls, plus a state-aware lifecycle.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust for the native wrapper, with a TypeScript SDK (npm package @microsoft/mxc-sdk). It leverages platform-native sandbox technologies like Windows Sandbox, LXC, Bubblewrap, Seatbelt, etc.
en.hot: Backed by Microsoft, it addresses the security pain point of running untrusted code in the AI era, being cross-platform and policy-driven, attracting developer attention. Despite modest stars (1212), it's an early preview with huge potential.
uses: AI app developers: securely execute model output, plugins, and tool code
Security researchers: study sandbox isolation policies and bypass techniques
Platform engineers: build multi-tenant code execution environments
Cloud providers: offer secure code execution services

zh.tag: 用真实地理数据在 Minecraft 中生成任意地点的世界
zh.what: Arnis 是一个免费开源的 Rust 工具，能够根据 OpenStreetMap 和海拔数据，在 Minecraft Java 版（1.17+）和基岩版中生成高度还原的真实世界地形与建筑。用户只需在地图上框选区域，即可生成自己的家乡、城市或自然景观。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、图形界面（GUI）、命令行工具、文档和示例资源。核心模块包括数据获取、地理处理、世界生成等，并支持自定义生成设置。

开发者：对 Rust 地理数据处理或 Minecraft 世界生成感兴趣的开发者。

en.tag: Generate real-world locations in Minecraft with high detail
en.what: Arnis is a free, open-source Rust tool that generates highly accurate Minecraft worlds based on real-world geography, using OpenStreetMap and elevation data. Users can select an area on a map and generate their hometown, cities, or landscapes in Minecraft Java (1.17+) and Bedrock.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, a GUI, command-line tools, documentation, and sample assets. Core modules include data fetching, geospatial processing, and world generation, with customizable generation settings.
en.stack: Written in Rust, it leverages OpenStreetMap and elevation data sources, and supports Minecraft Java and Bedrock editions.
en.hot: Its unique and practical concept of bringing the real world into Minecraft has attracted many players and developers. With 17,375 stars and 32 new stars today, it ranks #14 on GitHub Trending (Rust).

Educators for visualizing geography or urban planning in lessons.
Developers interested in Rust geospatial processing or Minecraft world generation.

zh.tag: 开源可组合支付平台，支持智能路由与成本优化
zh.what: Hyperswitch 是一个开源、可组合的支付平台，符合 PCI 标准，提供 SaaS 和自托管选项。它连接多种支付、支付、欺诈、保险库和令牌化提供商，通过智能路由和收入恢复提升授权率，并通过成本可观测性降低支付处理成本，同时简化对账操作。

en.tag: Open-source composable payments platform with intelligent routing and cost optimization

en.hot: With 43k stars, Hyperswitch gains attention for its open-source, composable payments infrastructure, addressing payment complexity and vendor lock-in, appealing to businesses seeking flexible payment solutions.

Companies aiming to optimize authorization rates and reduce costs
Organizations requiring self-hosted payment platforms for compliance
Developers seeking customizable, modular payment infrastructure

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的高性能 Minecraft 服务端
zh.what: Pumpkin 是一个完全用 Rust 编写的 Minecraft 服务器，旨在提供极致的性能和可定制性。它支持最新的 Java 和 Bedrock 版本，同时保持原版游戏机制。

Rust 开发者 —— 学习 Rust 在游戏服务器领域的实践
Minecraft 模组/插件开发者 —— 基于其插件系统进行扩展

en.tag: A fast, efficient Minecraft server built entirely in Rust
en.what: Pumpkin is a Minecraft server built entirely in Rust, designed for maximum performance and customizability. It supports the latest Java and Bedrock editions while adhering to vanilla game mechanics.
en.content: The repository contains a full server core implementation, including world loading, chunk generation, player management, entity AI, redstone, plugin system, etc., currently under heavy development.

zh.tag: 跨平台 iOS 侧载工具，功能丰富且开源

高级用户，想要注入 tweak 或自定义应用签名

en.tag: Cross-platform & feature-rich iOS sideloading app
en.what: Impactor is an open-source, cross-platform iOS sideloading tool supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows. It allows users to sign and install apps on iOS 9.0+ devices with their Apple ID, and supports installing SideStore, LiveContainer, and more.

zh.tag: 比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍的 S3 兼容对象存储
zh.what: RustFS 是一个基于 Rust 构建的高性能分布式对象存储系统，兼容 S3 API。它针对小对象（如 4KB）进行了极致优化，性能可达 MinIO 的 2.3 倍，同时支持与 MinIO、Ceph 等平台无缝迁移和共存。
zh.content: 仓库包含 RustFS 核心存储引擎、S3 API 网关、CLI 工具、Docker 部署配置以及完整的文档和示例。项目采用模块化架构，支持分布式部署和水平扩展。
zh.stack: 主要编程语言为 Rust，依赖 Tokio 异步运行时、S3 兼容库（如 aws-sdk-s3）、以及 RocksDB 或自研存储引擎。
zh.hot: 凭借比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍的性能优势和 Rust 的内存安全特性，RustFS 在 GitHub 上获得 30k+ Stars，并登上 Trending 周榜。其 S3 兼容性降低了迁移成本，吸引了大量数据湖和 AI 场景用户。
uses: 数据湖与 AI 训练场景 —— 需要高性能小对象存储的机器学习平台
替代 MinIO/Ceph —— 追求更高吞吐和更低延迟的 S3 兼容存储
边缘计算与 IoT —— 轻量级分布式存储部署在资源受限环境
云原生基础设施 —— 作为 Kubernetes 的持久化存储后端

en.tag: 2.3x faster than MinIO for small objects, S3-compatible object storage
en.what: RustFS is a high-performance, distributed object storage system built in Rust, compatible with S3 API. It is extremely optimized for small objects (e.g., 4KB), achieving 2.3x the performance of MinIO, while supporting seamless migration and coexistence with other S3-compatible platforms like MinIO and Ceph.
en.content: The repository contains the core storage engine, S3 API gateway, CLI tools, Docker deployment configs, and comprehensive documentation with examples. The project uses a modular architecture supporting distributed deployment and horizontal scaling.
en.stack: Primarily built in Rust, relying on Tokio async runtime, S3-compatible libraries (e.g., aws-sdk-s3), and RocksDB or custom storage engine.
en.hot: With 2.3x performance advantage over MinIO and Rust's memory safety, RustFS has gained 30k+ stars on GitHub and made it to the Trending weekly list. Its S3 compatibility reduces migration costs, attracting users in data lake and AI scenarios.
uses: Data lakes & AI training — high-performance small object storage for ML platforms
MinIO/Ceph replacement — S3-compatible storage with higher throughput and lower latency
Edge computing & IoT — lightweight distributed storage for resource-constrained environments
Cloud-native infrastructure — persistent storage backend for Kubernetes

zh.tag: Rust 编写的多提供商终端编码代理，支持插件与 TUI
zh.what: Claurst 是一个用 Rust 从零构建的开源终端编码代理，最初是 Claude Code 的洁净室重实现，现已演变为功能丰富的 TUI 结对程序员。它支持多提供商路由、插件系统、聊天分叉、记忆整合等，强调速度、内存效率和隐私（无跟踪遥测）。

隐私敏感用户：无跟踪、无遥测，可完全自托管。

en.tag: Open-source multi-provider terminal coding agent in Rust with TUI, plugins, and more

en.hot: With 10k+ stars and daily additions, Claurst attracts developers seeking efficient, privacy-friendly coding agents; its rich features and active beta phase drive popularity.
uses: Daily coding: acts as an AI pair programmer in the terminal with multi-provider support.
Privacy-conscious users: no tracking, no telemetry, fully self-hostable.
Experiment enthusiasts: try cutting-edge features like /goal and ultracode.
Rust developers: learn from a complex TUI application built in Rust.

zh.tag: 终端里的 AI 编程搭档，全面兼容主流 LLM

en.tag: Your coding bestie in the terminal, wired to any LLM

zh.tag: 大规模 AI 代理的高密度运行时与生命周期管理平台
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个为大规模 AI 代理部署提供高性能、高密度运行时的系统。它通过控制平面管理代理沙箱的完整生命周期，支持亚秒级的挂起/恢复操作，并允许将大量代理复用映射到少量物理节点上。该系统基于 Kubernetes 构建，提供代理专用的调度和控制，以实现低延迟和高资源利用率。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 Kubernetes（Pods 和 Pod 自动扩缩容）进行基础设施供应和工作节点生命周期管理，支持多种沙箱技术（microVM、gVisor）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 89 颗星，总星数达 1048，登上 GitHub Trending（Go 语言周榜）第 17 名。其高密度复用和亚秒级恢复能力解决了 AI 代理部署中的关键成本与延迟问题，吸引了基础设施开发者的关注。

en.tag: High-density runtime & lifecycle management for large-scale agent deployments
en.what: Agent Substrate is a system that provides a performant, high-density runtime for large-scale AI agent deployments. Its control plane manages the full lifecycle of agent sandboxes, enabling sub-second suspend/resume operations and heavy multiplexing of agents onto shared infrastructure. Built on Kubernetes, it offers agent-specific scheduling and control for low latency and high resource efficiency.
en.content: The repo contains the core system implementation, including a control plane, sandbox management (supporting microVMs and gVisor), lifecycle operations (create/destroy, suspend/resume), real-time worker assignment, and traffic routing. It also includes a demo showing ~250 stateful actors multiplexed across 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it leverages Kubernetes (Pods and Pod autoscaling) for infrastructure provisioning and worker lifecycle management, and supports multiple sandbox technologies including microVMs and gVisor.
en.hot: Gained 89 stars this week, reaching 1048 total and ranking #17 on GitHub Trending (Go weekly). Its high-density multiplexing and sub-second resume capabilities address key cost and latency issues in AI agent deployment, attracting infrastructure developers.

Infrastructure engineers: looking to build high-density, low-latency agent runtimes on Kubernetes.
Reinforcement learning (RL) teams: requiring unified management across agentic, inference, and training cycles.
Research institutions: exploring agent multiplexing and resource optimization techniques.
