zh.tag: 极速代理检查与 IP 轮换工具
zh.what: mubeng 是一个用 Go 编写的高性能代理检查器和 IP 轮换器。它能够快速验证代理的可用性，并在每次请求时自动轮换 IP 地址，帮助用户绕过 IP 封禁、速率限制或 WAF 拦截。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的命令行工具，支持二进制、Docker 和源码安装。提供代理检查、IP 轮换、Burp Suite 上游代理、OWASP ZAP 代理链等功能，并支持 HTTP、SOCKS v4(a)/v5 和 Amazon API Gateway 协议。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 标准库及第三方库，支持跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS、Raspberry Pi）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 54 颗星，总星数 2393，登上 GitHub Trending（Go 语言）日榜第 12 名。其极简设计和强大功能吸引了需要频繁更换 IP 的开发者和安全测试人员。
uses: 开发人员：在爬虫或 API 调用中自动轮换 IP，避免被封禁
安全测试人员：配合 Burp Suite 或 OWASP ZAP 使用，隐藏真实 IP
运维人员：快速批量检查代理池的可用性

en.tag: An incredibly fast proxy checker & IP rotator with ease.
en.what: mubeng is a high-performance proxy checker and IP rotator written in Go. It quickly verifies proxy availability and automatically rotates IP addresses for each request, helping users bypass IP bans, rate limits, or WAF blocks.
en.content: The repository contains a full-featured CLI tool with installation options via binary, Docker, or source. It offers proxy checking, IP rotation, Burp Suite upstream proxy, OWASP ZAP proxy chain, and supports HTTP, SOCKS v4(a)/v5, and Amazon API Gateway protocols.
en.stack: Built with Go, leveraging standard and third-party libraries, cross-platform support (Windows, Linux, macOS, Raspberry Pi).
en.hot: Gained 54 stars today, total 2393, ranking #12 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily. Its simplicity and powerful features attract developers and security testers who need frequent IP rotation.
uses: Developers: rotate IPs automatically in scraping or API calls to avoid bans
Security testers: use with Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP to hide real IP
Ops: quickly check proxy pool availability in batch

zh.tag: 电话号OSINT信息收集框架
zh.what: PhoneInfoga 是一个用于扫描国际电话号码的信息收集框架，可获取国家、地区、运营商和线路类型等基本信息，并利用多种技术尝试查找 VoIP 提供商或识别机主。它通过可配置的扫描器集合工作，旨在辅助调查而非自动化一切。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心框架、命令行界面、Web 图形界面以及 REST API 文档，支持通过外部 API、电话簿和搜索引擎进行 OSINT 足迹收集，并检查信誉报告、社交媒体和一次性号码等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，提供 REST API 和 Go 模块供编程使用，支持 Docker 部署，并集成了 Swagger 文档。
zh.hot: 尽管项目已停止维护，但因其强大的 OSINT 功能和易用性，仍保持 17k+ 星标，今日新增 29 星，位列 Go 趋势榜第 14 名，说明社区对其需求依然旺盛。
uses: 安全研究人员进行电话号码情报收集
调查记者验证电话号码相关信息
渗透测试人员辅助社会工程学攻击前侦察
普通用户查询陌生号码的基本信息

en.tag: OSINT framework for phone number reconnaissance
en.what: PhoneInfoga is an information gathering framework for scanning international phone numbers, providing basic details like country, area, carrier, and line type, and using various techniques to find VoIP providers or identify owners. It works with a collection of configurable scanners to assist investigations, not fully automate them.
en.content: The repository includes a Go-based core framework, CLI, web GUI, and REST API docs, enabling OSINT footprinting via external APIs, phone books, and search engines, plus checks for reputation reports, social media, and disposable numbers.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, offering a REST API and Go modules for programmatic use, with Docker support and Swagger documentation.
en.hot: Despite being unmaintained, its powerful OSINT capabilities and ease of use keep it at 17k+ stars, with 29 new stars today, ranking #14 on Go trending, showing sustained community demand.
uses: Security researchers for phone number intelligence gathering
Investigative journalists verifying phone-related information
Penetration testers for pre-engagement reconnaissance
General users looking up basic info on unknown numbers

zh.tag: Cloudflare CDN 优选 IP 测速工具
zh.what: 这是一个用于测试 Cloudflare CDN 延迟和速度的命令行工具，帮助用户从众多 IP 中筛选出最快、最稳定的 IP 地址。它支持 IPv4 和 IPv6，也适用于其他 CDN 或具有多个解析 IP 的网站。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言编写的源码、预编译的可执行文件（支持 Windows、Linux、macOS）、详细的 README 文档以及使用示例。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 标准库和少量第三方库，支持跨平台编译。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 28k 的 star，今日新增 31 个，因其解决了中国用户访问 Cloudflare CDN 速度慢的痛点，且简单易用，广受好评。
uses: 网站管理员或开发者，用于优化 Cloudflare CDN 的访问速度
需要频繁访问国外网站的用户，通过优选 IP 提升网络体验
网络爱好者，用于测试和比较不同 CDN 的性能

en.tag: Cloudflare CDN speed test and IP selection tool
en.what: A command-line tool to test Cloudflare CDN latency and speed, helping users find the fastest and most stable IP from a large pool. It supports IPv4 and IPv6, and can also be used for other CDNs or websites with multiple resolved IPs.
en.content: The repository contains Go source code, precompiled executables for Windows, Linux, and macOS, detailed README documentation, and usage examples.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging the standard library and a few third-party packages, with cross-platform compilation support.
en.hot: With over 28k stars and 31 new stars today, it addresses the pain point of slow Cloudflare CDN access for Chinese users, and its simplicity has earned widespread praise.
uses: Website admins or developers optimizing Cloudflare CDN access speed
Users who frequently visit foreign websites, improving network experience via optimized IPs
Network enthusiasts testing and comparing CDN performance

zh.tag: 一键运行开源大模型的本地推理平台
zh.what: Ollama 是一个本地运行开源大模型的工具，支持 Kimi-K2.6、GLM-5.2、DeepSeek、Qwen、Gemma 等众多模型。它提供简洁的命令行界面和 REST API，让用户轻松下载、运行和管理模型，并可与 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 代理集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ollama 的 Go 源码、安装脚本（macOS/Windows/Linux）、Docker 镜像、Python/JavaScript 客户端库，以及完整的 CLI 和 API 文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 llama.cpp 推理引擎，提供 REST API 和官方 Python/JavaScript SDK。
zh.hot: Star 数高达 178k，今日新增 84，持续霸榜。Ollama 让本地部署大模型变得极其简单，成为开发者体验开源模型的首选工具。
uses: 开发者本地快速体验和测试开源大模型
隐私敏感场景下离线运行 AI 助手
将本地模型接入 Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理
通过 REST API 构建自定义 AI 应用

en.tag: Run open-source LLMs locally with one command
en.what: Ollama is a tool for running open-source LLMs locally, supporting models like Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Gemma. It offers a simple CLI and REST API to easily download, run, and manage models, and integrates with AI agents like Claude Code and Codex.
en.content: The repo contains Ollama's Go source code, install scripts for macOS/Windows/Linux, Docker image, Python/JavaScript client libraries, and full CLI/API documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on the llama.cpp inference engine, with a REST API and official Python/JavaScript SDKs.
en.hot: With 178k stars and 84 new today, Ollama remains a trending favorite. It simplifies local LLM deployment, making it the go-to tool for developers exploring open models.
uses: Developers quickly trying and testing open LLMs locally
Running AI assistants offline for privacy-sensitive scenarios
Connecting local models to coding agents like Claude Code and Codex
Building custom AI apps via the REST API

zh.tag: App Store Connect 的极速脚本化 CLI
zh.what: 这是一个用于 App Store Connect API 的命令行工具，可自动化 iOS、macOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 的发布流程，包括 TestFlight、构建、提交、签名、分析、截图和订阅等。它采用 JSON 优先设计，无交互提示，适合在终端、IDE 或 CI/CD 管道中使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 二进制，提供 `asc` 命令，支持安装脚本、Homebrew 和 WinGet 安装。还包含文档、示例工作流和可选的 Agent Skills 包，用于自动化构建、TestFlight、元数据同步等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 App Store Connect API。支持 Homebrew、WinGet 和 curl 安装脚本，并集成了 Agent Skills（需要 git）。
zh.hot: 以 5669 星和日增 78 星登上 Go 趋势榜，因其填补了 App Store 发布自动化的空白，提供快速、可脚本化的 CLI，深受开发者欢迎。
uses: iOS/macOS 开发者：在 CI/CD 中自动化 TestFlight 分发和 App Store 提交
发布工程师：用脚本批量管理构建、签名和元数据
独立开发者：快速上传截图、管理订阅和查看分析数据

en.tag: Fast, scriptable CLI for App Store Connect API
en.what: A CLI for the App Store Connect API that automates release workflows for iOS, macOS, tvOS, and visionOS, including TestFlight, builds, submissions, signing, analytics, screenshots, and subscriptions. It is JSON-first with no interactive prompts, suitable for terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipelines.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI binary with the `asc` command, installable via script, Homebrew, or WinGet. It includes documentation, example workflows, and an optional Agent Skills pack for automating builds, TestFlight, metadata sync, etc.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging the App Store Connect API. Supports installation via Homebrew, WinGet, and curl script, and integrates Agent Skills (requires git).
en.hot: With 5,669 stars and +78 today on the Go trending list, it fills a gap in App Store release automation, offering a fast, scriptable CLI that developers love.
uses: iOS/macOS developers: automate TestFlight distribution and App Store submissions in CI/CD
Release engineers: script batch management of builds, signing, and metadata
Indie developers: quickly upload screenshots, manage subscriptions, and view analytics

zh.tag: AList 社区分支，抵御信任危机的开源文件列表工具
zh.what: OpenList 是 AList 的一个分支，旨在通过社区驱动和长期治理来抵御基于信任的攻击。它提供文件列表与分享功能，并强调代码完全开放和修改透明。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心程序、多语言 README（中英日等）、贡献指南、行为准则和 AGPL-3.0 许可证。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Cloudflare 提供的慈善资源用于文档和 API 服务。
zh.hot: 作为 AList 的替代品，在信任危机背景下迅速获得关注，Star 数接近 2.4 万，今日新增 37。
uses: 需要文件列表和分享功能的个人或团队
关注开源项目长期治理和社区驱动的开发者
希望避免信任风险、寻求透明代码的用户

en.tag: A community-driven AList fork for resilient, trust-safe open source file listing
en.what: OpenList is a fork of AList designed to defend against trust-based attacks through community-driven, long-term governance. It provides file listing and sharing capabilities, emphasizing full code openness and modification transparency.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based core application, multi-language READMEs (English, Chinese, Japanese, etc.), contributing guidelines, code of conduct, and AGPL-3.0 license.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, relying on charitable resources from Cloudflare for documentation and API services.
en.hot: As an AList alternative amid a trust crisis, it quickly gained attention with nearly 24k stars and 37 new stars today.
uses: Individuals or teams needing file listing and sharing
Developers interested in long-term governance and community-driven projects
Users seeking transparent code to avoid trust risks

zh.tag: 像 Prometheus 一样的日志聚合系统
zh.what: Loki 是一个水平可扩展、高可用、多租户的日志聚合系统，受 Prometheus 启发。它不索引日志内容，而是索引日志流的标签，因此成本低且易于运维。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Loki 主服务代码，以及文档、Helm chart 等。日志收集由 Alloy（原 Promtail）负责，查询和展示由 Grafana 完成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Grafana 生态，支持 Kubernetes 集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Grafana 官方日志方案，Loki 以低成本、易运维著称，与 Prometheus 标签体系无缝衔接，在云原生监控领域广受欢迎。
uses: Kubernetes 集群日志采集与查询
需要与 Prometheus 指标联动分析的场景
希望降低日志存储成本的团队

en.tag: Log aggregation system like Prometheus, but for logs
en.what: Loki is a horizontally-scalable, highly-available, multi-tenant log aggregation system inspired by Prometheus. It does not index log contents but rather a set of labels for each log stream, making it cost-effective and easy to operate.
en.content: The repository contains the main Loki service code, along with documentation and Helm charts. Log collection is handled by Alloy (formerly Promtail), and querying/displaying is done via Grafana.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, integrates with the Grafana ecosystem, and supports Kubernetes.
en.hot: As Grafana's official logging solution, Loki is known for its low cost and easy operation, seamlessly integrating with Prometheus labels, making it popular in cloud-native monitoring.
uses: Collecting and querying logs in Kubernetes clusters
Scenarios requiring correlation with Prometheus metrics
Teams looking to reduce log storage costs

zh.tag: 3D打印切片软件，支持多平台与远程控制
zh.what: BambuStudio 是一款功能丰富的 3D 打印切片软件，提供基于项目的流程、优化的切片算法和易用的图形界面。它支持多种打印机，并具备远程监控、多板管理等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的切片器源代码、编译指南、文档及预编译的 Windows/macOS/Linux 版本。基于 PrusaSlicer 开发，并扩展了多种高级功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，基于 PrusaSlicer（源自 Slic3r），支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。
zh.hot: 作为 Bambu Lab 官方切片软件，凭借强大的功能和活跃的社区，在 GitHub 上持续获得关注，今日新增 3 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第一。
uses: 3D打印爱好者：使用 BambuStudio 进行模型切片和打印管理。
Bambu Lab 打印机用户：利用远程控制和多板管理功能提升打印效率。
开发者：基于开源代码定制或贡献新功能。

en.tag: Feature-rich 3D printing slicer with multi-platform support and remote control
en.what: BambuStudio is a feature-rich 3D printing slicer with project-based workflows, optimized slicing algorithms, and an easy-to-use GUI. It supports multiple printers and includes remote monitoring, multi-plate management, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full slicer source code, build guides, documentation, and prebuilt releases for Windows/macOS/Linux. It is based on PrusaSlicer and extends it with advanced features.
en.stack: Primarily C++, built on PrusaSlicer (originally from Slic3r), supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: As the official slicer for Bambu Lab, it gains steady attention due to its powerful features and active community, adding 3 stars today and ranking #1 on the C++ trending list.
uses: 3D printing enthusiasts: use BambuStudio for slicing and print management.
Bambu Lab printer owners: leverage remote control and multi-plate management.
Developers: customize or contribute to the open-source codebase.

zh.tag: 1-bit LLM 官方推理框架，CPU 上高效运行
zh.what: BitNet 是微软推出的 1-bit 大语言模型推理框架，旨在让超低比特量化模型在 CPU 上高效运行。它支持 BitNet b1.58 等三元模型，并提供优化的内核和工具链，实现接近全精度模型的性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理引擎（C++ 实现）、CPU 和 GPU 内核、模型转换工具、示例代码，以及针对嵌入模型的 I2_S 量化支持。还发布了 BitNet-embedding 系列模型和 VibeASR.cpp 等衍生项目。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 OpenMP 等并行库，支持 x86 (AVX2) 和 ARM (NEON) 指令集，并提供 Python 绑定。
zh.hot: BitNet 代表了 LLM 推理的极低比特量化方向，能大幅降低内存和计算需求，在 CPU 上实现高效推理。近 4 万星标表明社区对边缘部署和成本优化的强烈兴趣。
uses: 在无 GPU 的服务器或边缘设备上部署 LLM，降低硬件成本
需要低延迟、高吞吐的 CPU 推理场景，如实时语音识别（VibeASR）
研究低比特量化技术和模型压缩的开发者
构建嵌入模型应用，利用 BitNet-embedding 加速检索

en.tag: Official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, efficient on CPU
en.what: BitNet is Microsoft's official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, enabling efficient CPU deployment of ternary models like BitNet b1.58. It provides optimized kernels and tooling to achieve near-full-precision performance.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference engine (C++), CPU and GPU kernels, model conversion tools, examples, and I2_S quantization support for embedding models. It also hosts BitNet-embedding models and VibeASR.cpp.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with OpenMP for parallelism, supporting x86 (AVX2) and ARM (NEON), and offering Python bindings.
en.hot: BitNet represents the extreme low-bit quantization direction for LLM inference, drastically reducing memory and compute needs while enabling efficient CPU inference. Its ~40k stars reflect strong community interest in edge deployment and cost optimization.
uses: Deploy LLMs on CPU-only servers or edge devices to cut hardware costs
Low-latency, high-throughput CPU inference scenarios like real-time ASR (VibeASR)
Developers researching low-bit quantization and model compression
Build embedding-based applications with accelerated retrieval via BitNet-embedding

zh.tag: 自托管游戏串流服务端，配合 Moonlight 使用
zh.what: Sunshine 是一个自托管的游戏串流服务端，允许用户将 PC 上的游戏和桌面串流到其他设备。它兼容 Moonlight 客户端，提供低延迟、高性能的串流体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Sunshine 的源代码、构建脚本、文档以及用于不同平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）的安装包。还提供 Docker 镜像和 Flathub 包，方便部署。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 FFmpeg、CUDA/NVENC 等硬件编码技术，支持多种视频编码和网络协议。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 40k 星标，因其开源、免费且功能强大的游戏串流方案而广受欢迎，是 NVIDIA GameStream 的替代品。
uses: 游戏玩家：将 PC 游戏串流到笔记本、手机或电视等设备
远程办公：远程访问桌面进行工作或演示
自托管爱好者：搭建私有串流服务，摆脱云服务限制

en.tag: Self-hosted game stream host for Moonlight
en.what: Sunshine is a self-hosted game stream host that lets users stream games and desktop from their PC to other devices. It works with Moonlight clients, offering low-latency, high-performance streaming.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, build scripts, documentation, and installers for different platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS). Docker images and Flathub packages are also provided for easy deployment.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it leverages FFmpeg, CUDA/NVENC, and other hardware encoding technologies, supporting various video codecs and network protocols.
en.hot: With over 40k stars, it's popular for being an open-source, free, and powerful game streaming solution, serving as an alternative to NVIDIA GameStream.
uses: Gamers: stream PC games to laptops, phones, or TVs
Remote work: access desktop remotely for work or presentations
Self-hosting enthusiasts: set up private streaming services without cloud limitations

zh.tag: 真正独立的现代网页浏览器，基于全新引擎
zh.what: Ladybird 是一个真正独立的网页浏览器，采用基于 Web 标准的新颖引擎，旨在构建完整、可用的现代浏览器。它目前处于预 alpha 阶段，仅适合开发者使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含浏览器的主要源代码，采用多进程架构，包括 UI 主进程、多个 WebContent 渲染进程、ImageDecoder 进程和 RequestServer 进程。核心库组件继承自 SerenityOS，如 LibWeb、LibJS、LibWasm 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SerenityOS 的多个库（LibWeb、LibJS、LibWasm 等），支持 Linux、macOS、Windows（WSL2）等平台。
zh.hot: 作为真正独立的浏览器项目，Ladybird 在开发者中引起广泛关注，star 数已达 64,842，今日新增 42，位列 C++ 日榜第一。
uses: 对浏览器引擎感兴趣的开发者，可以学习其架构和实现。
希望参与开源浏览器项目贡献的开发者。
关注 Web 标准和技术前沿的技术爱好者。

en.tag: A truly independent web browser with a novel standards-based engine
en.what: Ladybird is a truly independent web browser with a novel standards-based engine, aiming to build a complete, usable browser for the modern web. It is currently in pre-alpha state and only suitable for developers.
en.content: The repository contains the main source code of the browser, using a multi-process architecture with a main UI process, several WebContent renderer processes, an ImageDecoder process, and a RequestServer process. Core library components are inherited from SerenityOS, such as LibWeb, LibJS, LibWasm, etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on several SerenityOS libraries (LibWeb, LibJS, LibWasm, etc.), supporting Linux, macOS, Windows (with WSL2), and other *NIXes.
en.hot: As a truly independent browser project, Ladybird has gained significant attention among developers, with 64,842 stars and 42 new stars today, ranking first on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Developers interested in browser engines, to learn its architecture and implementation.
Developers who want to contribute to an open-source browser project.
Tech enthusiasts following web standards and cutting-edge technology.

zh.tag: 跨平台 C++ 音频应用与插件开发框架
zh.what: JUCE 是一个开源的跨平台 C++ 应用框架，主要用于开发桌面和移动应用，尤其擅长音频软件，支持 VST、VST3、AU、AUv3、LV2 和 AAX 等音频插件格式。它提供了丰富的 UI 组件和音频处理模块，简化了音频应用的开发流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含 JUCE 框架的完整源代码，包括核心模块、示例项目、Projucer 项目生成工具（需自行构建）以及 CMake 构建支持。目录结构清晰，包含 extras（如 Projucer）、examples 和 modules 等。
zh.stack: 基于 C++17（启用 Windows MIDI 服务时需 C++20），支持 CMake 3.22+ 和 Projucer 构建。跨平台支持 macOS/iOS、Windows、Linux 和 Android。
zh.hot: JUCE 是音频开发领域的标杆框架，拥有庞大的用户基础。虽然今日新增 star 不多，但长期保持高热度，在 GitHub Trending 上持续上榜，反映了其在音频开发者社区中的持久影响力。
uses: 音频插件开发者：创建 VST/AU/AAX 等格式的音频插件
音乐软件公司：快速构建跨平台 DAW 或音乐制作工具
独立开发者：利用其丰富的 UI 组件开发创意音频应用
教育研究：学习音频处理与跨平台 C++ 开发的最佳实践

en.tag: Cross-platform C++ framework for audio apps and plugins
en.what: JUCE is an open-source cross-platform C++ application framework for building desktop and mobile apps, with a strong focus on audio software. It supports major audio plugin formats like VST, VST3, AU, AUv3, LV2, and AAX, and provides extensive UI components and audio modules to streamline development.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the JUCE framework, including core modules, examples, the Projucer project generator (build from source), and CMake build support. It is organized into directories like extras (including Projucer), examples, and modules.
en.stack: Built on C++17 (C++20 when using Windows MIDI services), with CMake 3.22+ and Projucer build options. Cross-platform support for macOS/iOS, Windows, Linux, and Android.
en.hot: JUCE is a benchmark framework in audio development with a large user base. Despite modest daily star gains, it consistently appears on GitHub Trending, reflecting its enduring influence in the audio developer community.
uses: Audio plugin developers: create VST/AU/AAX plugins
Music software companies: rapidly build cross-platform DAWs or music tools
Indie developers: leverage rich UI components for creative audio apps
Education/research: learn audio processing and cross-platform C++ best practices

zh.tag: 开源 PS3 模拟器与调试器
zh.what: RPCS3 是全球首个免费开源的 PlayStation 3 模拟器/调试器，用 C++ 编写，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 FreeBSD。它允许用户在 PC 上运行 PS3 游戏，并提供调试功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码、构建脚本、文档（如 BUILDING.md）以及 Wiki 链接。项目还设有社区论坛和 Discord 服务器，用于游戏兼容性报告和讨论。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Qt 等库，支持多种平台。项目使用 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 作为最成熟的 PS3 模拟器之一，RPCS3 持续吸引大量关注，今日新增 20 星，总星数近 2 万，在 C++ 趋势榜上排名第六。
uses: 游戏玩家：在 PC 上体验 PS3 独占游戏
开发者：研究 PS3 硬件模拟和逆向工程
测试人员：参与游戏兼容性测试并提交报告

en.tag: Open-source PS3 emulator and debugger
en.what: RPCS3 is the world's first free and open-source PlayStation 3 emulator/debugger, written in C++ for Windows, Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD. It allows users to run PS3 games on PC and provides debugging capabilities.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, build scripts, documentation (e.g., BUILDING.md), and links to the Wiki. The project also has community forums and a Discord server for game compatibility reports and discussions.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with dependencies like Qt, and supports multiple platforms. The project uses GitHub Actions for continuous integration.
en.hot: As one of the most mature PS3 emulators, RPCS3 continues to attract attention, gaining 20 stars today and nearly 20k total, ranking 6th on the C++ trending list.
uses: Gamers: Experience PS3 exclusive titles on PC
Developers: Research PS3 hardware emulation and reverse engineering
Testers: Participate in game compatibility testing and report issues

zh.tag: 腾讯开源的高性能移动端神经网络推理框架
zh.what: ncnn 是一个专为移动端、嵌入式和桌面端优化的高性能神经网络推理框架。它无第三方运行时依赖，支持 CPU 和 Vulkan GPU 后端，并提供 pnnx 工具将 PyTorch 和 ONNX 模型转换为 ncnn 格式。开发者可以高效地将深度学习模型部署到手机、PC、浏览器和边缘设备上。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理引擎（C++实现）、pnnx 模型转换工具、Python 绑定、示例代码以及详细的文档。目录结构清晰，包括 src、tools、python、examples 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Vulkan 作为 GPU 后端，可选支持 OpenMP 等。提供 Python 绑定，并支持 PyTorch 和 ONNX 模型转换。
zh.hot: ncnn 在 GitHub 上拥有 23681 颗星，今日新增 10 颗，位列 C++ 日榜第 7。作为腾讯开源项目，它在移动端推理领域具有广泛影响力和社区支持。
uses: 移动应用开发者：在 Android/iOS 应用中高效部署深度学习模型
嵌入式/边缘设备开发者：在资源受限的设备上运行神经网络
AI 研究者：快速将 PyTorch/ONNX 模型转换并部署到多平台

en.tag: Tencent's high-performance neural network inference framework for mobile
en.what: ncnn is a high-performance neural network inference framework optimized for mobile, embedded, and desktop deployment. It has no third-party runtime dependencies, supports CPU and Vulkan GPU backends, and provides tools like pnnx to convert PyTorch and ONNX models to ncnn format. Developers can efficiently deploy deep learning models to phones, PCs, browsers, and edge devices.
en.content: The repository contains the core inference engine (C++ implementation), the pnnx model conversion tool, Python bindings, examples, and detailed documentation. The directory structure is clear, including src, tools, python, examples, etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with Vulkan as the GPU backend, and optional OpenMP support. Provides Python bindings and supports conversion from PyTorch and ONNX models.
en.hot: ncnn has 23,681 stars on GitHub, with 10 new stars today, ranking 7th on the daily C++ trending list. As a Tencent open-source project, it has broad influence and community support in mobile inference.
uses: Mobile app developers: efficiently deploy deep learning models in Android/iOS apps
Embedded/edge device developers: run neural networks on resource-constrained devices
AI researchers: quickly convert and deploy PyTorch/ONNX models to multiple platforms

zh.tag: 开源跨平台 BitTorrent 客户端，功能全面
zh.what: qBittorrent 是一个基于 Qt 和 libtorrent 的 BitTorrent 客户端，旨在成为其他客户端的优秀替代品。它快速、稳定，支持 Unicode 和多语言，并提供丰富的功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建配置、安装说明和许可证文件。项目使用 CMake 构建，支持多种平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 libtorrent 库，并使用 DB-IP 的 IP 到国家数据库。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源 BT 客户端，它拥有近 4 万 star，今日新增 36 星，持续受到关注。其稳定性和功能完整性使其成为许多用户的首选。
uses: 需要下载和分享种子的普通用户
寻求开源替代品的 BT 客户端用户
希望定制或学习 BT 客户端开发的开发者

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform BitTorrent client with rich features
en.what: qBittorrent is a BitTorrent client based on Qt and libtorrent, aiming to be a good alternative to other clients. It is fast, stable, supports Unicode and multiple languages, and offers many features.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, build configuration, installation instructions, and license files. The project uses CMake for building and supports multiple platforms.
en.stack: Primarily uses C++ and Qt framework, depends on libtorrent library, and uses DB-IP's IP-to-Country database.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source BT client, it has nearly 40k stars, with 36 stars added today, maintaining steady attention. Its stability and feature completeness make it a top choice for many users.
uses: Regular users who need to download and share torrents
Users seeking an open-source alternative to other BT clients
Developers who want to customize or learn BT client development

zh.tag: 单文件分发运行大模型，免安装跨平台
zh.what: llamafile 将 llama.cpp 与 Cosmopolitan Libc 结合，把大语言模型打包成单个可执行文件，用户无需安装即可在大多数操作系统和 CPU 架构上本地运行。它还包含 whisperfile，一个基于 whisper.cpp 的单文件语音转文字工具，支持音频转录和翻译。
zh.content: 仓库包含 llamafile 的源码、构建系统、预构建的 llamafile 可执行文件（如 llava-v1.5-7b）、whisperfile 工具、文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，依赖 llama.cpp、whisper.cpp 和 Cosmopolitan Libc，支持多种模型格式和硬件加速。
zh.hot: 以 25.5k stars 持续热门，因为极大简化了 LLM 的分发与运行，让普通用户也能轻松本地部署，且由 Mozilla 支持，社区活跃。
uses: 开发者：快速将 LLM 集成到应用中，无需复杂环境配置
普通用户：在个人电脑上运行聊天机器人或语音转文字工具
教育场景：用于教学演示或实验，无需服务器
隐私敏感场景：本地运行模型，数据不出设备

en.tag: Distribute and run LLMs as a single executable, no install, cross-platform
en.what: llamafile combines llama.cpp with Cosmopolitan Libc to package LLMs into a single executable that runs locally on most OSes and CPU architectures without installation. It also includes whisperfile, a single-file speech-to-text tool based on whisper.cpp, supporting audio transcription and translation.
en.content: The repo contains llamafile source code, build system, pre-built llamafile executables (e.g., llava-v1.5-7b), whisperfile tool, documentation, and examples.
en.stack: Built on C++, leveraging llama.cpp, whisper.cpp, and Cosmopolitan Libc, supporting various model formats and hardware acceleration.
en.hot: With 25.5k stars, it remains popular because it drastically simplifies LLM distribution and execution, enabling easy local deployment for everyday users, backed by Mozilla with an active community.
uses: Developers: quickly integrate LLMs into apps without complex environment setup
End users: run chatbots or speech-to-text on personal computers
Education: for teaching demos or experiments without servers
Privacy-sensitive: run models locally, data stays on device

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

zh.tag: 经典 Windows 代码编辑器与记事本替代品
zh.what: Notepad++ 是一款免费（自由）的源代码编辑器，支持多种编程语言和自然语言，是 Windows 环境下记事本的增强替代品。它提供语法高亮、代码折叠、宏录制、插件扩展等丰富功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建指南（BUILD.md）、贡献规则（CONTRIBUTING.md）、GPG 签名密钥以及支持系统信息。项目采用 GPL 许可证，并持续接受社区贡献。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Win32 API 和 Scintilla 编辑组件，构建系统支持 Visual Studio 等工具。
zh.hot: 作为拥有近 3 万 star 的经典项目，Notepad++ 长期活跃于 GitHub Trending，因其轻量、功能强大且完全免费，持续吸引大量 Windows 用户和开发者关注。
uses: Windows 用户寻找轻量级代码编辑器或记事本替代品
开发者需要快速查看或编辑配置文件、脚本等
学习 C++ 和 Win32 编程的参考项目
希望参与开源项目贡献的开发者

en.tag: Classic Windows code editor and Notepad replacement
en.what: Notepad++ is a free (free as in freedom and free of charge) source code editor that supports multiple programming and natural languages, serving as an enhanced Notepad replacement on Windows. It offers syntax highlighting, code folding, macro recording, plugin extensions, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++ source code, build guide (BUILD.md), contribution rules (CONTRIBUTING.md), GPG signing key, and supported systems info. The project is GPL-licensed and actively accepts community contributions.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, leveraging Win32 API and the Scintilla editing component, with build support for Visual Studio and other tools.
en.hot: With nearly 29k stars, Notepad++ remains a long-standing favorite on GitHub Trending due to its lightweight, powerful, and completely free nature, consistently attracting Windows users and developers.
uses: Windows users seeking a lightweight code editor or Notepad replacement
Developers needing quick viewing/editing of config files, scripts, etc.
Reference project for learning C++ and Win32 programming
Developers interested in contributing to open source

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。
zh.content: C++ 源码 + 一份简短 README，讲清使用步骤（FSL → 下载 nightly release → 注入器 → 关 BattlEye → 注入）和常见问题修复（掉线、存档消失、游戏起不来）。
zh.stack: C++，DLL 注入式单机/联机修改器，依赖外部注入器和 FSL，GPL-2.0；默认分支 enhanced。
zh.hot: 它面向 GTA5 增强版 Mod 社区的具体需求，并延续 YimMenu 项目路线，为需要开源菜单的用户提供选择。
uses: GTA5 单机玩家 —— 刷车刷钱体验全部游戏内容
mod 开发者 —— 基于源码学习或二次开发游戏菜单
离线娱乐 —— 关 BattlEye 后在私人战局整活

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open. Pairing with FSL (redirecting save data to local disk) is recommended to protect your account, and BattlEye anti-cheat must be disabled (there's no BE bypass — public sessions will kick you via heartbeat checks).
en.content: C++ source plus a short README covering the workflow (FSL → nightly release → injector → disable BattlEye → inject) and fixes for common issues (disconnects, missing saves, game won't launch).
en.stack: C++, a DLL-injection single/multiplayer mod menu relying on external injectors and FSL; GPL-2.0; default branch enhanced.
en.hot: It targets a concrete need in the GTA5 Enhanced modding community and continues the familiar YimMenu project line for users seeking an open menu.
uses: GTA5 single-player fans — unlock vehicles and cash to experience all content
mod developers — learn from or fork the source for custom game menus
Offline fun — mess around in private sessions with BattlEye off

zh.tag: 跨平台图形化代理客户端，基于 sing-box 内核
zh.what: Throne 是一款基于 Qt 的跨平台图形化代理工具，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。它利用 sing-box 和 Xray 内核，提供丰富的协议支持和订阅管理功能。作为已归档的 Nekoray 项目的延续，它带来了大量改进和新特性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Qt 桌面应用源码，支持多种代理协议（如 Shadowsocks、VMess、VLESS、Hysteria 等），提供订阅解析、自定义配置、链式出站等功能。还包含 Linux 安装脚本和 RPM 仓库配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 sing-box 和 Xray-core 作为代理内核，并集成 simple-protobuf、fkYAML、quirc、QHotkey、sqlitecpp 等库。
zh.hot: 作为 Nekoray 的活跃继任者，它吸引了大量原用户，star 数已达 6695，今日新增 18，位列 C++ 日榜第 4。其丰富的协议支持和跨平台特性使其在代理工具社区中备受关注。
uses: 需要跨平台图形化代理客户端的用户，替代已归档的 Nekoray
依赖 sing-box 或 Xray 内核的高级用户，需要自定义配置和链式出站
希望使用订阅链接管理多个代理服务器的用户

en.tag: Cross-platform GUI proxy client powered by sing-box
en.what: Throne is a Qt-based cross-platform GUI proxy utility supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. It leverages sing-box and Xray cores, offering extensive protocol support and subscription management. As a continuation of the archived Nekoray project, it brings many improvements and new features.
en.content: The repository contains the full Qt desktop application source code, supporting numerous proxy protocols (e.g., Shadowsocks, VMess, VLESS, Hysteria), with subscription parsing, custom configs, and chaining outbounds. It also includes Linux install scripts and RPM repository setup.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Qt framework, relying on sing-box and Xray-core as proxy cores, and integrating libraries like simple-protobuf, fkYAML, quirc, QHotkey, and sqlitecpp.
en.hot: As an active successor to Nekoray, it attracts many former users, with 6695 stars and 18 new today, ranking 4th on the C++ daily trending. Its extensive protocol support and cross-platform nature make it popular in the proxy tool community.
uses: Users needing a cross-platform GUI proxy client, replacing the archived Nekoray
Advanced users relying on sing-box or Xray cores, requiring custom configs and chaining outbounds
Users who want to manage multiple proxy servers via subscription links

zh.tag: 英特尔开源 AI 推理优化与部署工具包
zh.what: OpenVINO 是一个用于优化和部署深度学习模型的开源工具包，支持从边缘到云端的多种硬件平台。它能够提升计算机视觉、语音识别、生成式 AI 和 NLP 等任务的推理性能，并支持主流框架训练的模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenVINO 的完整源代码、文档、教程、集成示例和基准测试工具。还提供了 Python、C++、Node.js 等多种语言的 API 和安装包。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python、C++、Node.js 等接口，支持 ONNX、PyTorch、TensorFlow 等模型格式，并集成 Hugging Face Optimum Intel。
zh.hot: OpenVINO 作为英特尔官方的 AI 推理工具，拥有超过 1 万星标，今日新增 6 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 11 名。其广泛的硬件兼容性和对生成式 AI 的支持持续吸引开发者。
uses: AI 应用开发者：在边缘设备或云端部署优化后的推理模型，提升性能。
计算机视觉工程师：利用 OpenVINO 加速图像分类、目标检测等任务。
生成式 AI 爱好者：通过 OpenVINO GenAI 部署大语言模型和扩散模型。
嵌入式系统开发者：在 Intel CPU、GPU 和 NPU 上实现高效推理。

en.tag: Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
en.what: OpenVINO is an open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning models, supporting a range of platforms from edge to cloud. It boosts inference performance for tasks like computer vision, speech recognition, generative AI, and NLP, and supports models trained with popular frameworks.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, tutorials, integration examples, and benchmark tools for OpenVINO. It also provides APIs and packages for multiple languages including Python, C++, and Node.js.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with interfaces for Python, C++, Node.js, etc. Supports model formats like ONNX, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and integrates with Hugging Face Optimum Intel.
en.hot: As Intel's official AI inference toolkit, OpenVINO has over 10k stars, with 6 added today, ranking 11th on the C++ trending list. Its broad hardware compatibility and support for generative AI continue to attract developers.
uses: AI application developers: deploy optimized inference models on edge or cloud for better performance.
Computer vision engineers: accelerate tasks like image classification and object detection with OpenVINO.
Generative AI enthusiasts: deploy large language models and diffusion models via OpenVINO GenAI.
Embedded systems developers: achieve efficient inference on Intel CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs.

zh.tag: 离线、不追踪的开源安卓键盘
zh.what: FUTO Keyboard 是一款注重隐私的现代安卓键盘，基于 AOSP 的 LatinIME 深度改造。它完全离线运行，不收集用户数据，并支持丰富的自定义布局。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Android 键盘应用源码，包括输入逻辑、布局系统、构建脚本和文档。源码托管在 GitLab，GitHub 作为镜像和问题跟踪。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 C++（JNI 部分）和 Java/Kotlin（Android 应用），使用 Gradle 构建，依赖 Android SDK 和 NDK。
zh.hot: 在隐私意识增强的背景下，这款离线键盘因其不追踪、开源且可高度定制而受到关注，尽管今日新增星标为 0，但累计近 3000 星。
uses: 注重隐私的用户：希望输入法不收集个人数据。
开源爱好者：可自由查看和修改代码，参与贡献。
键盘定制者：喜欢自定义布局和功能的用户。

en.tag: Offline, privacy-respecting open-source Android keyboard
en.what: FUTO Keyboard is a privacy-focused modern Android keyboard, a fork of AOSP LatinIME with significant modifications. It works fully offline, collects no user data, and supports extensive layout customization.
en.content: The repository contains the full Android keyboard app source code, including input logic, layout system, build scripts, and documentation. Source is hosted on GitLab, mirrored to GitHub for issues and PRs.
en.stack: Primary languages are C++ (JNI) and Java/Kotlin (Android app), built with Gradle, depending on Android SDK and NDK.
en.hot: Amid growing privacy concerns, this offline keyboard gains attention for being non-tracking, open-source, and highly customizable; despite 0 stars today, it has nearly 3k stars overall.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want a keyboard that doesn't collect personal data.
Open-source enthusiasts who can freely view, modify, and contribute.
Keyboard customizers who enjoy tweaking layouts and features.

zh.tag: 开源魔兽世界3.3.5a服务端，模块化MMO框架
zh.what: AzerothCore是一个开源的游戏服务器应用和框架，用于托管大型多人在线角色扮演游戏（MMORPG）。它基于魔兽世界3.3.5a版本，旨在重现原始游戏体验，并经过大量开发以提高稳定性、游戏机制和模块化。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心服务器代码、模块系统、构建脚本、Docker配置、工具和仪表板，支持跨平台构建（Windows、macOS、Linux）。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++，基于MaNGOS、TrinityCore和SunwellCore，支持Docker部署，并集成CI（GitHub Actions）和CodeFactor。
zh.hot: 拥有8744颗星，是魔兽世界私服开发者的热门选择，社区活跃，持续更新，今日新增8星，位列C++趋势榜第16名。
uses: 魔兽世界私服管理员：搭建稳定、可定制的3.3.5a服务器
游戏开发学习者：研究大型MMO服务器架构与C++实践
模组开发者：利用模块系统扩展游戏功能

en.tag: Open-source WoW 3.3.5a server, modular MMO framework
en.what: AzerothCore is an open-source game server application and framework for hosting MMORPGs. Based on WoW patch 3.3.5a, it aims to recreate the original gameplay experience, with extensive development to improve stability, in-game mechanics, and modularity.
en.content: The repository contains core server code, a modular system, build scripts, Docker configurations, tools, and a dashboard, with cross-platform builds for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily C++, based on MaNGOS, TrinityCore, and SunwellCore, with Docker support and CI via GitHub Actions and CodeFactor.
en.hot: With 8,744 stars, it's a popular choice for WoW private server developers, actively maintained by a vibrant community, gaining 8 stars today and ranking #16 on the C++ trending list.
uses: WoW private server admins: set up stable, customizable 3.3.5a servers
Game dev learners: study large-scale MMO server architecture and C++ practices
Mod developers: extend game features via the modular system

zh.tag: C++即时模式GUI库，轻量无依赖，专为工具与调试界面而生
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个无冗余、自包含的 C++ 即时模式图形用户界面库，专注于为开发者提供内容创作与调试工具的快速迭代能力。它输出优化后的顶点缓冲区，可无缝集成到现有 3D 渲染管线中，无需外部依赖。与传统保留模式 UI 不同，它更适合构建高性能的内部工具、可视化面板和调试窗口。
zh.content: 仓库以核心头文件与单文件源码（imgui.h / imgui.cpp）为主体，并附带大量官方渲染后端与平台绑定（DirectX、OpenGL、Vulkan、Metal、GLFW、SDL、Win32 等）。同时提供开箱即用的示例程序、综合 Demo 窗口、文档 Wiki，以及独立的 imgui_test_engine 测试引擎。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 编写，自包含且无任何外部依赖；通过可插拔后端接入 DirectX、OpenGL、Vulkan、Metal、WebGPU 等现代图形 API，并可绑定至 GLFW、SDL、Win32 等窗口系统。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态中事实标准的工具型 UI 方案，Dear ImGui 已积累 74.7K Stars，本月新增 338 星并位列 Trending 月榜第 13。它几乎被所有主流游戏引擎和 3D 工具链采用，填补了高性能即时调试界面的长期空白。
uses: 游戏/图形引擎开发者 —— 为自研引擎快速搭建关卡编辑器、材质调试与性能分析面板
实时可视化与监控工具 —— 构建机器人、量化交易、嵌入式系统的实时数据看板
桌面工具软件作者 —— 为 C++ 桌面程序创建轻量、可移植的 ImGui 原生界面
算法与科研调试 —— 在图形/仿真/AI 训练过程中快速可视化参数与中间状态

en.tag: Bloat-free immediate-mode GUI library for C++ with minimal dependencies
en.what: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free, self-contained immediate-mode GUI library for C++ that empowers developers to build content creation and debugging tools with rapid iteration. It outputs optimized vertex buffers that can be rendered directly into any 3D pipeline, requiring zero external dependencies. Unlike retained-mode UI libraries, it is purpose-built for high-performance internal tools, visualizers, and debug windows.
en.content: The repository centers on core single-file headers (imgui.h / imgui.cpp) and ships with official renderer backends and platform bindings (DirectX, OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, GLFW, SDL, Win32, etc.). It also includes ready-to-run examples, a comprehensive demo window, extensive documentation, and a separate imgui_test_engine for automated testing.
en.stack: Written in pure C++ with zero external dependencies; integrates with modern graphics APIs via swappable backends for DirectX, OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, and WebGPU, alongside platform bindings for GLFW, SDL, and Win32.
en.hot: With 74.7K Stars and 338 new stars this month (ranking 13th on the monthly GitHub Trending), Dear ImGui is the de-facto standard for tooling UIs in C++. It is adopted by virtually every major game engine and 3D toolchain, filling a long-standing gap for high-performance immediate-mode debugging interfaces.
uses: Game/graphics engine developers — rapidly build level editors, material debuggers, and profiling dashboards for custom engines
Real-time visualization & monitoring — create live data dashboards for robotics, quant trading, and embedded systems
Desktop tool builders — craft lightweight, portable native UIs for C++ applications without heavy framework overhead
Algorithm & research debugging — visualize parameters and intermediate states during graphics, simulation, or AI training runs

zh.tag: ESP32 上的 WiFi/蓝牙攻防工具套件
zh.what: ESP32 Marauder 是一套运行在 ESP32 微控制器上的 WiFi 和蓝牙攻击与防御工具集。它提供了多种功能，如网络扫描、嗅探、攻击和检测，适用于安全研究和教育目的。该项目旨在将渗透测试能力带入低成本、便携的硬件平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含固件源码、预编译的发布版本、详细的 Wiki 文档以及用于构建和发布的 GitHub Actions 工作流。源码主要由 C++ 编写，并包含一些 Python 脚本用于辅助构建和测试。
zh.stack: 基于 ESP32 平台，使用 Arduino 框架或 ESP-IDF 进行开发。主要依赖 C++ 标准库和 ESP32 的 SDK，可能还涉及一些 Python 工具链用于自动化构建。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 11.8k 的星标，今日新增 16 星，位列 C++ 日榜第 18 名。其热度源于将复杂的网络安全工具集成到小巧、廉价的 ESP32 设备中，吸引了安全爱好者和硬件极客的关注。
uses: 安全研究人员：用于测试和验证 WiFi/蓝牙网络的安全性。
渗透测试人员：在便携设备上进行现场安全评估。
教育用途：学习无线网络攻击与防御的原理。
硬件爱好者：探索 ESP32 的潜力并参与开源项目。

en.tag: A suite of WiFi/Bluetooth offensive and defensive tools for the ESP32
en.what: ESP32 Marauder is a suite of WiFi and Bluetooth offensive and defensive tools that run on the ESP32 microcontroller. It provides various features such as network scanning, sniffing, attacking, and detection, suitable for security research and educational purposes. The project aims to bring penetration testing capabilities to a low-cost, portable hardware platform.
en.content: The repository contains firmware source code, precompiled release binaries, comprehensive Wiki documentation, and GitHub Actions workflows for building and publishing. The source is primarily written in C++ with some Python scripts for build and test assistance.
en.stack: Built on the ESP32 platform, developed using the Arduino framework or ESP-IDF. It relies on the C++ standard library and ESP32 SDK, and may involve some Python tooling for automated builds.
en.hot: The project has over 11.8k stars on GitHub, with 16 new stars today, ranking 18th on the C++ daily trending list. Its popularity stems from integrating complex network security tools into a small, inexpensive ESP32 device, attracting security enthusiasts and hardware geeks.
uses: Security researchers: for testing and validating the security of WiFi/Bluetooth networks.
Penetration testers: for on-site security assessments with a portable device.
Educational purposes: to learn the principles of wireless network attack and defense.
Hardware enthusiasts: to explore the potential of ESP32 and contribute to open source.

zh.tag: Linux 上的 Lossless Scaling 帧生成 Vulkan 层
zh.what: lsfg-vk 是一个 Vulkan 层，它挂钩 Vulkan 应用程序，使用 Lossless Scaling 的帧生成算法生成额外帧，从而在 Linux 上实现类似 Windows 的平滑插帧效果。它需要 Steam 上的 Lossless Scaling 软件，并提供图形界面进行配置。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Vulkan 层实现、图形配置界面（基于 Qt6/QML）、命令行工具，以及文档（如 Flatpak 指南、配置说明）。还提供了针对 Steam Deck 的 Decky 插件支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Vulkan API，图形界面基于 Qt6 和 Qt Quick（QML）。需要系统安装 Lossless Scaling（Steam 应用）。
zh.hot: 该项目填补了 Linux 上帧生成功能的空白，吸引了大量游戏玩家和 Linux 爱好者。4640 星表明社区需求旺盛，今日新增 6 星，在 C++ 趋势榜上排名第 19。
uses: Linux 游戏玩家：希望在 Linux 上使用帧生成提升游戏流畅度。
Steam Deck 用户：通过 Decky 插件轻松安装和配置。
开发者：对 Vulkan 层开发和帧生成技术感兴趣。

en.tag: Vulkan layer bringing Lossless Scaling frame generation to Linux
en.what: lsfg-vk is a Vulkan layer that hooks into Vulkan applications and generates additional frames using Lossless Scaling's frame generation algorithm, bringing similar frame interpolation to Linux. It requires the Lossless Scaling software on Steam and provides a GUI for configuration.
en.content: The repository contains the Vulkan layer implementation, a graphical configuration UI (Qt6/QML), command-line tools, and documentation (e.g., Flatpak guide, configuration details). It also offers a Decky plugin for Steam Deck.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging the Vulkan API, with a GUI based on Qt6 and Qt Quick (QML). Requires the Lossless Scaling Steam application.
en.hot: This project fills a gap for frame generation on Linux, attracting gamers and Linux enthusiasts. With 4640 stars, it shows strong community demand; today's +6 stars place it #19 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Linux gamers: want frame generation for smoother gameplay.
Steam Deck users: easy install via Decky plugin.
Developers: interested in Vulkan layer development and frame generation.

zh.tag: 开源多轨音频编辑与录音软件
zh.what: Audacity 是一款易于使用的多轨音频编辑器和录音软件，支持 Windows、macOS、GNU/Linux 等操作系统。它提供录音、编辑、混音、效果处理等功能，适用于播客、音乐制作、音频修复等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Audacity 的完整源代码，包括核心编辑功能、效果插件、导入导出模块以及即将推出的 Audacity 4 的全新 UI 和重构代码。当前 master 分支正在进行重大结构变更，同时维护 audacity3 分支以支持 3.x 版本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 wxWidgets 等跨平台库，并包含第三方库（如 lib-src）。构建系统支持 CMake，提供针对不同平台的构建说明。
zh.hot: 尽管今日新增 star 数不多，但作为长期流行的开源音频工具，其稳定的用户基础和即将发布的 Audacity 4 带来的重大更新持续吸引关注。
uses: 音频编辑爱好者：需要免费、跨平台的录音和编辑工具。
播客制作者：用于录制和后期处理播客节目。
音乐制作人：进行多轨混音和效果处理。
教育工作者：在教学中演示音频编辑和数字信号处理。

en.tag: Open-source multi-track audio editor and recorder
en.what: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows, macOS, GNU/Linux and other operating systems. It provides recording, editing, mixing, and effects processing, suitable for podcasts, music production, audio restoration, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of Audacity, including core editing features, effect plugins, import/export modules, and the upcoming Audacity 4 with a brand-new UI and refactorings. The master branch is undergoing major structural changes, while the audacity3 branch is maintained for 3.x versions.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on cross-platform libraries like wxWidgets, and includes third-party libraries (e.g., lib-src). The build system uses CMake, with build instructions for different platforms.
en.hot: Despite modest daily star gains, its long-standing popularity as an open-source audio tool and the upcoming Audacity 4 with major updates continue to attract attention.
uses: Audio editing enthusiasts: need a free, cross-platform tool for recording and editing.
Podcasters: for recording and post-processing podcast episodes.
Music producers: for multi-track mixing and effects processing.
Educators: to demonstrate audio editing and digital signal processing in teaching.

zh.tag: UE4/5 游戏注入式 Lua 脚本与调试工具集
zh.what: RE-UE4SS 是一个针对虚幻引擎 4/5 游戏的注入式 Lua 脚本系统，允许玩家和模组开发者编写 Lua 脚本或 C++ 模组来修改游戏行为。它还提供 SDK 生成器、蓝图模组加载器、实时属性查看/编辑器和多种转储工具，用于调试和逆向工程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档（docs.ue4ss.com）、示例模组和构建配置。核心组件包括 Lua 脚本 API、C++ 模组 API、蓝图加载器、实时属性编辑器、UHT 转储器、C++ 头文件生成器、USMap 转储器等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Unreal Engine 的反射系统，支持从 UE 4.12 到 5.7 版本。构建系统基于 CMake，并利用 Lua 作为脚本语言。
zh.hot: 作为 UE 模组开发的强大工具，持续吸引模组制作者和逆向工程师。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但累计 2783 星表明其稳定受欢迎，尤其在 C++ 相关项目中排名靠前。
uses: 游戏模组制作者：为 UE4/5 游戏编写 Lua 或 C++ 模组，无需修改游戏文件。
逆向工程师：使用转储工具和实时属性编辑器分析游戏内部结构。
游戏调试者：在运行时查看和修改对象属性，辅助调试和测试。

en.tag: Injectable Lua scripting, SDK generator, and live property editor for UE4/5 games
en.what: RE-UE4SS is an injectable Lua scripting system for Unreal Engine 4/5 games, enabling players and modders to write Lua scripts or C++ mods to alter game behavior. It also provides an SDK generator, blueprint mod loader, live property viewer/editor, and various dumping utilities for debugging and reverse engineering.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation (docs.ue4ss.com), example mods, and build configurations. Core components include Lua scripting API, C++ modding API, blueprint loader, live property editor, UHT dumper, C++ header generator, USMap dumper, and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging Unreal Engine's reflection system, supporting UE versions from 4.12 to 5.7. Build system uses CMake, with Lua as the scripting language.
en.hot: As a powerful tool for UE modding, it consistently attracts modders and reverse engineers. Despite modest daily stars, the cumulative 2783 stars indicate steady popularity, especially ranking high among C++ projects.
uses: Game modders: Write Lua or C++ mods for UE4/5 games without modifying game files.
Reverse engineers: Use dumping utilities and live property editor to analyze game internals.
Game debuggers: View and edit object properties at runtime for debugging and testing.

zh.tag: Azure 官方 C++ SDK，云端开发必备
zh.what: 这是 Azure 云服务的 C++ 开发工具包，提供身份认证、存储等服务的客户端库。开发者可以用它从 C++ 应用直接调用 Azure 服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个 C++ 库的源代码，如 azure-identity-cpp 和 azure-storage-blobs-cpp，以及构建配置、示例和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，支持 CMake 构建，使用 vcpkg 作为包管理器，兼容 Visual Studio 和 VS Code。
zh.hot: 虽然今日新增 star 为 0，但作为 Azure 官方 SDK，在 C++ 开发者中具有重要地位，长期稳定维护。
uses: C++ 开发者需要在应用中集成 Azure 服务（如存储、身份认证）
企业级项目需要稳定、官方支持的云 SDK
希望使用 CMake 和 vcpkg 管理依赖的跨平台开发团队

en.tag: Official Azure SDK for C++ for cloud development
en.what: This is the official Azure SDK for C++, providing client libraries for Azure services such as identity and storage. Developers can use it to call Azure services directly from C++ applications.
en.content: The repository contains source code for multiple C++ libraries, such as azure-identity-cpp and azure-storage-blobs-cpp, along with build configurations, samples, and documentation.
en.stack: Built with C++, supports CMake, uses vcpkg for package management, and is compatible with Visual Studio and VS Code.
en.hot: Although it gained 0 stars today, as the official Azure SDK it holds significant importance among C++ developers and is consistently maintained.
uses: C++ developers needing to integrate Azure services (e.g., storage, identity) into their apps
Enterprise projects requiring a stable, officially supported cloud SDK
Cross-platform teams using CMake and vcpkg for dependency management

zh.tag: 高颜值跨平台系统资源监控终端工具
zh.what: btop 是一款用 C++ 编写的系统资源监视器，在终端中提供 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络和进程的实时可视化。它支持 Linux、macOS 和多个 BSD 系统，并带有鼠标操作和自定义主题。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本、文档、主题文件以及跨平台 CI 配置。提供预编译二进制包和多种安装方式，如 snap 和包管理器。
zh.stack: 基于 C++23 开发，依赖 CMake 构建系统，并利用终端图形库（如 roff）实现界面。支持 Linux、macOS、FreeBSD、NetBSD、OpenBSD 等平台。
zh.hot: 凭借高颜值界面和丰富的功能，btop 已获得 33.9k 星标，成为终端监控工具的流行选择。今日新增 24 星，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 系统管理员和运维人员，用于实时监控服务器性能
开发者，在终端中快速查看资源占用和进程状态
喜欢自定义终端环境的用户，可定制主题和布局

en.tag: A beautiful cross-platform resource monitor for the terminal
en.what: btop is a system resource monitor written in C++, providing real-time visualization of CPU, memory, disks, network, and processes in the terminal. It supports Linux, macOS, and several BSDs, with mouse support and customizable themes.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, build scripts, documentation, theme files, and cross-platform CI configurations. Precompiled binaries and multiple installation methods are provided, including snap and package managers.
en.stack: Developed in C++23, built with CMake, and uses terminal graphics libraries (like roff) for the UI. Supports Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, NetBSD, OpenBSD, etc.
en.hot: With its beautiful interface and rich features, btop has gained 33.9k stars, becoming a popular choice for terminal monitoring tools. It gained 24 stars today, continuing to attract developer attention.
uses: System administrators and DevOps for real-time server performance monitoring
Developers who want quick resource and process overview in the terminal
Users who enjoy customizing terminal environments with themes and layouts

zh.tag: 极速 PDF 分类与文本提取的 Rust 库
zh.what: pdf-inspector 是一个用 Rust 编写的高性能 PDF 处理库，用于智能分类 PDF 类型（文本型、扫描型、图像型或混合型），并提取位置感知的文本、转换为干净的 Markdown。它无需 OCR 即可在 200ms 内处理文本型 PDF，帮助开发者避免不必要的 OCR 成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心库、Python/Node.js/WASM 绑定、CLI 工具，以及文档和基准测试。核心功能包括智能分类、文本提取、Markdown 转换、表格检测、CID 字体支持、多栏布局和编码问题检测。
zh.stack: 纯 Rust 实现，仅依赖 lopdf 进行 PDF 解析，无 ML 模型或外部服务。提供 Python、Node.js 和浏览器 WebAssembly 绑定。
zh.hot: 本周新增 8641 星，总星数达 13871，登上 GitHub 趋势榜第一。其速度极快（200 文档仅 0.47 秒），在基准测试中全面超越其他本地引擎，且无需 OCR，大幅节省成本。
uses: 开发者：在应用中快速判断 PDF 类型，决定是否走 OCR 流程，优化成本与速度。
数据管道：批量处理 PDF 文档，提取文本和结构，用于 RAG、搜索或分析。
浏览器应用：通过 WASM 在客户端本地解析 PDF，无需上传服务器。
需要高质量 Markdown 转换的场景，如文档转换工具或知识库构建。

en.tag: Fast Rust library for PDF classification and text extraction
en.what: pdf-inspector is a high-performance Rust library for PDF processing, intelligently classifying PDFs (text-based, scanned, image-based, or mixed) and extracting position-aware text with Markdown conversion. It handles text-based PDFs locally in under 200ms without OCR, helping developers avoid unnecessary OCR costs.
en.content: The repository includes the core Rust library, bindings for Python/Node.js/WASM, a CLI tool, plus documentation and benchmarks. Key features include smart classification, text extraction, Markdown conversion, table detection, CID font support, multi-column layout, and encoding issue detection.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation with a single dependency on lopdf for PDF parsing, no ML models or external services. Bindings are provided for Python, Node.js, and browser WebAssembly.
en.hot: With 8,641 new stars this week (total 13,871) and #1 on GitHub Trending, it's fast (0.47s for 200 docs) and outperforms other local engines in benchmarks, all without OCR, saving significant costs.
uses: Developers: quickly classify PDFs to decide whether OCR is needed, optimizing cost and speed.
Data pipelines: batch process PDFs to extract text and structure for RAG, search, or analytics.
Browser apps: use WASM to parse PDFs locally on the client, no server round trip.

zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，但内容以 Markdown 文档为主，辅以图表（如 PNG 图片）和代码片段。依赖 Anki 用于闪卡学习。
zh.hot: 作为系统设计面试的经典资源，star 数高达 36 万，今日新增 733，长期占据 GitHub 趋势榜。其全面性和实用性使其成为工程师的必备参考。
uses: 准备系统设计面试的求职者 — 提供常见问题和解决方案，助你高效备考。
希望提升系统架构能力的工程师 — 系统学习大规模系统设计原则。
技术面试官 — 参考其中问题与答案，设计面试题目。
计算机科学学生 — 作为系统设计课程的补充教材。

en.tag: One-stop guide for system design interviews and large-scale system learning
en.what: A comprehensive resource for learning system design and preparing for interviews, covering principles, case studies, and interview questions. It offers a structured learning path to help engineers master building scalable systems, with Anki flashcards for memorization.
en.content: The repo contains detailed notes on system design fundamentals, scalability, availability, consistency, etc., along with common interview questions and solutions with diagrams and code examples. It also offers multi-language translations and Anki flashcards.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, but content is mostly Markdown documents, supplemented with diagrams (e.g., PNG images) and code snippets. Uses Anki for flashcards.
en.hot: As a classic resource for system design interviews, it has 362k stars, with 733 new today, consistently trending on GitHub. Its comprehensiveness and practicality make it a must-have reference for engineers.
uses: Job seekers preparing for system design interviews — provides common questions and solutions for efficient preparation.
Engineers looking to improve system architecture skills — systematically learn large-scale system design principles.
Technical interviewers — reference questions and answers to design interview problems.
Computer science students — as supplementary material for system design courses.

zh.tag: 自我进化的通用 AI 代理，跨任务持续记忆
zh.what: Ouroboros 是一个开源的通用 AI 代理，其身份、持久记忆和历史在任务和重启之间保持连续。它能在外部项目上工作，协调实时专家代理群，并能重写自身运行的实现，包括代码、架构、提示、工具和依赖。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 源码、桌面应用（macOS/Linux/Windows）和 CLI 工具，以及安装脚本和文档。运行时将仓库、持久记忆、历史和界面保留在本地，模型推理可通过远程 API 或本地 GGUF 模型。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，支持 macOS 12+、Linux x86_64 和 Windows x64。依赖远程模型 API（如 OpenAI）或本地 GGUF 模型，并集成了 OuroborosHub 技能市场。
zh.hot: 本周新增 156 星，总星数 1013，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Python）第 16 名。其自我改写和持续记忆的能力引发了广泛关注，被视为 AI 代理领域的前沿探索。
uses: AI 研究者与开发者：探索自我进化和持续学习的代理架构
自动化任务执行：在外部项目上运行复杂任务，协调多个专家代理
个人助理：作为桌面应用，管理长期记忆和历史，跨会话保持上下文
技术爱好者：体验前沿 AI 代理，参与开源社区贡献

en.tag: Self-evolving general-purpose AI agent with persistent memory across tasks
en.what: Ouroboros is an open-source, general-purpose AI agent whose identity, durable memory, and history persist across tasks and restarts. It works on external projects, coordinates a live swarm of specialist agents, and can rewrite the implementation it runs on, including its code, architecture, prompts, tools, and dependencies.
en.content: The repository contains Python source code, desktop apps (macOS/Linux/Windows) and CLI tools, along with installation scripts and docs. The runtime keeps its repository, durable memory, history, and interface on your machine, while model inference can use remote APIs or a local GGUF model.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+, supports macOS 12+, Linux x86_64, and Windows x64. Relies on remote model APIs (e.g., OpenAI) or local GGUF models, and integrates with OuroborosHub skills marketplace.
en.hot: Gained 156 stars this week, reaching 1013 total, and ranked #16 on GitHub Trending (Python). Its self-rewriting and persistent memory capabilities have attracted significant attention, seen as a frontier exploration in AI agents.
uses: AI researchers and developers: explore self-evolving and continuously learning agent architectures
Automated task execution: run complex tasks on external projects, coordinating multiple specialist agents
Personal assistant: as a desktop app, manage long-term memory and history, maintaining context across sessions
Tech enthusiasts: experience cutting-edge AI agents and contribute to the open-source community

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理优化的 Android 开发技能库
zh.what: 这是一个专门为 AI 代理（如 Gemini、Antigravity）设计的 Android 开发技能库，包含模块化的指令和资源，帮助代理遵循 Android 最佳实践。它聚焦于 LLM 表现不佳的领域，通过 SKILL.md 文件为代理提供技术规范和领域知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能模块（如 r8-analyzer），每个技能由 markdown 文件（SKILL.md）组成，描述任务的技术规范。还提供了 Android CLI 工具，用于安装和管理这些技能到代理目录。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Python，基于开放标准 agent skills（markdown 格式），依赖 Android CLI 和开发者工具。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程助手普及，开发者需要标准化技能库提升代理的 Android 开发能力，该项目由 Google 官方支持，star 数快速增长（6.6k+），今日新增 47，登上日榜。
uses: Android 开发者：使用 AI 代理辅助开发时，安装技能以提升代码质量
AI 代理工具链开发者：参考技能格式和实现，构建类似技能库
技术团队：在 CI/CD 中集成代理，利用技能自动化 Android 开发任务

en.tag: AI-optimized modular skills for Android development agents
en.what: This is a repository of AI-optimized, modular skills for Android development agents (like Gemini, Antigravity), containing instructions and resources to help agents follow best practices. It focuses on areas where LLMs underperform, providing technical specs and domain knowledge via SKILL.md files.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill modules (e.g., r8-analyzer), each consisting of markdown files (SKILL.md) that specify tasks. It also includes an Android CLI tool to install and manage skills into agent directories.
en.stack: Primarily Python, based on the open-standard agent skills (markdown format), with Android CLI and developer tools as dependencies.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding assistants, developers need standardized skill libraries to enhance agents' Android development capabilities. Backed by Google, the project's stars are growing fast (6.6k+), with 47 new today, hitting the daily trending list.
uses: Android developers: install skills to improve code quality when using AI agents
AI agent toolchain developers: reference the skill format and implementation to build similar libraries
Tech teams: integrate agents into CI/CD to automate Android development tasks with skills

zh.tag: 将 Claude Code 升级为结构化开发平台的配置框架
zh.what: SuperClaude 是一个元编程配置框架，通过 30 个斜杠命令、20 个专业 AI 代理、7 种行为模式和 8 个 MCP 服务器，增强 Claude Code 的功能。它覆盖从头脑风暴到部署的完整开发生命周期，提供认知角色和开发方法论。

uses: Claude Code 用户希望增强开发流程，获得专业命令和认知角色。
团队希望标准化 AI 辅助开发，采用结构化方法论和模式。
开发者探索 MCP 服务器集成，扩展 AI 工具链。

en.tag: A config framework turning Claude Code into a structured dev platform
en.what: SuperClaude is a meta-programming configuration framework that enhances Claude Code with 30 slash commands, 20 specialized AI agents, 7 behavioral modes, and 8 MCP servers. It covers the full development lifecycle from brainstorming to deployment, offering cognitive personas and development methodologies.
en.content: The repo contains the framework's Python package (on PyPI), an npm package, documentation (multi-language READMEs), test workflows, and skill definitions for Smithery integration.
en.stack: Built on Python as a configuration layer for Claude Code, leveraging its extension mechanisms; also provides an npm package and supports installation via Smithery.
en.hot: With 23.8k stars and 214 new this week, it's popular for turning Claude Code into a structured dev platform, featured in Awesome Claude Code, and spawning SuperGemini and SuperQwen frameworks.
uses: Claude Code users wanting to enhance their dev workflow with specialized commands and cognitive personas.
Teams seeking to standardize AI-assisted development with structured methodologies and modes.
Developers exploring MCP server integrations to extend their AI toolchain.

zh.tag: 为长期运行的 AI 代理团队打造的轻量级循环工程状态内核
zh.what: LoopX 是一个本地优先的控制平面，用于管理长期运行的 AI 代理工作。它保持目标、门禁、待办事项、证据、配额和交接的稳定，而 Codex、Claude Code 等代理执行有界回合。它不替代代理运行时，而是提供可审查、可重启、易于交接的循环工程。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心状态内核、控制平面看板、文档（包括概念入门、产品发布就绪度）、示例循环、以及 Python 包（pyproject.toml）。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Python（3.11+），依赖包括用于状态管理的库，可能涉及异步处理，但具体依赖未列出。
zh.hot: 今日新增 847 星，总星数 2944，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6 名。它解决了 AI 代理长期运行中的关键痛点，如目标漂移、证据过期和交接困难，因此受到关注。
uses: 开发者和团队使用 Codex、Claude Code 等编码代理进行长期项目，需要管理目标和进度。
需要将多个代理的工作进行交接和协作的团队。
对代理工作流进行监控、复盘和持续改进的工程管理者。
希望在不更换代理运行时的情况下，增加控制层和可审计性的用户。

en.tag: Lightweight loop engineering state kernel for long-running AI agent teams
en.what: LoopX is a local-first control plane for managing long-running AI agent work. It keeps objectives, gates, todos, evidence, quota, and handoffs stable while agents like Codex or Claude Code execute bounded turns. It doesn't replace agent runtimes but provides reviewable, restartable, and handoff-friendly loop engineering.
en.content: The repo includes the core state kernel, control-plane board, docs (concept primer, release readiness), example loops, and a Python package (pyproject.toml).
en.stack: Primary language is Python (3.11+), with dependencies for state management, possibly async, but specifics not listed.
en.hot: Gained 847 stars today, total 2944, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending daily. It addresses critical pain points in long-running AI agent work like objective drift, stale evidence, and handoff difficulties, driving its popularity.
uses: Developers and teams using coding agents like Codex or Claude Code for long-running projects needing goal and progress management.
Teams that need to hand off work between multiple agents or peers.
Engineering managers who want to monitor, review, and continuously improve agent workflows.
Users who want to add a control layer and auditability without replacing their agent runtime.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的开源图原生上下文与决策基础设施
zh.what: Semantica 是一个图原生的基础设施，用于构建上下文感知且可问责的 AI 系统。它能够摄取企业数据，提取关键信息，构建上下文图与知识图谱，并支持图分析和因果推理，同时内置完整的决策溯源。该系统强调可解释、可追踪和可信赖，专为高风险和受监管领域设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 库、CLI 工具、文档和示例，支持多语言图存储（RDF 和 LPG），遵循 W3C 标准，提供本体管理和知识建模功能。项目采用模块化设计，便于自托管和审计。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python（3.8+），依赖图数据库和知识图谱技术，支持 RDF 和 LPG 存储，遵循 W3C 标准。可能涉及因果推理和决策智能相关库。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1102 星，总星数达 3323，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Python）第 13 名。其定位为“AI 代理的开源 Palantir”，填补了企业级上下文管理和决策溯源的需求，在 AI 信任与合规领域引发关注。
uses: 企业 AI 团队：需要为代理系统构建可解释、可审计的上下文管理平台。
受监管行业（金融、医疗）：要求决策可追溯、符合合规要求。
知识图谱开发者：希望利用图原生基础设施进行知识建模和因果推理。
AI 研究者：探索上下文感知和可问责 AI 系统的实现。

en.tag: Open-source graph-native infrastructure for context and accountable AI systems
en.what: Semantica is a graph-native infrastructure for building context-aware and accountable AI systems. It ingests enterprise data, extracts what matters, builds a Context Graph and knowledge graph, and runs graph analytics and causal reasoning with full decision provenance. It is explainable, traceable, and trustworthy by design, built for high-stakes, regulated domains.
en.content: The repository contains the core Python library, CLI tools, documentation, and examples. It supports polyglot graph storage (RDF and LPG), adheres to W3C standards, and offers ontology management and knowledge modeling. The project is modular, self-hostable, and auditable.
en.stack: Primarily Python (3.8+), leveraging graph database and knowledge graph technologies, supporting RDF and LPG storage, and adhering to W3C standards. It likely incorporates libraries for causal reasoning and decision intelligence.
en.hot: Gained 1,102 stars this week, reaching 3,323 total, ranking #13 on GitHub Trending (Python) weekly. Positioned as 'The Open Source Palantir for AI Agents', it addresses enterprise context management and decision provenance, sparking interest in AI trust and compliance.
uses: Enterprise AI teams: needing an explainable, auditable context management platform for agent systems.
Regulated industries (finance, healthcare): requiring traceable decisions and compliance.
Knowledge graph developers: leveraging graph-native infrastructure for knowledge modeling and causal reasoning.
AI researchers: exploring implementations of context-aware and accountable AI systems.

en.tag: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet, zero API fees

zh.tag: OSINT 用户名/邮箱搜索与 AI 画像工具

zh.hot: 本周新增 238 星，总星数达 7456，因其强大的 OSINT 功能和免费 AI 画像而受到关注。

渗透测试人员：在授权测试中收集目标信息。
隐私爱好者：检查自己的在线暴露情况。

en.what: Blackbird is a powerful OSINT tool that enables fast username and email searches across more than 600 platforms, with free AI-powered profiling. It integrates the WhatsMyName project to ensure low false positives and high-quality results.
en.content: The repository contains a Python script blackbird.py with a CLI, supporting username/email search and PDF/CSV export. It also includes AI integration for profiling, setup docs, and examples.
