Penetration testers: to gather intel during authorized tests.
Privacy enthusiasts: to check their own online exposure.

zh.tag: 专业级 Stable Diffusion 创意引擎与 WebUI
zh.what: InvokeAI 是一个面向 Stable Diffusion 模型的专业创意引擎，提供行业领先的 WebUI，支持图像生成、编辑和迭代。它被多个商业产品作为基础，适合专业人士和爱好者使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Web 服务器与 React UI、统一画布（支持内外绘、笔刷等）、节点式工作流管理、图库与画廊管理等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建后端，前端采用 React，依赖 Stable Diffusion 模型及 AI 生成技术。
zh.hot: 拥有 27.8k 星标，本周新增 84，因其专业级功能和商用友好许可而广受欢迎，成为 AI 绘画工具中的热门选择。
uses: 艺术家和设计师：使用统一画布进行 AI 辅助创作和图像编辑
开发者：通过节点式工作流构建自定义生成管线
商业团队：作为商业产品的 AI 生成基础引擎

en.tag: Professional creative engine & WebUI for Stable Diffusion
en.what: InvokeAI is a leading creative engine for Stable Diffusion models, offering an industry-leading WebUI for generating, editing, and iterating on images. It serves as the foundation for multiple commercial products, empowering professionals and enthusiasts.
en.content: The repository includes a locally hosted web server & React UI, Unified Canvas with in/out-painting and brush tools, node-based workflow management, and board/gallery management.
en.stack: Backend primarily in Python, frontend in React, leveraging Stable Diffusion models and AI generation technologies.
en.hot: With 27.8k stars and 84 added this week, it's popular for its professional features and commercially-friendly license, making it a top choice among AI art tools.
uses: Artists and designers: use Unified Canvas for AI-assisted creation and image editing
Developers: build custom generation pipelines via node-based workflows
Commercial teams: leverage as a foundation for AI generation in commercial products

zh.tag: 实用优先的 CSS 框架，快速构建自定义 UI
zh.what: Tailwind CSS 是一个实用优先的 CSS 框架，提供大量低级工具类，让你无需离开 HTML 即可快速构建现代界面。它通过组合工具类来设计样式，避免了传统 CSS 的上下文切换，并支持响应式、状态变体等特性。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架核心源码、文档、示例以及用于构建和测试的配置。主要目录包括 src（核心实现）、tests（测试）、以及用于生成文档和发布包的脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 环境，使用 PostCSS 作为插件集成，并支持多种构建工具。
zh.hot: Tailwind CSS 因其高效的工作流程和庞大的社区而广受欢迎，本周新增近千 star，总 star 数接近 10 万，稳居 TypeScript 周榜前列。
uses: 前端开发者：快速搭建响应式界面，减少自定义 CSS 编写
团队协作：统一设计规范，通过配置定制设计系统
原型设计：快速迭代 UI 概念，无需编写复杂样式

en.tag: A utility-first CSS framework for rapidly building custom user interfaces.
en.what: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework that provides low-level utility classes to rapidly build modern interfaces without leaving your HTML. It encourages styling by composing utilities, avoiding context switching, and supports responsive and state variants.
en.content: The repository contains the framework's core source code, documentation, examples, and build/test configurations. Key directories include src (core implementation), tests, and scripts for docs generation and package publishing.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, requires Node.js, integrates as a PostCSS plugin, and supports various build tools.
en.hot: Tailwind CSS is popular for its efficient workflow and large community, gaining nearly 1,000 stars this week and approaching 100k total stars, ranking high on the TypeScript weekly trending list.
uses: Frontend developers: rapidly build responsive interfaces with less custom CSS
Teams: unify design standards and customize design systems via config
Prototyping: quickly iterate UI concepts without complex styling

zh.tag: 无头表格构建库，多框架支持
zh.what: TanStack Table 是一个无头 UI 库，用于构建功能强大的表格和数据网格。它提供框架无关的核心，并支持 React、Vue、Solid、Svelte 等多个框架的适配器，让开发者完全控制标记、样式和行为。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库以及各框架的适配器（如 @tanstack/react-table），提供排序、过滤、分组、聚合、行选择等功能，并支持虚拟化与服务器端渲染。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，框架无关，核心逻辑与各框架适配器分离。
zh.hot: 凭借其灵活的无头设计和对多框架的支持，TanStack Table 成为构建复杂表格的首选库，拥有 28k+ stars，持续受到开发者青睐。
uses: 需要高度定制表格 UI 的 React/Vue/Solid 开发者
构建数据密集型应用（如管理后台、报表工具）的团队
希望在不牺牲性能的前提下实现复杂表格功能的开发者

en.tag: Headless UI for powerful tables & datagrids across frameworks
en.what: TanStack Table is a headless UI library for building powerful tables and datagrids. It provides a framework-agnostic core with adapters for React, Vue, Solid, Svelte, and more, giving developers full control over markup, styles, and behavior.
en.content: The repo contains the core library and framework adapters (e.g., @tanstack/react-table), offering sorting, filtering, grouping, aggregation, row selection, and support for virtualization and server-side rendering.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, framework-agnostic, with core logic separated from framework adapters.
en.hot: With its flexible headless design and multi-framework support, TanStack Table is a go-to library for complex tables, boasting 28k+ stars and continuous developer adoption.
uses: Developers needing highly customizable table UI in React/Vue/Solid
Teams building data-intensive apps like admin dashboards and reporting tools
Developers who want complex table features without sacrificing performance

zh.tag: AI 工作流共享与跨代理协作的开源桌面应用
zh.what: OpenWork 是一款免费开源的桌面应用，旨在共享 AI 工作流。它是 Claude Cowork 和 Codex 的开源替代品，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。用户可以通过 MCP 集成到 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等代理中，复用技能、MCP 和连接服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码、MCP 集成指南、OpenWork Den 组织管理后台文档，以及安装脚本和配置文件。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 MCP 协议与远程 API，支持与多种 AI 代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor）集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Claude Cowork 的开源替代，填补了 AI 工作流共享的空白，17k+ Stars 表明社区对跨代理协作工具的强烈需求。
uses: AI 开发者 —— 在不同代理间复用技能和 MCP，提升效率
团队协作 —— 通过 OpenWork Den 管理组织内的工作流和权限
个人用户 —— 创建并分享 AI 工作流，或本地使用桌面应用

en.tag: Open-source desktop app for sharing AI workflows and cross-agent collaboration
en.what: OpenWork is a free, open-source desktop app for sharing AI workflows. It serves as an open-source alternative to Claude Cowork and Codex for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Users can integrate it via MCP into agents like Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, etc., reusing skills, MCPs, and connected services.
en.content: The repo includes the desktop app source code, MCP integration guides, OpenWork Den organization admin documentation, and installation scripts/config files.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on MCP protocol and remote API, integrates with various AI agents like Claude Code and Cursor.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Claude Cowork, it fills the gap in AI workflow sharing. 17k+ Stars indicate strong community demand for cross-agent collaboration tools.
uses: AI developers — reuse skills and MCPs across different agents for efficiency
Team collaboration — manage workflows and permissions via OpenWork Den
Individual users — create and share AI workflows, or use the desktop app locally

zh.tag: 渐进式 JavaScript 前端框架，构建现代 Web 界面
zh.what: Vue.js 是一个渐进式、可增量采用的 JavaScript 框架，用于构建用户界面。它采用基于组件的架构，提供响应式数据绑定和组合式 API，使开发者能够高效地构建单页应用和复杂前端。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Vue 3 的核心源码，包括编译器、运行时、响应式系统、SSR 等模块，以及测试、构建配置和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 esbuild、rollup 等构建工具，支持浏览器和 Node.js 环境。
zh.hot: Vue 是长期热门的框架，本周新增 110 星，总星数超 5.4 万，持续吸引开发者关注，因其易用性和高性能而广受欢迎。
uses: 前端开发者：构建响应式单页应用和复杂交互界面
团队：快速搭建可维护的大型项目，利用组合式 API 组织代码
学习者：作为入门现代前端框架的首选，文档友好

en.tag: Progressive JavaScript framework for building modern web UIs
en.what: Vue.js is a progressive, incrementally-adoptable JavaScript framework for building user interfaces. It features a component-based architecture with reactive data binding and the Composition API, enabling developers to efficiently build single-page applications and complex frontends.
en.content: The repository contains the core source code of Vue 3, including the compiler, runtime, reactivity system, SSR, along with tests, build configs, and documentation.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, using build tools like esbuild and rollup, supporting both browser and Node.js environments.
en.hot: Vue remains a long-time popular framework, gaining 110 stars this week with over 54k total, continuously attracting developers due to its ease of use and high performance.
uses: Frontend developers: build reactive SPAs and complex interactive UIs
Teams: quickly scaffold maintainable large projects with Composition API
Learners: first choice for learning modern frameworks with friendly docs

zh.tag: 终端里的开源 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Qwen Code 是一个开源的 AI 编程代理，直接在终端中运行，提供交互式 UI 和代理功能。它支持自动记忆、自动技能、子代理、代理团队和 MCP，无需配置即可动态工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的核心框架，提供 CLI 工具、交互式终端 UI、IDE 插件、桌面应用、守护进程模式、SDK 以及 IM 机器人（Telegram/DingTalk/WeChat/Feishu）。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js（>=22），支持多种 API 协议（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Qwen），可接入第三方或本地模型（Ollama/vLLM）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 389 星，总星数达 26.9k，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 8 名。其开箱即用的代理特性和多协议支持吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接使用 AI 编程代理，无需离开命令行。
团队需要支持多种模型提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Qwen）的灵活工具。
希望利用 MCP 和子代理构建复杂自动化工作流的用户。
对开源、可定制、无供应商锁定的 AI 工具感兴趣的人。

en.tag: Open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal
en.what: Qwen Code is an open-source AI coding agent that runs in your terminal, offering an interactive UI and agentic capabilities. It features auto-memory, auto-skills, subagents, agent teams, and MCP, enabling dynamic workflows with zero setup.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based core framework, providing a CLI tool, interactive terminal UI, IDE plugins, desktop app, daemon mode, SDKs, and IM bots (Telegram/DingTalk/WeChat/Feishu).
en.stack: Built on Node.js (>=22), supports multiple API protocols (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen), and can integrate third-party or local models (Ollama/vLLM).
en.hot: Gained 389 stars this week, reaching 26.9k total, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) this week. Its out-of-the-box agentic features and multi-protocol support attract many developers.
uses: Developers who want an AI coding agent directly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Teams needing a flexible tool that supports multiple model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen).
Users who want to build complex automated workflows with MCP and subagents.
Those interested in open-source, customizable, vendor-lock-in-free AI tools.

zh.tag: AI 生产力工作室，智能对话与自主代理
zh.what: Cherry Studio 是一个 AI 生产力套件，提供智能对话、自主代理和超过 300 个预设助手。它统一接入前沿大语言模型，让用户在一个应用中完成多种 AI 任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码（基于 Electron）、构建图标、多语言文档和开发指南。核心功能包括智能聊天、代理执行和助手市场。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Electron 构建跨平台桌面应用。依赖现代前端框架和 AI 模型 API 集成。
zh.hot: 近 5 万星标，今日新增 328，因提供一站式 AI 工具和丰富助手而受欢迎。
uses: 需要统一管理多个 AI 模型的个人用户
希望使用预设助手提高工作效率的职场人士
对自主代理和自动化感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants
en.what: Cherry Studio is an AI productivity suite offering smart chat, autonomous agents, and over 300 preset assistants. It unifies access to frontier LLMs, enabling users to handle various AI tasks in one app.
en.content: The repo contains desktop app source (Electron-based), build icons, multilingual docs, and dev guides. Core features include smart chat, agent execution, and assistant marketplace.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on Electron for cross-platform desktop. Uses modern frontend frameworks and AI model API integrations.
en.hot: Nearly 50k stars with 328 added today, popular for its all-in-one AI toolkit and extensive assistant library.
uses: Individuals who want to manage multiple AI models in one place
Professionals seeking productivity gains via preset assistants
Tech enthusiasts interested in autonomous agents and automation

zh.tag: AI 工程基础框架，让 AI 代理直接生成生产级业务应用
zh.what: Open Mercato 是一个开源基础框架，旨在解决 AI 代码助手只生成代码但不知道代码放哪、如何分层的问题。它提供架构感知的 AI 工具链，让 Cursor、Claude Code 等代理能自主完成从添加数据表到实现完整功能的任务，并内置 CRM/ERP 等企业级模块，让开发者从 80% 完成度开始。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Next.js 应用（apps/mercato）、AI 技能与规范（specs）、领域模块（CRM、销售、订单等）、文档与示例，以及用于代码审查、工单流程和调试的协作工具。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 Next.js，采用规范优先开发，集成 AI 代理工具链（Cursor、Claude Code、Codex），并包含多租户、RBAC、事件流等架构决策。
zh.hot: 本周新增 52 星，登上 TypeScript 周榜第 11 名。它切中 AI 编程的痛点——AI 生成代码但缺乏架构一致性，提供开箱即用的企业级模块，让团队能快速用 AI 交付生产级应用。
uses: CTO/技术负责人：已部署 Cursor/Copilot 但发现不够用，希望让整个团队进入 AI 辅助开发。
开发者：想快速构建专业业务应用和后端，避免重复造轮子。
创业公司：需要 CRM/ERP 等企业级功能，但不想从零开始。
AI 工具链集成者：希望为 AI 代理提供架构感知的代码生成环境。

en.tag: AI-Engineering Foundation Framework for production-grade apps with AI agents
en.what: Open Mercato is an open-source foundation framework that solves the problem of AI code assistants generating code without knowing where to place it or how to layer it. It provides an architecture-aware AI harness, enabling agents like Cursor and Claude Code to autonomously handle tasks from adding data tables to implementing full features, with built-in CRM/ERP modules so developers start at 80% done.
en.content: The repo includes a Next.js app (apps/mercato), AI skills and specs, domain modules (CRM, sales, OMS, etc.), documentation and examples, plus collaboration tools for code review, ticketing, and debugging.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Next.js, spec-first development, integrated with AI agent toolchains (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex), and includes architectural decisions like multi-tenancy, RBAC, and event flow.
en.hot: Gained 52 stars this week, ranking #11 on the TypeScript weekly trending. It addresses the pain point of AI coding—generated code lacks architectural consistency—by offering ready-made enterprise modules, enabling teams to ship production apps fast with AI.
uses: CTOs/tech leads: already deployed Cursor/Copilot but found it insufficient, want to onboard the whole team to AI-assisted dev.
Developers: want to build professional business apps and backends quickly without reinventing the wheel.
Startups: need enterprise features like CRM/ERP but don't want to start from scratch.
AI toolchain integrators: want an architecture-aware code generation environment for AI agents.

zh.tag: 企业级 React UI 组件库与设计语言
zh.what: Ant Design 是一套面向企业级应用的设计语言和 React UI 组件库，提供丰富的可复用组件和一致的设计规范，帮助开发者快速构建高质量的中后台产品。它包含设计原则、组件、图标、主题等，支持现代浏览器和 React 生态。
zh.content: 仓库包含组件源码、设计规范文档、示例、主题配置、图标库、工具链（如 dumi 文档站点）以及完整的国际化支持。
zh.stack: 基于 React 和 TypeScript 构建，使用 Less 进行样式管理，支持 CSS-in-JS 方案，并依赖 @ant-design/icons 等内部包。
zh.hot: 作为 React 生态中最流行的 UI 库之一，拥有近 10 万星标，持续维护和更新，本周新增 134 星，长期占据 GitHub 趋势榜，是企业级应用开发的首选。
uses: 中后台管理系统的前端开发者，需要快速搭建界面
设计系统团队，需要参考企业级设计规范
React 开发者，寻求高质量、可定制的 UI 组件
需要国际化支持的多语言应用开发场景

en.tag: Enterprise-class React UI library and design language
en.what: Ant Design is an enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library, offering a rich set of reusable components and consistent design guidelines to help developers build high-quality admin and dashboard products quickly. It includes design principles, components, icons, theming, and supports modern browsers and the React ecosystem.
en.content: The repository contains component source code, design specification docs, examples, theme configuration, icon library, tooling (e.g., dumi documentation site), and full internationalization support.
en.stack: Built with React and TypeScript, uses Less for styling, supports CSS-in-JS solutions, and depends on internal packages like @ant-design/icons.
en.hot: As one of the most popular UI libraries in the React ecosystem, it has nearly 100k stars, is continuously maintained and updated, gained 134 stars this week, and consistently ranks on GitHub Trending, making it the go-to choice for enterprise app development.
uses: Frontend developers building admin dashboards and enterprise applications
Design system teams looking for enterprise-grade design guidelines
React developers seeking high-quality, customizable UI components
Projects requiring internationalization and multi-language support

zh.tag: 为浏览器中运行的一切提供快速、简单、可靠的测试
zh.what: Cypress 是一个现代化的前端端到端测试框架，旨在解决开发者在编写和运行浏览器测试时遇到的痛点。它提供了独特的交互式测试运行器、自动等待、实时重载等功能，让测试变得快速、简单且可靠。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cypress 的核心源码，包括命令行工具、测试运行器、Dashboard 服务集成等，以及文档、示例和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，基于 Node.js，依赖 npm/yarn/pnpm 进行包管理，并集成 CircleCI 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: Cypress 因其开发者体验和可靠性而广受欢迎，本周新增 297 星，总星数超过 5 万，稳居 TypeScript 周榜前列。
uses: 前端开发者：编写端到端测试，确保应用在真实浏览器中正常工作
QA 工程师：自动化回归测试，提升测试效率
团队协作：通过 Cypress Cloud 共享测试结果，监控测试状态
学习测试框架：作为现代测试工具的参考实现

en.tag: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser
en.what: Cypress is a modern front-end end-to-end testing framework designed to solve the pain points developers face when writing and running browser tests. It offers a unique interactive test runner, automatic waiting, real-time reloads, and more, making testing fast, easy, and reliable.
en.content: The repository contains the core source code of Cypress, including the CLI, test runner, Dashboard service integration, as well as documentation, examples, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, built on Node.js, with package management via npm/yarn/pnpm, and integrated with CircleCI for continuous integration.
en.hot: Cypress is popular for its developer experience and reliability, gaining 297 stars this week with over 50k total stars, consistently ranking high on the TypeScript weekly trending list.
uses: Frontend developers: write end-to-end tests to ensure apps work in real browsers
QA engineers: automate regression testing to improve efficiency
Team collaboration: share test results and monitor test status via Cypress Cloud
Learning testing frameworks: as a reference implementation of modern testing tools

zh.tag: 一条命令创建现代 React 应用，现已弃用
zh.what: Create React App 是一个官方工具，用于快速搭建 React 项目，无需手动配置构建工具。它隐藏了 webpack 和 Babel 等复杂配置，让开发者专注于代码。目前已被官方标记为弃用，建议迁移到其他 React 框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具、模板、文档和示例，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。通过 npx create-react-app my-app 即可创建新应用。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js，使用 webpack、Babel 等构建工具，并内置 ESLint 等开发依赖。
zh.hot: 尽管已弃用，但作为 React 生态的经典工具，仍拥有超过 10 万 star，本周新增 31 个，说明其历史影响力和用户基础依然庞大。
uses: 学习 React 的初学者，可通过教程快速上手
需要维护旧项目的开发者，了解其配置
对 React 工具链历史感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: One command to set up a modern React app, now deprecated
en.what: Create React App is an official tool to quickly scaffold a React project without manual build configuration. It hides complex setups like webpack and Babel, allowing developers to focus on code. It is now deprecated, and migration to other React frameworks is recommended.
en.content: The repository includes the CLI tool, templates, documentation, and examples, supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux. Create a new app with npx create-react-app my-app.
en.stack: Built on Node.js, uses webpack, Babel, and includes ESLint for development.
en.hot: Despite being deprecated, it remains a classic tool in the React ecosystem with over 100k stars, gaining 31 this week, reflecting its historical impact and large user base.
uses: Beginners learning React, following tutorials
Developers maintaining legacy projects, understanding its config
Tech enthusiasts interested in React tooling history

zh.tag: 人生进阶与英语学习开放指南
zh.what: 这是一份从英语学习出发，写给普通人持续成长、重新掌握人生主动权的开放指南。它涵盖了英语学习系统、AI学习方法以及人生复盘样本，帮助用户建立长期训练系统。

zh.hot: GSAP 是业界领先的动画库，被超过 1200 万个网站使用，本周新增 251 颗星，总星数达 27533，持续受到开发者青睐。
uses: 前端开发者：为网页添加流畅、高性能的动画效果
交互设计师：创建滚动触发动画、交互式原型
React/Vue 开发者：通过框架集成实现组件动画
广告/营销团队：制作吸引眼球的横幅和落地页动画

en.tag: High-performance, framework-agnostic JavaScript animation library
en.what: GSAP is a powerful JavaScript animation library that lets developers create high-performance animations easily, supporting CSS, SVG, Canvas, React, Vue, WebGL, and almost anything JavaScript can touch. It offers plugins like ScrollTrigger and MorphSVG for scroll animations, morphing, text splitting, and more.
en.content: The repository includes the GSAP core library, numerous optional plugins (e.g., ScrollTrigger, MorphSVG, SplitText, MotionPath, FLIP, Observer), and easing functions, along with comprehensive documentation and installation guides.
en.stack: Written in pure JavaScript with zero dependencies, installable via CDN or NPM, and compatible with all major browsers.
en.hot: GSAP is an industry-leading animation library used on over 12 million sites, gaining 251 stars this week to reach 27,533 total, and continues to be a favorite among developers.
uses: Frontend developers: add smooth, high-performance animations to web pages
Interaction designers: create scroll-triggered animations and interactive prototypes
React/Vue developers: animate components via framework integration
Ad/marketing teams: produce eye-catching banner and landing page animations

zh.tag: 基于 React 的全栈 Web 框架
zh.what: Next.js 是一个基于 React 的全栈 Web 框架，支持服务端渲染、静态生成和增量静态再生。它提供了文件系统路由、API 路由、中间件等开箱即用的功能，让开发者可以快速构建高性能的 Web 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Next.js 的核心源码、文档、示例以及贡献指南。主要目录包括 packages（核心包）、examples（示例应用）、test（测试）等。
zh.stack: 基于 React 和 Node.js，使用 Rust 编写的 Turbopack 作为打包工具。依赖包括 React、Webpack（可选）、Babel 等。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的 React 框架之一，Next.js 拥有超过 141k 的 Star，持续活跃的社区和 Vercel 的商业支持使其长期占据 GitHub 热门榜。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 构建全栈 React 应用的首选框架
团队/企业 —— 需要高性能、SEO 友好的生产级 Web 应用
初创公司 —— 快速搭建 MVP 或产品级网站

en.tag: The React Framework for Production
en.what: Next.js is a React-based full-stack web framework that supports server-side rendering, static generation, and incremental static regeneration. It provides file-system routing, API routes, middleware, and other out-of-the-box features, enabling developers to quickly build high-performance web applications.
en.content: The repository contains Next.js core source code, documentation, examples, and contribution guidelines. Key directories include packages (core packages), examples (sample apps), test (tests), etc.
en.stack: Built on React and Node.js, with Turbopack (Rust-based) as the bundler. Dependencies include React, Webpack (optional), Babel, etc.
en.hot: As one of the most popular React frameworks, Next.js has over 141k stars, with an active community and commercial support from Vercel, keeping it consistently trending on GitHub.
uses: Frontend developers — the go-to framework for building full-stack React apps
Teams/enterprises — need high-performance, SEO-friendly production web apps
Startups — quickly build MVP or production-grade websites

zh.tag: 硬件加速 GPU 终端模拟器，桌面与浏览器双端运行
zh.what: Rio 是一个用 Rust 编写的现代终端模拟器，利用 GPU 硬件加速实现流畅渲染，支持在桌面和浏览器中运行。它旨在提供跨平台一致体验，并支持自定义主题、分割视图等高级功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的终端模拟器源码，提供安装文档、配置指南、变更日志和赞助入口。支持多种打包格式，如 Flatpak，并附带多平台演示截图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 GPU 加速技术（如 WebGPU）实现渲染，支持跨平台（Windows、macOS、Linux）和 WebAssembly 浏览器版本。
zh.hot: 凭借 GPU 加速和跨平台（含浏览器）特性，在开发者中迅速走红，今日新增 85 星，总星数达 7239，位列 Rust 日榜第 4。
uses: 开发者：追求高性能、流畅体验的终端用户
跨平台用户：需要在桌面和浏览器间无缝切换的开发者
喜欢自定义：希望深度定制终端外观和行为的极客

en.tag: Hardware-accelerated GPU terminal emulator for desktop and browser
en.what: Rio is a modern terminal emulator written in Rust, leveraging GPU hardware acceleration for smooth rendering, and runs on both desktop and browser. It aims to deliver a consistent cross-platform experience with advanced features like custom themes and split views.
en.content: The repository contains the full terminal emulator source code, along with installation docs, config guide, changelog, and sponsor links. It supports various packaging formats like Flatpak and includes demo screenshots across platforms.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging GPU acceleration (e.g., WebGPU) for rendering, supporting cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux) and WebAssembly for browser.
en.hot: Gaining popularity for its GPU acceleration and cross-platform (including browser) capabilities, it added 85 stars today, reaching 7239 total, ranking #4 on Rust daily trending.
uses: Developers seeking high-performance, smooth terminal experience
Cross-platform users needing seamless transition between desktop and browser
Customization enthusiasts wanting deep control over terminal appearance and behavior

zh.tag: 人类与AI代理共存的蜂巢式协作空间
zh.what: Buzz 是一个自托管的协作平台，让人类和 AI 代理在同一个“房间”里共同工作。它基于 Nostr 协议，所有消息、操作和工作流步骤都作为签名事件记录在日志中，提供统一的身份模型和审计追踪。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Buzz 平台源码，包括前端界面、后端服务、Nostr 中继实现以及多个 Rust crate。提供了频道、画布、工作流、语音讨论等功能，并支持代理执行仓库操作、代码审查、CI/CD 等任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，基于 Nostr 协议，依赖多个 Rust crate 实现事件日志、身份管理和中继功能。
zh.hot: Buzz 在 GitHub 上一天内获得 3252 颗星，总星数达 4148，因其创新的“人类与代理平等协作”理念和自托管、基于 Nostr 的架构吸引了大量关注。
uses: 团队协作 —— 人类与 AI 代理在同一工作空间中共同管理项目、代码审查和 CI/CD
AI 代理开发 —— 测试和部署具有完整操作权限（如仓库、工作流）的 AI 代理
事件驱动工作流 —— 利用 Nostr 事件日志构建可审计的自动化流程
自托管社区 —— 为需要完全控制数据和身份的组织提供私有协作平台

en.tag: A self-hostable workspace where humans and agents collaborate in shared rooms
en.what: Buzz is a self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents share the same rooms. Built on the Nostr protocol, every message, action, and workflow step is a signed event in a single log, providing a unified identity model and audit trail.
en.content: The repository contains the full Buzz platform source code, including frontend UI, backend services, Nostr relay implementation, and multiple Rust crates. It offers channels, canvases, workflows, voice huddles, and enables agents to perform repo operations, code review, CI/CD, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, based on the Nostr protocol, leveraging multiple Rust crates for event logging, identity management, and relay functionality.
en.hot: Buzz gained 3252 stars in a single day, reaching 4148 total, due to its innovative concept of equal collaboration between humans and agents, self-hosted nature, and Nostr-based architecture.
uses: Team collaboration — humans and AI agents manage projects, code review, and CI/CD in the same workspace
AI agent development — test and deploy agents with full operational capabilities (repos, workflows, etc.)
Event-driven workflows — build auditable automation using Nostr event logs
Self-hosted communities — provide a private collaboration platform for organizations needing full data and identity control

zh.tag: 基于稀疏矩阵与线性代数的超快图数据库，为 LLM 知识图谱（GraphRAG）而生
zh.what: FalkorDB 是一个超快的多租户图数据库，底层使用 GraphBLAS 的稀疏邻接矩阵表示图，并通过线性代数执行查询。它旨在为大型语言模型提供高性能的知识图谱（GraphRAG），支持属性图模型和 OpenCypher 查询语言。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的图数据库实现，包括稀疏矩阵表示、线性代数查询引擎、OpenCypher 兼容层、多租户支持，以及云服务（FalkorDB Cloud）和 Docker 镜像。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 GraphBLAS 库进行稀疏矩阵运算，支持 OpenCypher 查询语言，提供 Docker 部署和云服务。
zh.hot: 随着 GraphRAG 和 AI Agent 记忆需求的兴起，FalkorDB 作为专为 LLM 设计的图数据库，凭借其超低延迟和独特技术路线，在 Rust 日榜排名第 5，今日新增 49 星。
uses: 构建 LLM 知识图谱（GraphRAG）的开发者，需要高性能图存储与查询
AI Agent 记忆管理场景，需要快速读写和检索实体关系
云安全、欺诈检测等需要实时图分析的应用
对图数据库底层技术（稀疏矩阵、线性代数）感兴趣的研究者

en.tag: Ultra-fast graph database leveraging sparse matrices & linear algebra, built for LLM knowledge graphs (GraphRAG)
en.what: FalkorDB is an ultra-fast, multi-tenant graph database that uses sparse adjacency matrices (GraphBLAS) under the hood and linear algebra for query execution. It aims to provide a high-performance knowledge graph for LLMs (GraphRAG), supporting the property graph model and OpenCypher queries.
en.content: The repository contains a full graph database implementation, including sparse matrix representation, linear algebra query engine, OpenCypher compatibility layer, multi-tenancy support, plus cloud service (FalkorDB Cloud) and Docker images.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, leveraging GraphBLAS for sparse matrix operations, supporting OpenCypher query language, with Docker deployment and cloud service.
en.hot: With the rise of GraphRAG and AI agent memory needs, FalkorDB, as a graph database designed specifically for LLMs, stands out with ultra-low latency and a unique technical approach, ranking #5 on the Rust daily trending with +49 stars today.
uses: Developers building LLM knowledge graphs (GraphRAG) needing high-performance graph storage and query
AI agent memory management scenarios requiring fast read/write and entity-relation retrieval
Applications like cloud security and fraud detection needing real-time graph analytics
Researchers interested in graph database internals (sparse matrices, linear algebra)

zh.tag: 透明 SSH/HTTPS/K8s/数据库堡垒机，无需客户端
zh.what: Warpgate 是一个智能且完全透明的堡垒主机/PAM 解决方案，支持 SSH、HTTPS、Kubernetes、MySQL、PostgreSQL、RDP 和 VNC。它不需要客户端软件或 SSH 包装器，可直接在 DMZ 中部署，并内置会话录制、浏览器访问、2FA/SSO 和暴力破解防护。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的单一二进制文件，提供管理 Web UI、内置 SSH/RDP/VNC 客户端、会话录制与回放功能，以及详细的文档和 Docker 支持。
zh.stack: 基于 100% 安全 Rust 编写，无外部依赖，支持 Docker 部署，集成 TOTP 和 OpenID Connect 用于 2FA/SSO。
zh.hot: 凭借无需客户端的透明代理架构和内置会话录制等企业级功能，在 Rust 趋势榜上排名第 3，star 数达 7473，持续吸引安全运维与基础设施团队关注。
uses: 安全团队：集中管理 SSH/数据库访问并审计会话
运维人员：通过浏览器或原生客户端安全访问内网资源
Kubernetes 管理员：为集群提供统一入口与权限控制
需要符合合规要求的企业：利用 2FA/SSO 和登录保护

en.tag: Transparent SSH/HTTPS/K8s/DB bastion, no client needed
en.what: Warpgate is a smart and fully transparent bastion host/PAM solution supporting SSH, HTTPS, Kubernetes, MySQL, PostgreSQL, RDP, and VNC. It requires no client software or SSH wrapper, can be deployed in the DMZ, and includes session recording, browser-based access, 2FA/SSO, and brute-force protection.
en.content: The repository contains a single Rust binary with an admin web UI, built-in SSH/RDP/VNC clients, session recording and replay, plus comprehensive docs and Docker support.
en.stack: Written in 100% safe Rust with no dependencies, supports Docker deployment, and integrates TOTP and OpenID Connect for 2FA/SSO.
en.hot: Ranked #3 on Rust trending with 7.4k stars, its clientless transparent proxy and enterprise features like session recording attract security and infra teams.
uses: Security teams: centrally manage SSH/DB access and audit sessions
Ops: securely access internal resources via browser or native clients
K8s admins: unified entry and access control for clusters
Compliance-focused enterprises: leverage 2FA/SSO and login protection

zh.tag: MCP 官方 Rust SDK，异步运行时支持
zh.what: 这是 Model Context Protocol 的官方 Rust SDK，提供核心协议实现和过程宏，用于构建 MCP 客户端和服务器。它支持最新的 MCP 规范，并兼容旧版本。
zh.content: 仓库包含两个 crate：rmcp（核心协议实现）和 rmcp-macros（用于生成工具实现的宏）。支持多种传输、工具、资源、提示、采样、日志、订阅、缓存、任务等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 tokio 异步运行时，依赖 serde 进行序列化，schemars 用于 JSON Schema 生成。
zh.hot: 作为 MCP 官方 SDK，随着 MCP 生态的爆发而备受关注，本周新增 42 星，总星数达 3773，位列 Rust 周榜第 19 名。
uses: Rust 开发者构建 MCP 客户端或服务器
需要高性能、异步 I/O 的 AI 工具集成场景
希望使用官方支持、持续更新的 MCP 实现的项目

en.tag: Official Rust SDK for Model Context Protocol with async runtime
en.what: This is the official Rust SDK for the Model Context Protocol, providing core protocol implementation and procedural macros for building MCP clients and servers. It supports the latest MCP specification while maintaining compatibility with older versions.
en.content: The repository contains two crates: rmcp (core protocol implementation) and rmcp-macros (macros for generating tool implementations). It supports various transports, tools, resources, prompts, sampling, logging, subscriptions, caching, tasks, and more.
en.stack: Built on Rust with tokio async runtime, uses serde for serialization and schemars for JSON Schema generation.
en.hot: As the official MCP SDK, it gains attention with the MCP ecosystem's growth, adding 42 stars this week to reach 3773 total, ranking 19th on the Rust weekly trending list.
uses: Rust developers building MCP clients or servers
Scenarios requiring high-performance, async I/O for AI tool integration
Projects wanting an officially supported, actively maintained MCP implementation

zh.tag: Rust 异步运行时，构建可靠、高性能异步应用
zh.what: Tokio 是一个事件驱动、非阻塞 I/O 的异步运行时，用于编写可靠、异步、精简的 Rust 应用。它提供多线程工作窃取调度器、基于操作系统事件队列的 reactor，以及异步 TCP/UDP 套接字等核心组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含运行时核心库、调度器、reactor、网络模块、定时器等，以及丰富的示例和文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖操作系统事件队列（epoll、kqueue、IOCP 等），提供异步 I/O 和并发原语。
zh.hot: 作为 Rust 生态中最流行的异步运行时，Tokio 凭借零成本抽象和高性能，成为构建网络服务的基石，持续获得大量关注。
uses: Rust 开发者构建高性能网络服务（如 Web 服务器、代理、数据库客户端）
需要异步 I/O 和并发处理的应用，如聊天系统、实时数据处理
学习 Rust 异步编程和运行时原理的开发者

en.tag: Rust async runtime for building reliable, high-performance async apps
en.what: Tokio is an event-driven, non-blocking I/O runtime for writing reliable, asynchronous, and slim applications in Rust. It provides a multithreaded work-stealing scheduler, a reactor backed by OS event queues, and async TCP/UDP sockets.
en.content: The repo contains the runtime core library, scheduler, reactor, networking modules, timers, and extensive examples and documentation.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leverages OS event queues (epoll, kqueue, IOCP), provides async I/O and concurrency primitives.
en.hot: As the most popular async runtime in the Rust ecosystem, Tokio's zero-cost abstractions and high performance make it a cornerstone for building network services, consistently attracting significant attention.
uses: Rust developers building high-performance network services (web servers, proxies, database clients)
Applications needing async I/O and concurrency, like chat systems, real-time data processing
Developers learning Rust async programming and runtime internals

zh.tag: 高性能多人协作代码编辑器，Atom 与 Tree-sitter 作者打造
zh.what: Zed 是一款由 Rust 编写的高性能多人协作代码编辑器，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它强调极快的响应速度和流畅的多人实时协作体验，旨在让开发者“以思维的速度编码”。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Zed 编辑器源代码，涵盖编辑器核心、协作功能、UI 组件、以及针对各平台的构建脚本和文档。还包含贡献指南、许可证信息以及第三方依赖的许可证管理工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Tree-sitter 进行语法解析，使用 cargo-about 管理开源许可证，并利用 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 凭借其卓越的性能和多人协作特性，Zed 在开发者中广受好评，目前拥有 88k+ 星标，今日新增 81，持续位列 Rust 趋势榜前列。
uses: 追求极致响应速度和流畅编辑体验的开发者
需要实时多人协作编码的团队
对 Rust 或编辑器开发感兴趣的开源贡献者
希望使用现代、高性能编辑器的程序员

en.tag: High-performance multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter
en.what: Zed is a high-performance multiplayer code editor written in Rust, available on macOS, Linux, and Windows. It emphasizes lightning-fast responsiveness and seamless real-time collaboration, aiming to let developers 'code at the speed of thought'.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the Zed editor, including the editor core, collaboration features, UI components, and build scripts and documentation for each platform. It also includes contribution guidelines, license information, and tools for managing third-party dependency licenses.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging Tree-sitter for syntax parsing, using cargo-about for open-source license compliance, and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: With its outstanding performance and multiplayer collaboration features, Zed has gained wide acclaim among developers, currently holding 88k+ stars, with 81 added today, consistently ranking high on the Rust trending list.
uses: Developers seeking ultimate responsiveness and smooth editing experience
Teams needing real-time collaborative coding
Open-source contributors interested in Rust or editor development
Programmers wanting a modern, high-performance editor

zh.tag: 面向智能体 AI 的实时事件流处理平台
zh.what: RisingWave 是一个专为智能体 AI 设计的事件流处理平台，能够持续从数据库、事件流和 Webhook 摄取数据，进行增量处理，并以低延迟提供最新结果。它用一个系统替代了传统的 Debezium + Kafka + Flink + 数据库的组合。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Rust 实现的流处理引擎，提供 SQL 接口统一处理流和表，支持多种数据源（Webhook、CDC、Kafka 等）和增量计算，还包含文档、演示和基准测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Kafka、Pulsar、Kinesis 等消息系统，以及 PostgreSQL、MySQL 等数据库的 CDC 连接器。
zh.hot: 随着智能体 AI 对实时数据的需求激增，RisingWave 以单一系统替代复杂事件流栈，简化架构并降低延迟，因此在 GitHub 上受到广泛关注，周榜排名第 18。
uses: 智能体 AI 开发者：需要实时数据流和低延迟查询来驱动 AI 代理的决策。
数据工程师：希望简化事件流处理架构，避免维护多套系统。
实时应用团队：构建需要毫秒级新鲜度的仪表盘或监控系统。
DevOps 与平台团队：寻求统一的数据摄取、处理和存储解决方案。

en.tag: Event streaming platform for agentic AI, unifying ingest, process, and serve
en.what: RisingWave is an event streaming platform for agentic AI, continuously ingesting data from databases, event streams, and webhooks, processing it incrementally, and serving fresh results at low latency. It replaces the traditional stack of Debezium, Kafka, Flink, and a serving database with a single system.
en.content: The repository contains a full stream processing engine implemented in Rust, offering a unified SQL interface for streams and tables, supporting various sources (webhooks, CDC, Kafka, etc.) and incremental computation, along with docs, demos, and benchmarks.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, integrating with message brokers like Kafka, Pulsar, Kinesis, and CDC connectors for databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL.
en.hot: With the surge in demand for real-time data in agentic AI, RisingWave simplifies the event streaming stack into one system, reducing latency and operational overhead, which has gained significant attention on GitHub, ranking #18 on the weekly trending.
uses: Agentic AI developers: needing real-time data streams and low-latency queries to drive AI agent decisions.
Data engineers: looking to simplify event streaming architecture and avoid maintaining multiple systems.
Real-time application teams: building dashboards or monitoring systems that require millisecond freshness.
DevOps and platform teams: seeking a unified solution for data ingestion, processing, and storage.

zh.tag: 终端里的邮件客户端，支持多协议与多账户
zh.what: Himalaya 是一个用 Rust 编写的命令行邮件管理工具，支持 IMAP、SMTP、JMAP、Gmail REST API 和 Microsoft Graph 等协议。它提供统一的 API 来操作邮箱、信封、标志、消息和附件，并支持 Maildir 等本地存储格式。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Rust 源码、安装脚本、截图、logo 以及详细的 README 文档，涵盖功能列表、安装配置、使用说明和常见问题。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 rustls、native-tls 等 TLS 库，支持通过 cargo features 切换后端。
zh.hot: 作为终端邮件客户端，它提供了丰富的协议支持和可脚本化的 JSON 输出，吸引了许多追求高效和可定制性的开发者。尽管 star 数不算特别高，但今日新增 29 星，说明仍有一定热度。
uses: 喜欢在终端中高效处理邮件的开发者或系统管理员
需要自动化邮件处理或脚本化操作的场景
追求隐私和轻量级工具的用户，避免使用重量级 GUI 客户端

en.tag: A terminal-based email client supporting multiple protocols and accounts
en.what: Himalaya is a command-line email management tool written in Rust, supporting protocols like IMAP, SMTP, JMAP, Gmail REST API, and Microsoft Graph. It provides a unified API for mailboxes, envelopes, flags, messages, and attachments, and supports local storage formats like Maildir.
en.content: The repository contains the complete Rust source code, installation scripts, screenshots, logo, and a detailed README covering features, installation, configuration, usage, and FAQ.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, using TLS libraries like rustls and native-tls, with backend support gated by cargo features.
en.hot: As a terminal email client, it offers extensive protocol support and scriptable JSON output, attracting developers who value efficiency and customization. Despite a moderate star count, it gained 29 stars today, indicating ongoing interest.
uses: Developers or sysadmins who prefer handling email in the terminal
Scenarios requiring automated or scripted email processing
Users seeking privacy and lightweight tools over heavy GUI clients

zh.tag: Rust 编写的下一代 Coding Agent Harness，极致性能与多会话支持
zh.what: jcode 是一款基于 Rust 的下一代 Coding Agent Harness，旨在提升 AI 编程助手的技能上限。它专为多会话工作流、无限可定制性与极致性能而设计，能够在本地以极低资源消耗运行复杂编程任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心运行时、跨平台 CLI 安装脚本（Linux/macOS/Windows），以及展示内存与启动速度优势的基准测试数据。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为主语言，强调零成本抽象与资源效率；支持可选本地嵌入模型，通过 Bash/PowerShell 脚本实现一键跨平台安装。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程工具同质化严重的背景下，jcode 凭借 8421 Star 和 Rust 日榜第 11 名的热度，以单会话 27.8 MB 的超低内存占用和多会话架构，精准击中开发者对高性能本地 Agent 的需求。
uses: 追求本地低内存、高性能 AI 编程体验的核心开发者
需要长期运行多会话复杂工作流的高级用户
希望深度定制 Coding Agent 行为与工具链的极客与团队

en.tag: Next-gen coding agent harness in Rust for multi-session, low-RAM workflows
en.what: jcode is a next-generation coding agent harness built in Rust to raise the skill ceiling of AI coding assistants. It is designed for multi-session workflows, infinite customizability, and extreme performance, allowing complex coding tasks to run locally with minimal resource usage.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust core runtime, cross-platform CLI installers for Linux/macOS/Windows, and benchmark data highlighting its memory and boot-up speed advantages.
en.stack: Primarily Rust with zero-cost abstraction and resource efficiency in mind; supports optional local embeddings and one-click cross-platform installation via Bash/PowerShell scripts.
en.hot: With 8,421 stars and a spot at #11 on GitHub's Rust daily trending list, jcode stands out in the crowded AI coding space by delivering an ultra-low 27.8 MB RAM footprint per session and a multi-session architecture that meets developers' demand for high-performance local agents.
uses: Core developers seeking local, low-memory, high-performance AI coding experiences
Power users running long-term, complex multi-session workflows
Hackers and teams wanting infinite customizability of their coding agent behavior and toolchain

zh.tag: 轻量级 Bitwarden 自托管服务器
zh.what: Vaultwarden 是 Bitwarden 的第三方轻量级服务器实现，用 Rust 编写，兼容官方客户端。它允许用户在低资源环境下自托管密码管理器，替代官方资源密集型的服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器端代码，支持 Docker、Podman 等多种部署方式，提供 Web Vault、API 和后台管理功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 语言，使用 Rocket 框架，依赖 SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL 数据库，支持 Docker 容器化部署。
zh.hot: 拥有 64,210 星标，是自托管密码管理领域的标杆项目。其轻量、安全且完全兼容官方客户端的特性，吸引了大量追求隐私和资源优化的用户。
uses: 个人用户 —— 在低配 VPS 或 NAS 上自托管密码管理器
小型团队 —— 无需付费订阅即可使用 Bitwarden 功能
隐私爱好者 —— 完全掌控密码数据，避免云服务依赖

en.tag: Lightweight self-hosted Bitwarden server
en.what: Vaultwarden is an alternative lightweight server implementation of Bitwarden, written in Rust and compatible with official Bitwarden clients. It enables self-hosted password management on low-resource environments, replacing the official resource-heavy service.
en.content: The repository contains the complete server-side code, supports deployment via Docker, Podman, and others, and provides Web Vault, API, and admin features.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Rocket framework, supports SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL databases, and offers Docker containerization.
en.hot: With 64,210 stars, it's a benchmark in self-hosted password management. Its lightweight, secure, and fully compatible nature attracts users seeking privacy and resource efficiency.
uses: Individual users — self-host password manager on low-end VPS or NAS
Small teams — use Bitwarden features without paid subscription
Privacy enthusiasts — full control over password data, avoiding cloud dependency

zh.tag: 把每个任务变成可打开应用的桌面 AI 代理
zh.what: BitFun 是一个桌面 AI 代理，它将代码代理的深度与通用任务能力相结合，不仅限于软件开发。它能为每个任务创建专属界面（如图表、看板、表单），并将对话绑定到该界面的实时状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心代理运行时、桌面应用（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、Mini Apps 框架、自托管设备同步服务器，以及文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Rust，桌面应用可能使用 Tauri 或类似框架，支持跨平台。依赖包括 MCP、Skills/Hooks 等定制机制，以及用于快速搜索的 flashgrep。
zh.hot: BitFun 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 19 颗星，总星数达 1496，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 10。其独特的 Agentic Mini Apps 概念和自托管多设备控制功能吸引了开发者关注。
uses: 开发者：希望使用 AI 代理进行编码、调试和代码审查，并享受桌面应用的便利。
办公人员：需要 AI 辅助研究、写作、制作演示文稿和会议记录。
技术爱好者：喜欢自托管服务，希望控制自己的数据和设备同步。
AI 应用开发者：希望基于 BitFun 构建自定义 Agent 和 Mini Apps。

en.tag: A desktop AI agent that turns every task into an app you can open
en.what: BitFun is a desktop AI agent that combines the depth of a code agent with open, general-purpose capabilities for work beyond software development. It creates a dedicated interface for each task—such as charts, boards, forms, or panels—and binds a conversation to that interface's live state.
en.content: The repository contains a high-performance agent runtime written in Rust, a polished desktop application for macOS/Windows/Linux, a Mini Apps framework, a self-hostable device-sync server, along with documentation and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: The primary language is Rust, with a desktop app likely built on Tauri or similar, supporting cross-platform. It leverages MCP, Skills/Hooks for customization, and flashgrep for fast search.
en.hot: BitFun is gaining traction on GitHub, with 19 new stars today and a total of 1496, ranking #10 on the Rust trending list. Its unique Agentic Mini Apps concept and self-hosted multi-device control are drawing developer attention.
uses: Developers: who want an AI agent for coding, debugging, and code review with a desktop app.
Office workers: needing AI assistance for research, writing, presentations, and meeting notes.
Tech enthusiasts: who prefer self-hosting and controlling their data and device sync.
AI app builders: looking to create custom agents and Mini Apps on top of BitFun.

zh.tag: 多服务器部署与自动化管理平台
zh.what: Komodo 是一个用于在众多服务器上构建和部署软件的开源工具。它提供统一的界面来管理多台服务器，支持自动化部署、环境配置、同步更新等操作，并允许通过 API 进行扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心应用代码、文档、截图以及部署脚本。界面支持浅色和深色主题，涵盖仪表盘、堆栈管理、Compose、环境变量、同步、更新、统计和导出等功能模块。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，可能使用现代 Web 框架构建前端，后端采用 Rust 生态。依赖包括 Docker 等容器技术，用于构建和部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 104 星，总星数达 11854，位列 Rust 周榜第 10。其无限服务器连接和 API 自动化的承诺吸引了寻求轻量级自托管部署方案的用户。
uses: 需要管理多台服务器的 DevOps 工程师或系统管理员
寻求自托管、开源部署工具的个人开发者或小团队
希望利用 API 实现自动化部署和运维的自动化爱好者
对 Rust 构建的现代基础设施工具感兴趣的技术人员

en.tag: Multi-server deployment and automation platform
en.what: Komodo is an open-source tool for building and deploying software across many servers. It provides a unified interface to manage multiple servers, supporting automated deployments, environment configuration, sync updates, and extensibility via APIs.
en.content: The repository contains core application code, documentation, screenshots, and deployment scripts. The UI supports light and dark themes, featuring modules for dashboard, stack management, Compose, environment variables, sync, updates, stats, and export.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, likely using modern web frameworks for the frontend and Rust ecosystem for the backend. Dependencies include container technologies like Docker for building and deploying.
en.hot: Gained 104 stars this week, reaching 11,854 total, ranking 10th on the Rust weekly trending. Its promise of unlimited server connections and API automation attracts users seeking lightweight self-hosted deployment solutions.

Individual developers or small teams seeking self-hosted, open-source deployment tools
Automation enthusiasts wanting to leverage APIs for automated deployment and ops
Tech professionals interested in modern infrastructure tools built with Rust

zh.tag: 带语法高亮和 Git 集成的 cat 增强版
zh.what: bat 是一个 cat 命令的克隆，但增加了语法高亮、Git 集成、自动分页等功能。它能以更友好的方式显示文件内容，支持多种编程语言和标记语言。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档（含多语言 README）、示例截图和配置文件。核心功能包括语法高亮、Git 集成、非打印字符显示、自动分页等。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Git 进行版本控制集成，支持通过 Cargo 构建和发布。
zh.hot: 作为 cat 命令的现代替代品，bat 凭借其出色的语法高亮和 Git 集成，在开发者中广受欢迎，已获得超过 6 万星标，本周新增 220 星。
uses: 开发者日常查看代码文件，提高可读性
系统管理员查看日志或配置文件，快速识别关键信息
需要与 Git 集成显示文件修改状态的用户
希望将 cat 替换为更强大工具的命令行爱好者

en.tag: A cat(1) clone with syntax highlighting and Git integration
en.what: bat is a clone of the cat command with syntax highlighting, Git integration, and automatic paging. It displays file contents in a more user-friendly way, supporting many programming and markup languages.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation (including multi-language READMEs), example screenshots, and configuration files. Key features include syntax highlighting, Git integration, non-printable character display, and automatic paging.
en.stack: Written in Rust, integrates with Git for version control, and is built and distributed via Cargo.
en.hot: As a modern replacement for cat, bat is popular among developers for its excellent syntax highlighting and Git integration, amassing over 60k stars with 220 added this week.
uses: Developers viewing code files daily for better readability
System administrators checking logs or config files to quickly identify key info
Users needing Git integration to show file modification status
CLI enthusiasts who want a more powerful replacement for cat

zh.tag: AI 代理的浏览器自动化 CLI，原生 Rust 实现
zh.what: 这是一个专为 AI 代理设计的浏览器自动化命令行工具，提供快速的原生 Rust 实现。它允许 AI 代理通过命令行操作浏览器，如打开网页、点击元素、填写表单、截图等，并支持可访问性树快照和引用操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心二进制、Node.js 包装器（用于 npm 安装）、安装脚本（支持 npm、Homebrew、Cargo）以及构建工具。提供全局安装和项目本地安装方式，并自动检测现有 Chrome 等浏览器。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，通过 Node.js 和 pnpm 进行构建和分发，依赖 Chrome（通过 Chrome for Testing 下载），支持 Linux 系统依赖安装。

uses: AI 代理开发者：需要让代理与网页交互时，可用此 CLI 实现自动化操作。
测试工程师：利用快照和引用操作简化端到端测试脚本编写。
命令行爱好者：无需编写代码即可快速操作浏览器，适合自动化日常任务。

en.tag: Browser automation CLI for AI agents, fast native Rust
en.what: A browser automation CLI designed for AI agents, with a fast native Rust implementation. It enables AI agents to control a browser via command line, including opening pages, clicking elements, filling forms, taking screenshots, and supports accessibility tree snapshots with refs.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust core binary, a Node.js wrapper for npm installation, install scripts (npm, Homebrew, Cargo), and build tooling. It supports global and project-local installation, and auto-detects existing Chrome installations.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built and distributed via Node.js and pnpm, depends on Chrome (downloaded via Chrome for Testing), and supports Linux system dependency installation.
en.hot: As a Vercel Labs project for AI agent browser automation, it gained 40k+ stars quickly due to its native Rust performance and simple CLI design, frequently appearing on the Rust trending list.
uses: AI agent developers: use this CLI to automate web interactions for agents.
Test engineers: simplify end-to-end test scripts with snapshot and ref operations.
CLI enthusiasts: quickly automate browser tasks without writing code.

zh.tag: 阿里巴巴开源的企业级AI代码审查CLI工具
zh.what: OpenCodeReview 是一款基于 AI 的代码审查 CLI 工具，起源于阿里巴巴集团内部，经过两年大规模验证，为数万开发者服务并发现数百万代码缺陷。它读取 Git diff，通过具备工具调用能力的 Agent 将变更文件发送给可配置的 LLM，生成精确到行的结构化审查评论。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具源码、内置精细调优的规则集（NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL注入等）、支持 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容接口，以及多语言文档和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Git 和 LLM API（OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容），支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent。
zh.hot: 作为阿里巴巴内部大规模验证的代码审查工具开源，结合确定性流水线和 LLM Agent 的混合架构，精准行级评论和内置规则集吸引了大量开发者，今日新增 162 星，总星数 10964。
uses: 开发团队 —— 集成到 CI/CD 流水线，自动审查代码提交，提升代码质量
个人开发者 —— 在本地运行审查，快速发现潜在缺陷和安全漏洞
开源维护者 —— 用于管理 PR 审查，减少人工负担

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested AI code review CLI with deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent
en.what: OpenCodeReview is an AI-powered code review CLI tool originating from Alibaba Group's internal system, serving tens of thousands of developers and identifying millions of code defects over two years. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates line-level structured review comments.
en.content: The repo contains Go CLI source code, built-in fine-tuned rulesets (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), support for OpenAI & Anthropic compatible APIs, and multi-language documentation and installation scripts.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, depends on Git and LLM APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic compatible), supports agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor.
en.hot: Open-sourced from Alibaba's battle-tested internal tool, its hybrid architecture of deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, and built-in rulesets have attracted many developers, gaining 162 stars today and 10964 total.
uses: Development teams — integrate into CI/CD pipelines for automated code review on commits, improving code quality
Individual developers — run locally for quick detection of potential defects and security vulnerabilities
Open source maintainers — manage PR reviews with reduced manual effort

zh.tag: GitHub 官方的堆叠式 PR 管理 CLI 扩展
zh.what: gh-stack 是一个 GitHub CLI 扩展，用于管理堆叠分支和拉取请求。它将大型变更拆分为一系列相互依赖的小型 PR，并自动化创建分支、保持 rebase、设置正确的 PR 基础分支等繁琐操作。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 GitHub CLI (gh) v2.0+，通过 `gh extension install` 安装。
zh.hot: 本周新增 541 星，总星数 1139，登上 GitHub 趋势榜（Go 语言）第 6 名。它解决了大型 PR 评审难的问题，并支持 AI 代理集成，受到开发者关注。
uses: 大型功能开发团队，希望将大变更拆分为可审查的小 PR
需要频繁 rebase 和依赖分支管理的开发者
使用 AI 编码代理（如 Copilot）的开发者，可通过 skill 集成
开源项目维护者，希望简化贡献流程

en.tag: Official GitHub CLI extension for managing stacked PRs
en.what: gh-stack is a GitHub CLI extension for managing stacked branches and pull requests. It breaks large changes into a chain of small, reviewable PRs that build on each other, automating branch creation, rebasing, and setting correct base branches.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI extension with `gh stack` commands (init, add, push, view, submit, etc.) and a skill for AI agent integration.
en.stack: Written in Go, requires GitHub CLI (gh) v2.0+, installed via `gh extension install`.
en.hot: Gained 541 stars this week (total 1139), ranking #6 on GitHub Trending (Go). It addresses the pain of large PR reviews and supports AI agent integration, drawing developer attention.
uses: Teams working on large features that want to split changes into reviewable PRs
Developers who need frequent rebasing and branch management
Developers using AI coding agents (e.g., Copilot) that can integrate via skill
Open-source maintainers who want to streamline contribution workflows

en.tag: Comprehensive Kubernetes security platform from dev to runtime

Developers: quick security checks on Kubernetes configs in IDE.

zh.tag: Git 版数据库，可分支合并的 SQL 数据版本控制
zh.what: Dolt 是一个 SQL 数据库，支持像 Git 仓库一样进行 fork、clone、branch、merge、push 和 pull。你可以像连接 MySQL 一样连接 Dolt，并通过 SQL 或 Git 风格的命令行管理数据和 schema 的版本。

软件开发者：在应用开发中管理数据库 schema 迁移和测试数据。
团队协作：多人同时编辑数据库，通过分支和合并解决冲突。
AI 代理记忆：作为多智能体工作流中的共享状态存储。

en.tag: Git for Data: a SQL database with fork, clone, branch, merge, push, pull
en.what: Dolt is a SQL database that you can fork, clone, branch, merge, push and pull just like a Git repository. Connect to it like any MySQL database to read or modify schema and data, with version control exposed via SQL and a Git-like CLI.

en.stack: Primarily written in Go, MySQL-compatible, with a Git-like command-line interface.
en.hot: Dolt brings Git-like version control to databases, solving data collaboration and tracking pain points. It gained 89 stars this week, reaching 24k+ total stars.
uses: Data scientists and analysts: track dataset changes for reproducible analysis.
Software developers: manage database schema migrations and test data in app development.
Team collaboration: multiple people edit a database concurrently, resolving conflicts via branches and merges.
AI agent memory: as shared state storage in multi-agent workflows.

平台团队：标准化应用交付和配置管理

en.tag: The Kubernetes package manager, like apt/yum for K8s apps
en.what: Helm is a tool for managing Kubernetes applications by packaging pre-configured resources as Charts. It streamlines installing, upgrading, and managing K8s apps, akin to a package manager for Kubernetes.
en.content: The repo contains Helm's source code, docs, tests, and example charts. Core is a Go CLI for templating, release management, and repo interactions.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging Kubernetes API and templating. Supports multiple installation methods: binaries, Homebrew, Chocolatey, etc.
en.hot: As a standard tool in the K8s ecosystem, it has 30k+ stars, +189 this month, and remains active. v4 stable release and v3 support until 2026 keep community interest high.
uses: K8s developers: quickly package and deploy apps
DevOps engineers: manage complex app lifecycles
Platform teams: standardize app delivery and config management

zh.tag: 基于 HTTP 的轻量级 pub-sub 消息推送服务，支持自托管
zh.what: ntfy 是一个基于 HTTP 的 pub-sub 通知服务，允许用户通过简单的 PUT/POST 请求从任何脚本或计算机向手机、桌面推送实时通知。它无需注册账号或支付费用即可使用官方托管服务，同时也支持完全开源的自托管部署，满足隐私与定制化需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的服务端核心与 Web 前端，并配合独立维护的开源 Android 与 iOS 客户端应用，形成端到端的推送生态。
zh.stack: 后端基于 Go 构建高性能 HTTP API，默认采用 SQLite 存储消息与订阅状态；客户端覆盖 Android、iOS 及 PWA 多平台。
zh.hot: 凭借「一行 curl 即可推送」的极简体验和完全开源可自托管的特性，ntfy 已获得近 3.2 万 Star，本月新增 1195 Star，跻身 GitHub Go 语言月榜第 8，成为开发者最喜爱的轻量消息基础设施之一。
uses: DevOps / SRE —— 将服务器告警、CI/CD 流水线结果实时推送到手机
开发者 / 极客 —— 脚本执行完毕、定时任务完成时接收桌面或移动端通知
隐私敏感用户 —— 通过自托管实例替代商业推送服务，掌控数据主权
IoT / 家庭自动化 —— 将设备状态、智能家居事件推送到家庭成员终端

en.tag: Lightweight HTTP pub-sub notification service with self-hosting support
en.what: ntfy is a simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service that lets you send real-time alerts to your phone or desktop via PUT/POST requests from any script or computer. It requires no sign-up or fees to use the hosted instance, and being fully open source, it also supports self-hosting for privacy and customization.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based server core and web frontend, complemented by separate open-source Android and iOS clients, forming an end-to-end push ecosystem.
en.stack: The backend is built in Go for a high-performance HTTP API, using SQLite by default for message and subscription storage, with clients available for Android, iOS, and PWA.
en.hot: With its 'one-line curl to push' simplicity and fully open-source, self-hostable nature, ntfy has earned nearly 32k stars, gaining 1,195 this month and ranking 8th on GitHub's Go monthly trending list as a favorite lightweight messaging infra tool.
uses: DevOps / SRE —— Push server alerts and CI/CD pipeline results to mobile in real time
Developers / Geeks —— Get notified on phone or desktop when scripts or cron jobs finish
Privacy-conscious users —— Self-host to replace commercial push services and retain data sovereignty
IoT / Home automation —— Push device status and smart-home events to family members' devices

zh.tag: 把AI编码代理当队友分配任务的协作工作台
zh.what: Multica 是一个开源工作台，让你像给队友派活一样把 issue 分配给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 20 种编码代理。代理会自动接单、在可控运行时中工作、实时评论并交回审查，所有上下文和决策都关联到同一 issue。支持自托管，无锁定。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Go 后端、Web 前端（看板界面）、文档（README、自托管指南、愿景）、以及用于集成 20 种代理 CLI 的运行时适配器。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 构建后端，前端为 Web 应用，支持多种代理 CLI 的集成，自托管部署。
zh.hot: 44.5k stars 且单日新增 274，登上 Go 趋势榜第二，因为解决了多代理协作中上下文丢失和重复解释的痛点，将代理真正纳入团队流程。
uses: 开发者团队：统一管理多个编码代理，减少切换和重复沟通成本
技术负责人：将代理分配为团队成员，通过看板跟踪进度和审查结果
自托管用户：对数据隐私有要求，希望完全掌控代理运行环境

en.tag: Assign issues to AI coding agents like teammates in an open-source workspace
en.what: Multica is an open-source workspace where you assign issues to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 20 others, just as you would to a teammate. Agents pick up issues, work in a runtime you control, comment as they go, and hand back for review, keeping context and decisions tied to the issue. Self-hostable with no lock-in.
en.content: The repo contains the core Go backend, a web frontend (board UI), documentation (README, self-hosting guide, vision), and runtime adapters for integrating 20 agent CLIs.
en.stack: Built primarily with Go for the backend, with a web frontend, and integrations for multiple agent CLIs; supports self-hosting.
en.hot: With 44.5k stars and +274 today, ranking #2 on Go trending, it solves the pain of context loss and repeated explanations when managing multiple agents, integrating them into team workflows.
uses: Dev teams: manage multiple coding agents in one place, reducing context switching and repeated explanations
Tech leads: assign agents as team members, track progress and review via board
Self-hosters: need data privacy and full control over agent runtimes

zh.tag: 自托管 Web 应用防火墙，保护应用免受攻击
zh.what: SafeLine 是一个自托管的 Web 应用防火墙（WAF）和反向代理，用于保护 Web 应用免受各种攻击和漏洞利用。它通过过滤和监控 Web 应用与互联网之间的 HTTP 流量，防御 SQL 注入、XSS、代码注入、RCE 等常见威胁。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 WAF 实现，包括核心引擎、管理界面、文档和示例配置。提供 Docker 镜像，支持快速部署，并配有详细的安装指南和中文文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，可能涉及 Nginx 或类似反向代理技术。
zh.hot: 作为自托管 WAF 的领先项目，SafeLine 在 GitHub 上获得了 22k+ 星标，并多次登上 Trending 榜首，本周新增 282 星。其易用性和强大功能吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队：为自建网站或应用提供简单易用的安全防护。
企业安全团队：部署在内部或云环境，保护关键 Web 应用免受攻击。
DevOps 工程师：作为 CI/CD 流程中的安全层，自动拦截恶意流量。

en.tag: Self-hosted WAF / reverse proxy to protect web apps from attacks
en.what: SafeLine is a self-hosted Web Application Firewall (WAF) and reverse proxy that protects web apps from attacks and exploits. It filters and monitors HTTP traffic between a web application and the Internet, defending against SQL injection, XSS, code injection, RCE, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full WAF implementation, including core engine, management UI, documentation, and example configurations. Docker images are provided for quick deployment, along with detailed installation guides and Chinese documentation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging Docker for containerized deployment, possibly integrating with Nginx or similar reverse proxy technologies.
en.hot: As a leading self-hosted WAF, SafeLine has gained 22k+ stars on GitHub and topped the Trending charts multiple times, with 282 new stars this week. Its ease of use and powerful features attract many developers.
uses: Individual developers or small teams: provide easy-to-use security protection for self-hosted websites or apps.
Enterprise security teams: deploy in internal or cloud environments to protect critical web applications.
DevOps engineers: integrate as a security layer in CI/CD pipelines to automatically block malicious traffic.

zh.tag: AI 工程化开源控制平面，编排跨工具工作流
zh.what: SuperPlane 是一个用于 AI 驱动工程的开源自动化引擎，可跨 Git、LLM、CI/CD、可观测性、事件响应和基础设施等工具编排工程工作流，提供持久执行、审批和操作界面。它确定性执行流程，为人类和 AI 提供安全交互所需的护栏。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎、CLI、文档和示例，核心概念包括应用（Apps）、画布（Canvases）、组件（Components）和事件触发。提供自托管和云服务两种部署方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，依赖 Git 进行版本控制，集成 LLM、CI/CD、可观测性等工具，支持 webhooks、调度和事件触发。
zh.hot: 本周新增 436 星，总星数达 4792，位列 Go 周榜第 11。作为开源 AI 代理控制平面，填补了 AI 工程自动化编排的空白，吸引大量关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要为代理提供安全护栏和审批流程的团队
平台工程团队：希望统一编排跨 Git、CI/CD、可观测性等工具的工作流
DevOps 工程师：需要持久执行和人工审批的复杂自动化场景
技术领导者：评估 AI 工程自动化平台，用于内部工具链集成

en.tag: Open-source control plane for agentic engineering, orchestrating workflows across tools
en.what: SuperPlane is an open-source automation engine for AI-driven engineering, orchestrating engineering workflows across tools like Git, LLMs, CI/CD, observability, incident tools, and infrastructure, with durable execution, approvals, and an operational UI. It executes processes deterministically, providing guardrails for safe human-AI interaction.
en.content: The repo contains the core engine, CLI, docs, and examples, with core concepts like Apps, Canvases, Components, and event triggers. It offers self-hosted and cloud deployment options.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, relies on Git for versioning, integrates with LLMs, CI/CD, observability tools, and supports webhooks, schedules, and event triggers.
en.hot: Gained 436 stars this week, reaching 4792 total, ranking 11th on the Go weekly trending. As an open-source control plane for AI agents, it fills a gap in AI engineering orchestration, drawing significant attention.
uses: AI agent developers: teams needing guardrails and approval workflows for agents
Platform engineering teams: wanting to orchestrate workflows across Git, CI/CD, observability, etc.
DevOps engineers: complex automation requiring durable execution and human approvals
Tech leaders: evaluating AI engineering automation platforms for internal toolchain integration

zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供持久化结构化记忆的分布式图式问题追踪器
zh.what: Beads 是一个为 AI 编码代理设计的分布式图式问题追踪器，提供持久化、结构化的记忆。它用依赖感知的图取代混乱的 Markdown 计划，帮助代理处理长周期任务而不丢失上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Beads CLI 工具源码、安装脚本、文档以及多种代理集成（如 Codex CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等）。用户通过 `bd` 命令初始化项目、创建/关闭问题、同步远程代理。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 开发，底层依赖 Dolt（分布式版本化数据库）实现图存储和同步。支持通过 npm 和 PyPI 安装 MCP 相关包。
zh.hot: GitHub 日增 95 星，总星数 25601，位列 Go 语言日榜第 11。AI 编码代理的持久记忆需求旺盛，Beads 以轻量 CLI 和分布式图方案解决痛点。
uses: AI 编码代理开发者 —— 为代理提供持久化记忆和任务管理
使用 Codex CLI、Claude Code 等工具的开发者 —— 集成 Beads 以提升长周期任务处理能力
团队协作场景 —— 多代理通过 Dolt 同步工作状态和依赖图

en.tag: A distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents with persistent structured memory
en.what: Beads is a distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents, providing persistent structured memory. It replaces messy markdown plans with a dependency-aware graph, helping agents handle long-horizon tasks without losing context.
en.content: The repo contains the Beads CLI tool source code, installation scripts, documentation, and integrations for various agents (Codex CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Users interact via `bd` commands to init projects, create/close issues, and sync with remote agents.
en.stack: Built with Go, leveraging Dolt (distributed versioned database) for graph storage and sync. Also provides npm and PyPI packages for MCP integration.
en.hot: Gaining 95 stars daily, total 25601, ranking #11 on Go daily trending. The demand for persistent memory in AI coding agents is high, and Beads addresses it with a lightweight CLI and distributed graph approach.
uses: AI coding agent developers — provide persistent memory and task management for agents
Developers using Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc. — integrate Beads to improve long-horizon task handling
Team collaboration — multiple agents sync work status and dependency graph via Dolt

zh.tag: 高性能命令行模糊搜索工具与交互式终端应用框架
zh.what: fzf 是一个通用的命令行模糊查找器，能够在海量数据中通过模糊匹配快速定位目标。它既可以作为独立的文件、历史记录搜索工具，也可通过事件驱动架构嵌入脚本，构建丰富的交互式终端应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Go 编写的单二进制可执行文件源码，以及针对 Bash、Zsh、Fish、Nushell、Vim 和 Neovim 的即用型集成脚本与插件。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，编译为无依赖的独立二进制文件；通过事件驱动架构提供可编程接口，并原生支持主流 Shell 与编辑器生态。
zh.hot: 凭借 81K+ Star 和月增 1,121 Star 的势头，fzf 已成为终端效率工具的标杆；其毫秒级检索速度、零依赖部署以及对全平台 Shell 和编辑器的深度集成，让它在开发者群体中经久不衰。
uses: 终端重度用户 —— 快速模糊定位文件、目录与命令历史，替代传统 grep/find 交互。
Shell 效率极客 —— 通过键盘驱动的工作流，在 Bash/Zsh/Fish 中构建自定义模糊菜单。
Vim/Neovim 用户 —— 作为编辑器插件实现文件、Buffer、LSP 符号等模糊搜索。
运维与 DevOps 工程师 —— 在日志、进程、K8s 资源等海量文本中秒级定位目标。

en.tag: A blazing-fast command-line fuzzy finder and interactive terminal toolkit
en.what: fzf is a general-purpose command-line fuzzy finder that lets you rapidly locate items in massive datasets using fuzzy matching. It works as a standalone tool for searching files and command history, and its event-driven architecture allows embedding into scripts to build rich interactive terminal applications.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for a single Go binary, along with ready-to-use integration scripts and plugins for Bash, Zsh, Fish, Nushell, Vim, and Neovim.
en.stack: Written in Go and distributed as a self-contained, dependency-free binary. It exposes a programmable, event-driven interface and natively integrates with major shells and editors.
en.hot: With 81K+ stars and 1,121 new stars this month, fzf is a benchmark for terminal productivity; its millisecond-level search speed, zero-dependency deployment, and deep integration across all major shells and editors make it a perennial favorite among developers.
uses: Power terminal users — Fuzzy-locate files, directories, and command history at speed, replacing traditional grep/find interactions.
Shell efficiency enthusiasts — Build custom fuzzy menus and keyboard-driven workflows in Bash, Zsh, Fish, or Nushell.
Vim/Neovim users — Use as an editor plugin for fuzzy searching files, buffers, LSP symbols, and more.
Ops & DevOps engineers — Instantly pinpoint targets in massive logs, processes, or Kubernetes resources.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理和 IDE 打造的高性能代码智能引擎
zh.what: Gortex 是一个高性能的代码智能引擎，将代码索引成图结构，并通过 CLI、MCP 服务器和 Web UI 暴露给 AI 代理和 IDE。它支持 257 种语言和多仓库，能显著减少 AI 编码代理的 token 消耗（最高 50 倍）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心引擎、tree-sitter 解析器、编译器级解析器（针对多种语言）、175 个可配置的 MCP 工具、CLI 和 Web UI，以及文档和基准测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 tree-sitter 进行语法解析，支持多种编译器级解析器，生成持久化的知识图谱。
zh.hot: 本周新增 109 颗星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜（Go 语言）。其亮点是能大幅降低 AI 编码代理的 token 消耗（最高 50 倍），且完全本地化、零依赖，支持 19 种编码代理。
uses: AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor 等）的开发者，希望减少 token 消耗并提升代码理解能力。
IDE 用户，需要高效的代码导航和智能提示。
大型多仓库项目团队，需要跨服务的调用链和契约分析。

en.tag: High-performance code-intelligence engine for AI agents and IDE
en.what: Gortex is a high-performance code-intelligence engine that indexes code into a graph and exposes it via CLI, MCP Server, and Web UI for AI agents and IDEs. It supports 257 languages and multiple repositories, reducing token usage for AI coding agents by up to 50x.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based core engine, tree-sitter parsers, compiler-grade resolvers for multiple languages, 175 configurable MCP tools, CLI and Web UI, along with documentation and benchmarks.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, uses tree-sitter for syntax parsing, supports compiler-grade resolvers, and generates a persistent knowledge graph.
en.hot: Gained 109 stars this week, trending on GitHub (Go). Its key appeal is reducing token usage for AI coding agents by up to 50x, fully local, zero dependencies, and supporting 19 coding agents.
uses: Developers of AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) seeking to reduce token usage and improve code understanding.
IDE users needing efficient code navigation and intelligent suggestions.
Teams working on large multi-repository projects requiring cross-service call chains and contract analysis.

zh.tag: 网络侦察与中间人攻击的瑞士军刀
zh.what: bettercap 是一个用 Go 编写的强大、易扩展且可移植的框架，旨在为安全研究人员、红队和逆向工程师提供一站式解决方案，用于对 WiFi、蓝牙低功耗（BLE）、CAN 总线、无线 HID 设备和以太网网络进行侦察和中间人（MITM）攻击。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 bettercap 源代码、跨平台构建配置（Linux/macOS/Windows）、Docker 镜像、模块化文档（如 WiFi、BLE、CAN-bus 等模块），以及一个基于 Web 的用户界面（UI）用于实时事件展示。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 libpcap 等网络库，支持跨平台编译，并提供 Docker 容器化部署。
zh.hot: 作为一款功能全面的网络攻击与侦察工具，bettercap 在安全社区广受欢迎，拥有近 2 万 Star，本周新增 185 个，持续位列 GitHub Go 语言趋势榜。
uses: 安全研究人员：用于渗透测试和漏洞验证，快速评估网络安全性。
红队成员：在授权评估中执行中间人攻击和网络侦察。
网络安全爱好者：学习网络协议和攻击原理，提升技能。
物联网开发者：测试 BLE 和 CAN-bus 设备的安全性。

en.tag: Swiss Army knife for network recon and MITM attacks
en.what: bettercap is a powerful, easily extensible and portable framework written in Go, offering security researchers, red teamers and reverse engineers an easy-to-use, all-in-one solution for reconnaissance and MITM attacks on WiFi, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), CAN-bus, wireless HID devices and Ethernet networks.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of bettercap, cross-platform build configurations (Linux/macOS/Windows), Docker images, modular documentation (e.g., WiFi, BLE, CAN-bus modules), and a web-based UI for real-time event visualization.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on network libraries like libpcap, supports cross-platform compilation, and offers Docker containerized deployment.
en.hot: As a comprehensive network attack and recon tool, bettercap is highly popular in the security community, with nearly 20k stars, adding 185 this week, consistently ranking on GitHub's Go trending list.
uses: Security researchers: for penetration testing and vulnerability validation to quickly assess network security.
Red teamers: to perform MITM attacks and network recon during authorized assessments.
Cybersecurity enthusiasts: to learn network protocols and attack principles, enhancing skills.
IoT developers: to test the security of BLE and CAN-bus devices.

zh.tag: 云原生应用代理，自动发现服务并动态配置路由
zh.what: Traefik 是一个现代 HTTP 反向代理和负载均衡器，旨在简化微服务的部署。它能够与 Docker、Kubernetes 等基础设施组件集成，自动且动态地配置自身，无需手动维护路由规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Traefik 的源代码、文档、示例配置以及 Web UI 资源。主要目录包括 docs（文档）、pkg（核心代码）、cmd（入口命令）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种后端集成库（如 Docker、Kubernetes、Consul 等），并支持 ACME 自动 HTTPS 证书。
zh.hot: 拥有 64k+ star，是云原生领域最受欢迎的反向代理之一。其自动服务发现和动态配置特性极大简化了微服务路由管理，因此持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 微服务架构中作为入口网关，自动路由到 Docker/Kubernetes 等服务
需要动态更新路由规则的场景，如频繁扩缩容或服务变更
希望简化 HTTPS 证书管理的开发者，利用内置 ACME 自动签发证书
边缘代理或 API 网关，支持多种协议和中间件

en.tag: Cloud-native application proxy with automatic service discovery and dynamic routing
en.what: Traefik is a modern HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer that simplifies microservices deployment. It integrates with infrastructure components like Docker and Kubernetes, automatically and dynamically configuring itself without manual route management.
en.content: The repository contains Traefik's source code, documentation, example configurations, and Web UI assets. Key directories include docs, pkg (core code), and cmd (entry commands).
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with integrations for various backends (Docker, Kubernetes, Consul, etc.) and support for automatic HTTPS via ACME.
en.hot: With 64k+ stars, it's one of the most popular reverse proxies in cloud-native. Its automatic service discovery and dynamic configuration greatly simplify microservice routing, keeping it in the spotlight.
uses: As an ingress gateway in microservices, automatically routing to services in Docker/Kubernetes
Scenarios needing dynamic route updates, such as frequent scaling or service changes
Developers wanting simplified HTTPS management with built-in ACME auto-certificates
Edge proxy or API gateway supporting multiple protocols and middleware

zh.tag: 开源中间人攻击框架，绕过双因素认证的钓鱼神器
zh.what: Evilginx2 是一个独立的中间人攻击框架，用于钓鱼登录凭证和会话 Cookie，从而绕过双因素认证。它通过代理浏览器与目标网站之间的流量，实时窃取敏感信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Evilginx 3.0 的完整源代码，使用 Go 编写，实现了自己的 HTTP 和 DNS 服务器，无需额外依赖。还包含官方 phishlets 数据库、文档和配置示例。

en.tag: Open-source MITM framework for phishing credentials and bypassing 2FA
en.what: Evilginx2 is a standalone man-in-the-middle attack framework used for phishing login credentials and session cookies, allowing bypass of 2-factor authentication. It proxies traffic between the browser and the target site to steal sensitive data in real time.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Evilginx 3.0, written in Go, with its own HTTP and DNS server, requiring no extra dependencies. It also includes an official phishlets database, documentation, and configuration examples.

en.what: HAMi is a Kubernetes-native middleware for virtualizing and sharing GPUs and other AI accelerators. AI infra engineers: implement device isolation and fair scheduling for multi-tenant environments
Cloud-native developers: integrate heterogeneous accelerators (NVIDIA/AMD/Ascend) into K8s workloads
Research institutions: run multiple experiments or training jobs on limited GPU resources

en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, example configs, and build/test scripts for workerd. The core is a C++ runtime providing a Workers execution environment based on standard Web APIs.
