en.hot: As the open-source core of Cloudflare Workers, workerd attracts developers and enterprises; +57 stars today, 8519 total, #8 on C++ daily trending. Its nanoservices architecture and compatibility design stand out.
uses: Self-host Workers apps: migrate code from Cloudflare to your own servers.
Local development: simulate the Workers environment for faster iteration.
Programmable HTTP proxy: intercept, modify, and route requests.
Learn Workers internals: study its design principles and implementation.

zh.tag: 实时分析型列式数据库管理系统
zh.what: ClickHouse 是一个开源的列式数据库管理系统，专为实时生成分析数据报告而设计。它能够对海量数据进行极速查询，支持 SQL 接口，适用于在线分析处理（OLAP）场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ClickHouse 数据库的完整源代码、构建脚本、测试套件以及文档。提供 Linux、macOS、FreeBSD 等平台的安装方式，并有丰富的社区资源如教程、文档、视频和 Slack 群组。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 LLVM、libcxx、zlib-ng 等底层库，支持多种编译器和平台。
zh.hot: ClickHouse 因其极致的查询性能和实时分析能力而广受欢迎，拥有 48k+ Stars，本周新增 159 Stars，在 C++ 周榜排名第 15。
uses: 数据工程师 —— 构建实时 OLAP 数据管道和仪表盘
DevOps/SRE —— 监控和可观测性数据存储与查询
数据分析师 —— 对海量数据进行交互式探索分析
产品经理 —— 了解用户行为分析场景下的技术选型

en.tag: Real-time analytics column-oriented database management system
en.what: ClickHouse is an open-source column-oriented database management system designed for real-time generation of analytical data reports. It enables blazing-fast queries on massive datasets, supports SQL interface, and is suitable for online analytical processing (OLAP) scenarios.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code, build scripts, test suites, and documentation for the ClickHouse database. It provides installation methods for Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, and offers rich community resources such as tutorials, documentation, videos, and Slack groups.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with dependencies on LLVM, libcxx, zlib-ng, and other low-level libraries, supporting multiple compilers and platforms.
en.hot: ClickHouse is widely popular for its extreme query performance and real-time analytics capabilities, with over 48k Stars and 159 new stars this week, ranking 15th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Data engineers — building real-time OLAP data pipelines and dashboards
DevOps/SRE — storing and querying monitoring and observability data
Data analysts — interactive exploration and analysis of massive datasets
Product managers — understanding technical choices for user behavior analytics

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 开发的 C++ 测试框架，提供单元测试、模拟对象和丰富的断言。它支持自动测试发现、死亡测试、参数化测试等特性，是 C++ 社区最广泛使用的测试工具之一。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的合并源码、构建系统（CMake/Bazel）、文档和示例。目录结构包括 googletest（核心框架）、googlemock（模拟库）和 docs（文档）。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，依赖 C++17 及以上标准（1.17.x 分支）。构建支持 CMake 和 Bazel，计划引入 Abseil 依赖。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 测试的行业标准，持续稳定更新（本周新增 45 star）。1.17.0 版本要求 C++17，吸引新用户关注。
uses: C++ 开发者 —— 编写单元测试和集成测试
质量保证工程师 —— 自动化测试和持续集成
开源项目维护者 —— 为项目添加测试覆盖
教学场景 —— 学习 C++ 测试最佳实践

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework providing unit testing, mocking, and a rich set of assertions. It supports automatic test discovery, death tests, parameterized tests, and is one of the most widely used testing tools in the C++ community.
en.content: The repository contains merged source code of GoogleTest and GoogleMock, build systems (CMake/Bazel), documentation, and examples. Directory structure includes googletest (core framework), googlemock (mocking library), and docs.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation, requires C++17 or later (1.17.x branch). Build supports CMake and Bazel, with planned dependency on Abseil.
en.hot: As the industry standard for C++ testing, it maintains steady updates (45 stars this week). The 1.17.0 release requires C++17, attracting new users.
uses: C++ developers — writing unit and integration tests
QA engineers — automated testing and CI
Open-source maintainers — adding test coverage to projects
Educational settings — learning C++ testing best practices

zh.tag: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架与生态平台
zh.what: TensorFlow 是 Google 开发的端到端开源机器学习平台，提供从研究到生产部署的完整工具链与库生态。它让研究者能够推进机器学习前沿，也让开发者轻松构建和部署 AI 驱动的应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 运行时、Python 与 C++ API、Keras 高级接口，以及 TensorFlow Lite、TensorFlow.js 等跨平台推理部署工具和丰富的官方示例。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 构建高性能计算后端，通过 Python 提供主要前端接口；支持 CUDA GPU 加速、Bazel 构建系统及 Docker 部署，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最具影响力的基础框架之一，TensorFlow 凭借 196,329 星（本周新增 365 颗）和工业级稳定性，持续获得学术界与工业界的广泛采用。
uses: 机器学习研究者 —— 需要灵活底层接口进行模型创新与算法实验
AI 应用开发者 —— 希望借助 Keras 和 TF Lite 快速训练并部署到端侧或服务器
工程团队 —— 寻求从训练到推理的规模化、可移植生产流水线
高校学生 —— 学习深度学习原理与工程实践的首选框架之一

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open-source ML framework and ecosystem
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open-source machine learning platform developed by Google, offering a comprehensive toolchain and library ecosystem from research to production. It enables researchers to push the state-of-the-art in ML while allowing developers to easily build and deploy AI-powered applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ runtime, Python and C++ APIs, the Keras high-level interface, plus cross-platform deployment tools like TensorFlow Lite and TensorFlow.js along with extensive official examples.
en.stack: Built on C++ for a high-performance compute backend with Python as the primary frontend; it supports CUDA GPU acceleration, Bazel builds, Docker deployment, and multi-language bindings.
en.hot: As one of the most influential foundational deep-learning frameworks, TensorFlow maintains strong momentum with 196,329 stars and 365 new stars this week, reflecting broad academic and industrial adoption for its production-grade stability.
uses: ML researchers —— who need flexible low-level APIs for model innovation and algorithmic experiments
AI application developers —— looking to quickly train and deploy models to mobile, edge, or server via Keras and TF Lite
Engineering teams —— seeking scalable, portable production pipelines from training to inference
Students and educators —— using it as a primary framework to learn deep-learning concepts and engineering practices

zh.tag: 回合制末日生存游戏，深度模拟与开放世界
zh.what: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead 是一款设定在末日后的回合制生存游戏。玩家在一个严酷、持久、程序生成的世界中挣扎求生，搜刮文明遗迹，对抗各种怪物和其他幸存者。游戏强调深度模拟和自由度。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的游戏源代码、文档（如编译指南）、数据文件（如 tileset 截图）以及多平台打包配置（Arch、Fedora、Debian/Ubuntu、Flatpak）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，支持 Ncurses 和 SDL（tiles）两种界面。构建系统支持多平台（Linux、OS X、Windows、BSD）。
zh.hot: 作为一款长期维护的开源游戏，拥有稳定的玩家和贡献者社区。本周新增 75 星，总星数 12907，在 C++ 周榜中排名第 12，持续受到关注。
uses: 喜欢深度模拟和生存游戏的玩家，可以体验复杂的系统交互。
对游戏开发感兴趣的开发者，可以学习大型 C++ 项目的架构和社区协作。
希望参与开源游戏贡献的玩家，可通过 CodeTriage 等渠道参与。

en.tag: Turn-based post-apocalyptic survival game with deep simulation and open world
en.what: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead is a turn-based survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Players struggle to survive in a harsh, persistent, procedurally generated world, scavenging for resources and fighting monsters and other survivors. It emphasizes deep simulation and freedom.
en.content: The repository contains the full game source code, documentation (e.g., compiling guides), data files (e.g., tileset screenshots), and packaging configurations for multiple platforms (Arch, Fedora, Debian/Ubuntu, Flatpak).
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, supporting both Ncurses and SDL (tiles) interfaces. The build system supports multiple platforms (Linux, OS X, Windows, BSD).
en.hot: As a long-maintained open-source game, it has a stable community of players and contributors. With 75 new stars this week and a total of 12,907, it ranks 12th on the C++ weekly trending, showing sustained interest.
uses: Players who enjoy deep simulation and survival games can experience complex system interactions.
Developers interested in game development can learn from the architecture of a large C++ project and community collaboration.
Players who want to contribute to an open-source game can participate via channels like CodeTriage.

zh.tag: 用 SQL 查询操作系统状态的开源监控框架
zh.what: osquery 将操作系统抽象为高性能关系数据库，允许用户通过 SQL 查询系统数据，如进程、网络连接、内核模块等。它支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows，广泛用于安全监控、合规检查和故障排查。
zh.content: 仓库包含 osquery 的完整源代码，包括核心守护进程、交互式查询 shell（osqueryi）、命令行工具（osqueryd）、表实现、插件和扩展 API，以及文档和构建配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，并集成多种第三方库（如 Boost、SQLite、Google Test）。支持跨平台编译，提供丰富的表 API 供开发者扩展。
zh.hot: osquery 作为安全监控和系统分析领域的标杆项目，拥有 23k+ 星标，因其强大的 SQL 查询能力和跨平台支持而广受欢迎。本周新增 23 星，持续保持热度。
uses: 安全团队：用于端点检测与响应（EDR）、入侵检测和合规审计，通过 SQL 快速查询系统状态。
DevOps/运维：监控服务器健康、排查性能问题，并自动化收集系统信息。
开发人员：利用表 API 编写自定义插件，扩展 osquery 功能以适配特定场景。
取证分析：在数字取证中快速提取系统快照，辅助事件调查。

en.tag: SQL-powered OS instrumentation, monitoring, and analytics framework
en.what: osquery exposes the operating system as a high-performance relational database, allowing users to query system data like processes, network connections, and kernel modules via SQL. It supports Linux, macOS, and Windows, and is widely used for security monitoring, compliance, and troubleshooting.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of osquery, including the core daemon, interactive query shell (osqueryi), command-line tool (osqueryd), table implementations, plugin and extension APIs, along with documentation and build configurations.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built with CMake, and integrates third-party libraries like Boost, SQLite, and Google Test. It supports cross-platform compilation and offers a rich table API for extension.
en.hot: As a benchmark project in security monitoring and system analysis, osquery has 23k+ stars, popular for its powerful SQL query capabilities and cross-platform support. It gained 23 stars this week, maintaining steady popularity.
uses: Security teams: for endpoint detection and response (EDR), intrusion detection, and compliance audits, quickly querying system state via SQL.
DevOps/SysAdmins: to monitor server health, troubleshoot performance issues, and automate system information collection.
Developers: to write custom plugins using the table API, extending osquery for specific use cases.
Forensics analysts: to quickly extract system snapshots for incident investigation.

zh.tag: 统一分布式存储平台，对象、块、文件三合一
zh.what: Ceph 是一个开源的分布式存储系统，提供对象存储、块存储和文件系统存储三种接口。它设计为可扩展、高可用，无单点故障，广泛用于云基础设施和企业级存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ceph 的核心源代码，包括 RADOS、RBD、RGW、CephFS 等组件，以及构建脚本、文档和测试。主要用 C++ 编写，支持多种平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 Boost、gRPC、RocksDB 等库，构建系统采用 CMake 和 Ninja。
zh.hot: Ceph 是分布式存储领域的标杆项目，star 数持续增长，本周新增 31 个，进入 C++ 周榜前 20，反映了其在云原生和私有云中的持续重要性。
uses: 云平台存储后端，如 OpenStack、Kubernetes 的持久化存储
企业级统一存储，替代传统 SAN/NAS
大数据分析平台的数据存储层
开发者和研究者学习分布式系统设计

en.tag: Unified distributed storage for object, block, and file
en.what: Ceph is an open-source distributed storage system that provides object, block, and file storage interfaces. It is designed to be scalable, highly available, and without single points of failure, widely used in cloud infrastructure and enterprise storage.
en.content: The repository contains the core source code of Ceph, including components like RADOS, RBD, RGW, and CephFS, along with build scripts, documentation, and tests. It is primarily written in C++ and supports multiple platforms.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies on Boost, gRPC, RocksDB, etc. Build system uses CMake and Ninja.
en.hot: Ceph is a benchmark project in distributed storage, with steady star growth (31 this week) and ranking #20 on the C++ trending list, reflecting its enduring importance in cloud-native and private cloud environments.
uses: Storage backend for cloud platforms like OpenStack and Kubernetes persistent storage
Enterprise unified storage replacing traditional SAN/NAS
Data storage layer for big data analytics platforms
For developers and researchers learning distributed system design

zh.tag: 统一云端与本地离线推理的跨平台 AI 客户端
zh.what: 这是一个生产就绪的跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，支持在 Android 设备上本地运行 GGUF 模型（GPU 加速，无需联网），同时可无缝切换到 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google Gemini 或 Kimi 等云端 API。它提供多模态聊天、持久化会话、后台任务和智能自动配置等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Flutter 应用源码，包括 UI 层（聊天、任务、模型、设置视图）、GetX 控制器、服务层（本地推理、云服务、下载服务）以及推理管线的架构说明。
zh.stack: 基于 Flutter 3.x（Dart >=3.3.0），使用 GetX 管理状态，Hive 本地存储，Dio 网络请求，以及 Firebase 消息推送。本地推理依赖 Vulkan 加速。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 日榜（C++）排名第 5，今日新增 23 星，总星数 834。其亮点是同时支持本地离线运行和云端 API，且针对多种 Android 设备进行了图像生成测试，满足了用户对隐私和灵活性的需求。
uses: 注重隐私的用户：希望在本地运行模型，避免数据上传到云端。
移动开发者：需要参考 Flutter 跨平台 AI 客户端架构和本地推理集成。
AI 爱好者：希望在没有网络或低配设备上体验 LLM 和图像生成。

en.tag: Unified cross-platform AI client bridging cloud APIs and on-device offline LLM inference
en.what: A production-ready cross-platform AI chat client that runs GGUF models locally on Android with GPU acceleration (no internet after download) and seamlessly switches to cloud APIs like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or Kimi. It offers multimodal chat, persistent sessions, background tasks, and smart auto-configuration.
en.content: The repository contains the complete Flutter app source code, including UI layer (chat, task, model, settings views), GetX controllers, service layer (local inference, cloud service, download service), and architecture documentation for the inference pipeline.
en.stack: Built with Flutter 3.x (Dart >=3.3.0), uses GetX for state management, Hive for local storage, Dio for networking, and Firebase for push notifications. Local inference relies on Vulkan acceleration.
en.hot: Ranked #5 on GitHub Trending (C++) with 23 stars today and 834 total. Its appeal lies in combining local offline execution with cloud API fallback, tested on various Android devices for image generation, addressing privacy and flexibility needs.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to run models locally without data leaving their device.
Mobile developers looking for a reference Flutter cross-platform AI client architecture and local inference integration.
AI enthusiasts who want to experiment with LLMs and image generation offline or on low-end devices.

zh.tag: 开源最强国际象棋引擎，UCI 协议，支持 NNUE 神经网络评估
zh.what: Stockfish 是一个免费且强大的 UCI 国际象棋引擎，用于分析棋局并计算最佳走法。它不包含图形界面，需要配合第三方 GUI 使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、Makefile 构建脚本、NNUE 神经网络权重文件，以及文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种 CPU 架构和指令集，采用 NNUE 神经网络评估，通过 Fishtest 分布式测试框架进行性能测试。
zh.hot: 作为国际象棋引擎的标杆，持续保持顶级棋力，社区活跃，今日新增 7 星，总星数 16257，长期受到棋手和开发者的关注。
uses: 国际象棋爱好者：使用 Stockfish 分析棋局、提高棋艺
开发者：研究高性能 C++ 代码、NNUE 神经网络在棋类中的应用
研究者：用于 AI 博弈、搜索算法和评估函数的实验平台

en.tag: The strongest open-source UCI chess engine with NNUE evaluation
en.what: Stockfish is a free and strong UCI chess engine that analyzes chess positions and computes optimal moves. It does not include a GUI, requiring third-party interfaces for use.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++ source code, Makefile build scripts, NNUE neural network weights, along with documentation and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, supports various CPU architectures and instruction sets, uses NNUE neural network evaluation, and leverages the Fishtest distributed testing framework.
en.hot: As the benchmark of chess engines, it consistently maintains top-level strength, with an active community, gaining 7 stars today and 16,257 total, long appreciated by players and developers.
uses: Chess enthusiasts: analyze games and improve skills with Stockfish
Developers: study high-performance C++ and NNUE applications in chess
Researchers: use as a platform for AI game-playing, search algorithms, and evaluation functions

zh.tag: 以太坊智能合约编程语言官方编译器
zh.what: Solidity 是一种面向合约的静态类型高级语言，用于在以太坊平台上实现智能合约。该仓库是 Solidity 编译器的官方实现，将 Solidity 代码编译为可在以太坊虚拟机（EVM）上运行的字节码。
zh.content: 仓库包含编译器的完整源代码、构建和安装说明、示例合约（如投票、盲拍）以及详细的文档链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，并集成测试框架。
zh.hot: 作为以太坊生态的核心基础设施，Solidity 拥有 25k+ 星标，持续活跃开发，本周新增 25 星，位列 C++ 周榜第 13 名。
uses: 智能合约开发者：编写和部署以太坊上的去中心化应用
区块链学习者：通过官方示例和文档学习 Solidity 语言
工具链开发者：基于 Solidity 编译器构建开发工具和 IDE 插件

en.tag: Official compiler for Ethereum's smart contract language
en.what: Solidity is a statically-typed, contract-oriented high-level language for implementing smart contracts on Ethereum. This repository is the official implementation of the Solidity compiler, which compiles Solidity code into bytecode that runs on the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM).
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the compiler, build and install instructions, example contracts (like voting, blind auction), and links to comprehensive documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, uses CMake build system, and integrates testing frameworks.
en.hot: As core infrastructure of the Ethereum ecosystem, Solidity has 25k+ stars, active development, and gained 25 stars this week, ranking #13 on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Smart contract developers: write and deploy dApps on Ethereum
Blockchain learners: study Solidity via official examples and docs
Toolchain developers: build dev tools and IDE plugins on top of the compiler

zh.tag: 用 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用的开源框架
zh.what: Electron 是一个开源框架，允许开发者使用 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 构建跨平台桌面应用。它基于 Node.js 和 Chromium，被 Visual Studio Code 等众多知名应用采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 的完整源代码、文档、示例以及构建和测试脚本。它提供了预编译的二进制文件，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 JavaScript，依赖 Chromium 和 Node.js。通过 npm 安装，支持多种平台架构。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 12 万颗星，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的桌面应用框架之一。今日新增 8 颗星，持续保持高热度。
uses: 开发者：希望用 Web 技术快速构建跨平台桌面应用的开发者
团队：需要为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供一致体验的产品团队
学习者：想学习桌面应用开发或了解 Chromium 和 Node.js 集成的学习者

en.tag: Open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop apps with web tech
en.what: Electron is an open-source framework that lets developers build cross-platform desktop apps using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. It is based on Node.js and Chromium and is used by many well-known apps like Visual Studio Code.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and build/test scripts for Electron. It provides prebuilt binaries for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and JavaScript, relying on Chromium and Node.js. Installed via npm, supporting multiple platforms and architectures.
en.hot: With over 120k stars, it's one of the most popular desktop app frameworks on GitHub. Gained 8 stars today, maintaining high popularity.
uses: Developers: those who want to quickly build cross-platform desktop apps using web technologies
Teams: product teams needing consistent experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Learners: those interested in desktop app development or the integration of Chromium and Node.js

zh.tag: 跨平台 Android 实时投屏与控制工具
zh.what: QtScrcpy 是一款通过 USB 或网络显示和控制 Android 设备的软件，无需 root 权限。它支持 GNU/Linux、Windows 和 macOS 三大平台，注重轻量、高性能、低延迟和非侵入性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 QtScrcpy 源代码、跨平台构建配置（Windows/macOS/Ubuntu）、截图、文档（如按键映射脚本规则），以及作者开发的更专业的投屏软件 QuickMirror 的推广信息。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架开发，依赖 adb 进行设备通信，支持 GPU 视频渲染（在 QuickMirror 中提及）。
zh.hot: 作为 scrcpy 的 Qt 图形化版本，它提供了更友好的界面和按键映射功能，方便游戏玩家和开发者使用。今日新增 174 星，总星数超 3.1 万，位列 C++ 日榜第三，持续受到关注。
uses: 安卓开发者：无需 root 即可调试和演示应用，实时查看设备屏幕。
游戏玩家：通过按键映射脚本，用键盘鼠标玩手机游戏（如 PUBG Mobile）。
技术支持：远程协助或批量管理多台 Android 设备（结合 QuickMirror 可管理 500+ 台）。

en.tag: Cross-platform Android real-time display and control tool
en.what: QtScrcpy is a software that displays and controls Android devices via USB or over the network, requiring no root privileges. It supports GNU/Linux, Windows, and macOS, focusing on lightness, performance, low latency, and non-intrusiveness.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of QtScrcpy, cross-platform build configurations (Windows/macOS/Ubuntu), screenshots, documentation (e.g., key mapping script rules), and promotional info for the author's more professional screen casting software QuickMirror.
en.stack: Developed primarily with C++ and Qt framework, relies on adb for device communication, and supports GPU video rendering (mentioned in QuickMirror).
en.hot: As a Qt graphical version of scrcpy, it offers a friendlier UI and key mapping features, appealing to gamers and developers. With 174 stars today and over 31k total, it ranks #3 on the C++ daily trending list, maintaining steady popularity.
uses: Android developers: debug and demo apps without root, view device screen in real time.
Gamers: play mobile games (e.g., PUBG Mobile) with keyboard and mouse via key mapping scripts.
Tech support: remote assistance or batch management of multiple Android devices (with QuickMirror, manage 500+ devices).

zh.tag: 开源像素动画与精灵图编辑器，游戏美术必备工具
zh.what: Aseprite 是一款专注于像素艺术和动画精灵图创作的专业桌面软件，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。它通过图层与帧分离的动画时间轴、洋葱皮预览和丰富的像素画笔工具，帮助用户制作游戏素材和复古风格动画。软件同时提供 Lua 脚本扩展、命令行接口和多种格式导入导出，满足从个人创作到工业化流程的多样化需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面端源码，基于自研 UI 框架构建，涵盖绘画引擎、动画时间轴、颜色管理、文件读写及脚本系统等核心模块。除主程序代码外，还提供了依赖库（如 Skia 图形后端）的集成配置和跨平台构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主体采用 C++ 开发，图形渲染基于 Skia 库，并依赖 Google 的 depot_tools 进行依赖管理；构建系统支持 CMake，覆盖 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 三端编译。
zh.hot: 凭借 38.1k+ Star 的社区认可度，Aseprite 是像素艺术领域的事实标准工具；其开源属性与专业级动画功能（如洋葱皮、Lua 脚本）持续吸引独立游戏开发者和艺术创作者，本周再获 211 Star 登上 C++ 周榜前 20。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 快速绘制角色、场景与 UI 的像素风游戏素材
像素艺术家与动画师 —— 制作复古风插画、表情包和逐帧动画
游戏美术教育者 —— 作为低门槛、可扩展的像素画教学工具
工具链集成工程师 —— 利用 CLI 与 Lua 脚本实现自动化资产导出流水线

en.tag: Open-source pixel art & animated sprite editor for game developers and artists
en.what: Aseprite is a dedicated desktop application for creating pixel art and animated sprites across Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a timeline that separates layers and frames, onion skinning for smooth animation workflows, and pixel-perfect drawing tools tailored for game asset creation. The tool also supports Lua scripting, CLI automation, and extensive import/export formats to fit both hobbyist and production pipelines.
en.content: The repository houses the full C++ desktop application source, built on a custom UI framework, covering the rendering engine, animation timeline, color management, file I/O, and scripting subsystems. It also includes dependency integrations (such as the Skia graphics backend) and cross-platform build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ with Skia handling the graphics backend and Google depot_tools managing dependencies; the project uses CMake and supports compilation on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: With over 38.1k stars, Aseprite is the de facto standard for pixel art; its open-source model combined with professional animation features—such as onion skinning and Lua scripting—keeps attracting indie game developers and artists, earning another 211 stars this week and landing in the top 20 of GitHub’s C++ Trending.
uses: Indie game developers — rapidly creating pixel-art characters, environments, and UI assets
Pixel artists and animators — producing retro-style illustrations, emoticons, and frame-by-frame animations
Game-art educators — teaching pixel fundamentals with a low-barrier, highly extensible tool
Pipeline engineers — automating asset export via CLI and Lua scripting in production workflows

zh.tag: 嵌入式持久化键值存储库，为闪存与 RAM 优化
zh.what: RocksDB 是一个嵌入式的持久化键值存储库，专为快速存储设计，尤其适合闪存设备。它基于 LevelDB 构建，采用 LSM 树架构，支持多线程压缩，可存储数 TB 数据。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库源码、示例、公共接口（include/ 目录）以及详细的 Wiki 文档。公共接口稳定，内部 API 可能随时更改。
zh.stack: 使用 C++ 编写，依赖 LevelDB 的早期工作，支持多种压缩算法和存储后端。
zh.hot: 虽然本周新增 star 不多（31），但总 star 数高达 31951，说明其长期稳定受欢迎，是数据库领域的基石组件。
uses: 需要高性能嵌入式键值存储的数据库开发者
构建分布式存储系统或缓存层的后端工程师
对 LSM 树和存储引擎优化感兴趣的研究者
需要持久化存储的应用程序（如消息队列、日志存储）

en.tag: Embeddable persistent key-value store optimized for flash and RAM storage
en.what: RocksDB is an embeddable persistent key-value store for fast storage, especially suited for flash drives. Built on LevelDB, it uses an LSM tree design with multi-threaded compactions, capable of storing multiple terabytes of data.
en.content: The repository contains core library source code, examples, public interface (include/ directory), and detailed Wiki documentation. The public interface is stable, while internal APIs may change without notice.
en.stack: Written in C++, built on earlier LevelDB work, supports various compression algorithms and storage backends.
en.hot: Despite modest weekly stars (31), the total stars of 31951 reflect its long-term popularity as a foundational database component.
uses: Database developers needing high-performance embedded key-value storage
Backend engineers building distributed storage systems or cache layers
Researchers interested in LSM trees and storage engine optimization
Applications requiring persistent storage (e.g., message queues, log storage)

zh.tag: 专治「AI 味」网页的设计 skill，让 AI 生成的 UI 不像模板货
zh.what: Together AI 出品的设计 skill 包：装进 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 后，AI 生成网页 UI 时会从 20 套主题里选宏观结构，并跑 57 项「anti-slop」检查加自我批判，拒绝 LLM 默认那套千篇一律的渐变卡片风。提供生成、hallmark audit（给现有代码打分）、hallmark redesign（换结构重写）、hallmark study（从截图/URL 提取设计 DNA）四个动词。
zh.content: 核心是 skills/hallmark/ 下的 SKILL.md + references/ 规则文件；docs/ 有 recipes 和示例，site/ 是官网及大量自包含 HTML+CSS 示例页（语言占比因此显示为 CSS）。
zh.stack: Markdown 规则 + 参考文档的 skill 包（符合 Agent Skills 规范），示例为纯 HTML/CSS，MIT，无运行时依赖，一行 npx skills add nutlope/hallmark 安装。
zh.hot: 它直指 AI 生成网站同质化这一普遍痛点，并用在线 Demo 降低验证门槛，定位清晰且易于传播。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 没有设计师，也能让 AI 生成不撞脸的官网和落地页
设计师 —— 用 hallmark study 从优秀网站提取设计 DNA 做参考
前端工程师 —— 用 audit 给存量项目打分，找出「AI 味」重灾区

en.tag: The anti-'AI-slop' design skill — AI-built UIs that don't look like templates
en.what: A design skill pack from Together AI: once installed in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, your agent picks a macro-structure from 20 themes when generating web UIs, then runs 57 'anti-slop' checks plus self-critique — rejecting the default LLM look of identical gradient cards. Four verbs: generate, hallmark audit (score existing code), hallmark redesign (rewrite with a new structure), hallmark study (extract design DNA from a screenshot or URL).
en.content: The core is SKILL.md plus rule files under skills/hallmark/ and references/; docs/ holds recipes and examples; site/ contains the homepage and many self-contained HTML+CSS example pages (which is why the language stat reads CSS).
en.stack: A Markdown-rules skill pack (Agent Skills compliant) with pure HTML/CSS examples; MIT, zero runtime dependencies; install via npx skills add nutlope/hallmark.
en.hot: Its anti-slop positioning addresses a common complaint about AI-generated websites, while the live demo makes the claim easy to evaluate.
uses: Indie devs & small teams — generate distinctive sites and landing pages without a designer
Designers — extract design DNA from great sites with hallmark study
Frontend engineers — audit existing projects to find the worst 'AI-slop' offenders

zh.tag: AI 驱动的全球实时态势感知仪表盘
zh.what: World Monitor 是一个实时全球情报仪表盘，利用 AI 聚合新闻、监控地缘政治事件和基础设施状态，提供统一的态势感知界面。它支持多个垂直领域（科技、金融、大宗商品、能源等）的定制化视图。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Web 应用源码、CLI 工具和 npm 包，提供多种主题变体（科技、金融、大宗商品、能源等），以及 MCP 服务器集成。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，使用 npm 包管理，支持 Web 应用和 CLI 两种形态，集成了 MCP 服务器。
zh.hot: 凭借 AI 驱动的实时全球情报聚合和多个垂直领域定制视图，上线后迅速获得 6.5 万+ Star，日增近 1300，登顶 GitHub 日榜。
uses: 地缘政治分析师 —— 实时监控全球事件与基础设施状态
金融投资者 —— 跟踪大宗商品、能源等市场动态
科技从业者 —— 获取科技领域新闻与趋势
普通用户 —— 通过 Happy 变体关注积极新闻

en.tag: AI-powered real-time global intelligence dashboard for situational awareness
en.what: World Monitor is a real-time global intelligence dashboard that uses AI to aggregate news, monitor geopolitical events, and track infrastructure status in a unified situational awareness interface. It offers customized views for various verticals like tech, finance, commodities, and energy.
en.content: The repository contains full web application source code, CLI tools, and npm packages, offering multiple theme variants (tech, finance, commodities, energy, etc.), along with MCP server integration.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, managed via npm, supports both web app and CLI, and integrates MCP server.
en.hot: With AI-powered real-time global intelligence aggregation and multiple vertical-specific views, it quickly gained over 65K stars, adding nearly 1,300 daily, topping GitHub's daily trending chart.
uses: Geopolitical analysts — monitor global events and infrastructure in real time
Financial investors — track commodities, energy, and market movements
Tech professionals — stay updated with tech news and trends
General users — follow positive news via the Happy variant

zh.tag: 多 AI 编程代理并行编排的桌面与移动工作平台
zh.what: Orca 是一款 Agent Development Environment（ADE），让用户能够并行运行多种主流 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），各自在隔离的 git worktree 中执行任务。同时提供移动端伴侣应用，方便用户随时随地监控、接收通知并追加指令。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面端应用源码（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、移动端配套应用（iOS/Android），以及用于多代理并行执行、git worktree 管理与结果对比合并的核心模块。
zh.stack: 主要基于 TypeScript 构建，提供跨平台桌面客户端与移动端配套应用，通过集成多家第三方 AI 编程代理的 API 实现统一调度。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程代理百花齐放的背景下，Orca 以「并行工作树 + 移动端遥控」解决了多代理对比与随时监控的痛点；一周内新增 5,409 Star 并以 21.3k 总星数冲上 GitHub 周榜第 7，足见开发者对统一代理调度界面的强烈需求。
uses: 需要同时对比多个 AI 编程代理输出的开发者——在独立 git worktree 中并行运行多个代理，择优合并结果
追求随时随地掌控编码任务的技术团队——通过移动端伴侣应用远程监控代理状态并追加指令
希望统一调度自有 AI 订阅工具的高级用户——将 Codex、Claude Code 等集中在一套桌面环境中管理
需要保持代码库隔离的谨慎工程师——每个代理在独立工作树中操作，避免污染主分支

en.tag: Parallel AI coding agent orchestrator for desktop and mobile
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) that lets developers run a fleet of popular coding agents—such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode—in parallel within isolated git worktrees. It also offers a mobile companion app to monitor progress, receive notifications, and send follow-up instructions from anywhere.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop application source (macOS/Windows/Linux), a mobile companion app (iOS and Android), and core modules for parallel agent execution, git worktree management, and result comparison/merging.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it provides cross-platform desktop clients and mobile companion apps, integrating third-party AI coding agent APIs for unified orchestration.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, Orca's parallel worktrees and mobile companion solve the pain of comparing multiple agents and monitoring them on the go; the project gained 5,409 stars this week, hitting #7 on GitHub Trending with 21.3k total stars, reflecting strong demand for a unified agent orchestration interface.
uses: Developers who want to benchmark multiple AI agents side-by-side—run several agents in isolated git worktrees and merge the best result
Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

zh.tag: 港大出品的 AI 私人家教：个性化终身学习工作区
zh.what: 香港大学 HKUDS 实验室的「agent 原生」学习平台：聊天辅导、刷题测验、深度研究、可视化、解题、Mastery Path 掌握度练习跑在同一套 agent 循环上。支持多引擎 RAG 知识库（LlamaIndex、PageIndex、GraphRAG、LightRAG，可挂 Obsidian 库），可从任意对话呼叫 Claude Code / Codex 等子 agent；带三层可检查记忆（L1 trace / L2 摘要 / L3 综合）和 Memory Graph 溯源。
zh.content: 完整 Web 应用（Python 后端 + Next.js 16 前端），附 11 种语言 README、Docker 部署、CLI/agent-native 接口、EduHub 社区 skills 生态；发版极勤。
zh.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16，RAG 多引擎 + MCP 工具 + FAISS 向量库，Apache-2.0；2025 年 12 月底创建，有 arXiv 论文背书。
zh.hot: 它把 AI 教育与 Agent 原生工作流结合，并由高校实验室持续维护，概念清晰、可体验性强。
uses: 学生 / 自学者 —— 把教材和论文喂进去，得到 24 小时私人家教
考研 / 考证党 —— 用刷题测验 + 掌握度路径系统备考
知识管理玩家 —— 直接挂 Obsidian 库做 RAG 问答

en.tag: An AI personal tutor from HKU: a lifelong, personalized learning workspace
en.what: An 'agent-native' learning platform from HKU's HKUDS lab: chat tutoring, quizzes, deep research, visualization, problem solving and Mastery-Path practice all run on one agent loop. It supports multi-engine RAG knowledge bases (LlamaIndex, PageIndex, GraphRAG, LightRAG — even your Obsidian vault), lets you call Claude Code / Codex sub-agents from any conversation, and ships three-layer inspectable memory (L1 trace / L2 summary / L3 synthesis) with a Memory Graph for provenance.
en.content: A full web app (Python backend + Next.js 16 frontend) with READMEs in 11 languages, Docker deployment, CLI/agent-native interfaces and the EduHub community skills ecosystem; releases ship very frequently.
en.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16, multi-engine RAG + MCP tools + FAISS; Apache-2.0; created late December 2025 with an arXiv paper behind it.
en.hot: It combines AI education with an agent-native workflow and carries the credibility of a university research lab, making the concept easy to evaluate and share.
uses: Students & self-learners — feed in textbooks and papers, get a 24/7 personal tutor
Exam candidates — prepare systematically with quizzes and the mastery path
PKM enthusiasts — plug your Obsidian vault straight in for RAG Q&A

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。
zh.content: monorepo：apps/web、apps/desktop、apps/api 三个应用，根目录 Cargo.toml（Rust 核心）；用 moonrepo + proto 管理工具链，moon run web:dev 即可起本地开发。
zh.stack: TypeScript（Web 前端）+ Rust 核心，Bun 包管理，MIT；重写期间暂不接受外部代码贡献。
zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.

Researchers and engineers experimenting with low-latency dialog systems who want to swap VAD, STT, or TTS components

en.tag: Open-source CLI suite that gives AI agents full control over Office documents

en.stack: Built in Python, it relies on yt-dlp for video fetching, ffmpeg for frame extraction and audio demuxing, and falls back to the OpenAI Whisper API when free captions are unavailable. It integrates with agent environments via plugin protocols.
en.hot: With 8,992 stars and 1,876 added this week alone, it hit #15 on GitHub's Python Trending list. It solves the critical gap of AI agents being unable to perceive video, winning developers over with zero-config setup, multi-platform support, and a true "see-and-hear" experience.

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.
uses: Developers inheriting large legacy projects — one command maps the codebase into a knowledge graph
Heavy AI users — swap vector RAG for graph context that retrieves the right thing
Docs teams — fold docs, PDFs and diagrams into one queryable graph

zh.tag: 流式3D重建的几何上下文Transformer基础模型
zh.what: LingBot-Map 是一个前馈式 3D 基础模型，能够从流式数据中实时重建三维场景。它通过几何上下文 Transformer 架构，在单一流式框架内统一了坐标定位、密集几何线索编码与长程漂移校正。
zh.content: 仓库提供交互式演示脚本 demo.py、离线批量渲染管线，以及 KITTI 和 Oxford Spires 评估基准；预训练模型权重已同步发布在 HuggingFace 与 ModelScope。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 与 PyTorch 构建，核心采用 Transformer 架构，支持 SDPA 与 FlashInfer 双后端以加速超长序列的流式推理。
zh.hot: 该模型可在 518×378 分辨率下以约 20 FPS 稳定处理超 10,000 帧的长序列，月增 4,765 Star，总星数突破 12,000，跻身 GitHub Python 月榜第 18 名。
uses: 自动驾驶与机器人感知 —— 需要实时从连续视频流构建大规模 3D 场景地图。
AR/VR 内容生成 —— 为沉浸式应用提供高效的长序列几何重建与离线渲染能力。

en.tag: Geometric Context Transformer for real-time streaming 3D reconstruction
en.what: LingBot-Map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model that reconstructs scenes from streaming data in real time. It unifies coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction within a single streaming framework via its Geometric Context Transformer architecture.
en.content: The repo ships an interactive demo script (`demo.py`), an offline rendering pipeline, and evaluation benchmarks for KITTI and Oxford Spires, with pretrained weights hosted on both HuggingFace and ModelScope.
en.stack: Built in Python on PyTorch with a Transformer core, supporting both SDPA and FlashInfer backends to accelerate inference over extremely long sequences.
en.hot: Delivering stable ~20 FPS inference at 518×378 across sequences exceeding 10,000 frames, the project gained 4,765 stars this month, surpassing 12,000 total and hitting #18 on GitHub’s monthly Python Trending list.
uses: Autonomous driving & robotics teams — for real-time large-scale 3D mapping from continuous video streams.
AR/VR content creators — seeking efficient long-sequence geometric reconstruction and offline rendering for immersive experiences.
Computer-vision researchers — exploring streaming 3D foundation models, geometric Transformers, and long-range drift correction.

uses: 开发者构建需要可靠 JSON 输出的 LLM 应用（如 API 调用、数据提取）
需要跨模型切换且保持输出格式一致的项目
希望避免手动解析和验证 LLM 输出的团队

en.tag: Structured output generation engine for LLMs

en.content: The repo contains the core library, model integrations (OpenAI, vLLM, Transformers, etc.), structured output types (JSON, Regex, Pydantic, etc.), examples, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily Python, depends on Pydantic, regex, and model backend SDKs (e.g., openai, vllm).
en.hot: Gained 813 stars this week, total over 15k. Structured output is a must-have in LLM app development; Outlines provides an elegant solution, adopted by NVIDIA, Cohere, HuggingFace, etc.
uses: Developers building LLM apps requiring reliable JSON output (e.g., API calls, data extraction)
Projects needing consistent output formats across different models
Teams wanting to avoid manual parsing and validation of LLM outputs

en.tag: MCP server granting Claude terminal control, file search & diff editing
en.what: DesktopCommanderMCP is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that grants Claude and other AI clients terminal control, filesystem search, and diff-based file editing capabilities. It goes beyond conventional AI editors by letting AI execute long-running commands, manage processes, and automate local development tasks using the host client's subscription instead of extra API tokens.
en.content: The repository contains the MCP server source code, a TypeScript-based toolkit for terminal and filesystem operations, and a standalone Desktop Commander App (Beta) with visual file previews, a Markdown editor, and support for multiple AI models.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript on top of the MCP Filesystem Server, it communicates with clients like Claude Desktop via the Model Context Protocol and is distributed via npm.
en.hot: Amid the AI coding assistant boom, it has surged to 8,467 stars with 1,657 added this week (ranking 5th on GitHub Trending), precisely solving the pain point of AI being unable to directly operate local terminals and filesystems, enabling developers to drive entire local workflows via natural language.
uses: Developers who want to execute terminal commands and batch-edit code via natural language instructions
AI toolchain integrators looking to extend Claude Desktop or other MCP clients with local filesystem and shell capabilities
Automation-minded users seeking a unified chat interface for code search, editing, and process management

en.what: Astryx is an open-source design system used inside Meta for eight years, powering 13,000+ apps. It offers 150+ accessible components, brand-level theming, dark mode, templates, and a CLI, enabling both humans and AI agents to build UIs with the same tooling.

zh.tag: 终端 AI 编程代理，内置 IDE 能力
zh.what: oh-my-pi 是一个终端 AI 编程代理，将 IDE 的编辑能力集成到命令行中。它支持哈希锚定的编辑、优化的工具集、LSP、Python、浏览器和子代理等功能，旨在提供开箱即用且高度可定制的编码体验。

en.tag: Terminal AI coding agent with IDE wired in

en.stack: Primarily Rust and TypeScript, with Bun as the recommended runtime, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows. It leverages LSP and DAP protocols and integrates with multiple AI providers.
en.hot: As a fork of Pi, it offers a more capable agent surface and is continuously tuned by real-world use. With 1,739 stars added this week and a total of 22,525, ranking #16 on the TypeScript weekly trending, it reflects high developer interest in terminal AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want AI-assisted coding directly in the terminal without switching IDEs
Those needing a highly customizable and extensible AI agent with multiple providers and tools
Tech enthusiasts interested in building high-performance CLI tools with Rust and TypeScript
Developers who want to leverage LSP and DAP integration for code navigation and debugging

zh.tag: 代码驱动、实时更新的软件架构可视化工具
zh.what: LikeC4 是一种建模语言和工具集，用于从代码描述生成软件架构图。它受 C4 模型启发，但允许自定义符号、元素类型和嵌套层级，使架构图始终与实际代码同步。
zh.content: 仓库包含 LikeC4 语言规范、CLI 工具、VS Code 扩展以及示例模板。核心是 `likec4` 包，提供 `start` 命令启动本地预览服务器，并支持导出为静态站点。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 运行时。前端使用 React 渲染交互式图表，支持 VS Code 和 Open VSX 扩展。
zh.hot: 今日新增 58 星，总星数 4019，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 12。开发者对“代码即架构”的自动化、可视化需求强烈，LikeC4 提供了比传统 UML 更灵活、更现代的替代方案。
uses: 软件架构师 —— 用代码定义并维护系统架构图，确保文档与实现一致
开发团队 —— 在 CI/CD 中自动生成架构图，用于代码审查和文档
技术写作者 —— 为开源项目或内部系统创建可交互的架构文档

en.tag: Code-driven, always up-to-date software architecture visualization
en.what: LikeC4 is a modeling language and toolset that generates software architecture diagrams from code descriptions. Inspired by the C4 model, it allows custom notation, element types, and nested levels, keeping diagrams always in sync with the actual code.
en.content: The repository includes the LikeC4 language specification, CLI tool, VS Code extension, and example templates. The core `likec4` package provides a `start` command to launch a local preview server and supports exporting to static sites.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, runs on Node.js. The frontend uses React for interactive diagram rendering, with extensions for VS Code and Open VSX.
en.hot: Gained 58 stars today, total 4019, ranked #12 on TypeScript daily trending. Developers have a strong demand for automated, code-driven architecture visualization, and LikeC4 offers a more flexible, modern alternative to traditional UML.
uses: Software architects — define and maintain system architecture diagrams in code, ensuring docs match implementation
Development teams — auto-generate architecture diagrams in CI/CD for code reviews and documentation
Technical writers — create interactive architecture docs for open-source or internal systems

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打造的设计语言与技能集，终结千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风
zh.what: Impeccable 是一套面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）的设计指导语言与 CLI 工具。它通过 23 条标准化命令和 46 条确定性检测规则，帮助 AI 在生成前端界面时摆脱千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风格，产出更具品牌感与专业度的设计。开发者只需在项目中运行初始化命令，即可建立包含品牌语境、视觉规范与组件库的设计上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含可安装在 AI 工具中的核心技能包、用于本地检测的 CLI 与浏览器扩展，以及一套由 PRODUCT.md 和 DESIGN.md 驱动的设计上下文系统。整体以命令式交互为主，支持实时浏览器迭代与无需 LLM 的离线规则检测。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，通过 npm 分发并以 npx 方式安装，同时提供浏览器扩展用于实时迭代检测。设计规则以确定性逻辑实现，可独立于 LLM 运行。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上已获得 47.7K Star，本周新增 2,331 星并跻身 Trending 周榜第 14 名，反映出开发者对「AI 生成前端同质化」的强烈痛点共鸣。它精准击中了当前 AI 编码工具产出界面千篇一律的普遍问题，提供了可落地的设计工程化方案。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 希望让 AI 助手生成更专业、不千篇一律的界面代码
独立创始人/产品经理 —— 需要快速建立品牌感强、视觉一致的产品界面
设计工程师 —— 想将设计规范转化为 AI 可执行的确定性规则与检测流程

en.tag: A design language and skillset for AI coding agents to escape generic SaaS templates
en.what: Impeccable is a design guidance language and CLI tool for AI coding agents like Claude and Cursor. It provides 23 standardized commands and 46 deterministic detection rules to help AI-generated frontend designs break away from generic SaaS templates and achieve stronger brand identity. Developers can set up a comprehensive design context—including brand voice, visual guidelines, and component libraries—through a single initialization command.
en.content: The repository includes a core skill package for AI tools, a CLI and browser extension for local auditing, and a design context system driven by PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md. It focuses on command-based interactions, supporting live browser iteration and offline deterministic rule checks without requiring an LLM or API key.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, distributed via npm and installed through npx, with a browser extension for real-time iteration and auditing. The design rules are implemented as deterministic logic that can run independently of any LLM or API key.
en.hot: With 47.7K stars and 2,331 new stars this week landing it at #14 on GitHub Trending, the project resonates strongly with developers frustrated by homogenized AI-generated frontend designs. It directly addresses the pain point of repetitive SaaS templates by offering a practical, engineering-grade design system for AI agents.
uses: Frontend developers who want their AI assistants to generate professional, non-generic UI code
Indie founders and product managers looking to quickly build brand-conscious, visually consistent interfaces
Design engineers seeking to convert design specifications into deterministic, AI-executable rules and audit workflows

zh.what: 这是 OpenAI 官方为 Claude Code 开发的插件，让开发者无需离开终端环境即可调用 Codex 进行代码审查或任务委托。用户可通过斜杠命令执行只读评审、对抗性压力测试，或将编码任务后台交给 Codex 代理处理。
zh.content: 仓库包含插件源码、Claude Code 市场清单配置，以及内置的 /codex:* 斜杠命令和 codex-rescue 子代理。同时提供完整安装文档与演示视频，支持通过 npm 安装 Codex CLI 并自动处理登录与会话交接。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 18.18+ 构建，作为 Claude Code 插件运行，需 OpenAI Codex CLI 及 ChatGPT 订阅或 OpenAI API Key。通过 Claude Code 插件市场分发，并使用 npm 管理 Codex 全局安装。
zh.hot: 凭借 OpenAI 官方背书与 Claude Code 的庞大用户基础，该插件本周新增 1801 Star，以近 3 万总星标数冲入 GitHub 周榜第 12 名。它精准击中了开发者希望在同一终端内无缝切换 Claude 与 Codex 两大 AI 工作流的痛点。
uses: Claude Code 忠实用户 —— 希望在熟悉的终端工作流中直接复用 Codex 的审查与代理能力。
追求代码质量的团队 —— 需要对多文件变更进行常规审查或对抗性压力测试，发现潜在设计缺陷。
高频使用 AI 辅助编程的开发者 —— 想将耗时任务后台委托给 Codex，通过异步状态查询和结果拉取保持专注。
多 AI 工具链整合者 —— 试图打通 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 生态，构建统一的命令行 AI 开发环境。

en.tag: Claude Code plugin integrating OpenAI Codex for code review and task delegation
en.what: An official OpenAI plugin that embeds Codex capabilities directly into Claude Code, letting developers review and delegate coding tasks without leaving their terminal. It exposes slash commands for read-only reviews, adversarial pressure-testing, and background task delegation to Codex agents.
en.content: The repo hosts the plugin source, Claude Code marketplace manifest, and built-in slash commands such as /codex:review plus the codex-rescue subagent. It also includes comprehensive installation docs and a demo video, supporting npm-based Codex CLI setup and automated session hand-off.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript for Node.js 18.18+, it runs as a Claude Code plugin and requires the OpenAI Codex CLI along with a ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key. It is distributed via the Claude Code plugin marketplace and uses npm for global Codex CLI installation.
en.hot: Backed by OpenAI and Claude Code's large user base, the plugin gained 1,801 stars this week and reached #12 on GitHub Trending with nearly 29k total stars. It directly addresses developer demand for seamlessly switching between Claude and Codex within a single terminal workflow.
uses: Claude Code power users who want to leverage Codex review and agent capabilities inside their existing terminal workflow.
Teams focused on code quality looking to run standard or adversarial reviews on multi-file changes to uncover design flaws.
Developers heavily using AI-assisted coding who want to delegate long-running tasks to Codex in the background and check results asynchronously.
Multi-AI toolchain integrators aiming to bridge Anthropic and OpenAI ecosystems within a unified CLI environment.

zh.tag: 用 Claude 操控 TradingView 图表的 AI 助手桥
zh.what: 这是一个 MCP 服务器，通过 Chrome DevTools 协议将 Claude Code 连接到本地运行的 TradingView 桌面应用，实现 AI 辅助的图表分析、Pine Script 开发和流程自动化。所有数据处理均在本地完成，不传输外部。
zh.content: 包含 MCP 服务器实现、CDP 通信模块、Pine Script 辅助工具和示例配置。提供工具让 LLM 读取图表状态、执行脚本并获取反馈。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js，使用 Chrome DevTools Protocol 与 Electron 应用通信，MCP 协议与 Claude Code 集成。
zh.hot: 将 LLM 代理与专业交易工具结合，满足交易者自动化分析需求，4543 Stars 日增 28，登顶 JavaScript 日榜第 3。
uses: 交易者：用自然语言分析图表、编写 Pine Script 策略
开发者：研究 LLM 代理与桌面金融应用的交互模式
量化研究员：自动化回测与指标提取

en.tag: AI bridge connecting Claude Code to TradingView Desktop for chart analysis & automation
en.what: An MCP server that connects Claude Code to your locally running TradingView Desktop via Chrome DevTools Protocol, enabling AI-assisted chart analysis, Pine Script development, and workflow automation. All data processing stays local.
en.content: Includes MCP server implementation, CDP communication module, Pine Script helpers, and example configs. Provides tools for LLM to read chart state, execute scripts, and get feedback.
en.stack: Node.js-based, uses Chrome DevTools Protocol to communicate with Electron apps, integrates with Claude Code via MCP protocol.
en.hot: Combines LLM agents with professional trading tools, meeting traders' automation needs. 4543 stars (+28/day), #3 on JavaScript daily trending.
uses: Traders: analyze charts and write Pine Script strategies via natural language
Developers: study LLM agent interaction with desktop financial apps
Quant researchers: automate backtesting and indicator extraction

zh.tag: React 动画组件库，165+ 可定制组件
zh.what: React Bits 是一个开源 React 组件库，提供 165+ 个动画、交互式且完全可定制的组件，用于构建令人难忘的网站。它涵盖文本动画、背景、UI 元素等，旨在帮助开发者快速打造惊艳的界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含组件源码、文档站点（reactbits.dev）以及创意工具（如 Background Studio、Shape Magic、Texture Lab）。组件提供 JS-CSS、JS-TW、TS-CSS、TS-TW 四种变体，支持复制粘贴使用。
zh.stack: 基于 React 和 JavaScript，支持 shadcn 和 jsrepo 安装，依赖极少，支持 tree-shaking。
zh.hot: 凭借 165+ 免费可定制组件和创意工具，在开发者中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 4.5 万，本月新增 2171，位列 JavaScript 月榜第 15 名。
uses: 前端开发者：快速为网站添加动画效果，节省开发时间
设计师：利用创意工具生成背景、形状和纹理素材
产品团队：用现成组件打造高质感、令人难忘的用户界面

en.tag: 165+ animated, customizable React components for memorable websites
en.what: React Bits is an open-source collection of 165+ animated, interactive, and fully customizable React components for building memorable websites. It includes text animations, backgrounds, UI elements, and more, helping developers ship stunning interfaces faster.
en.content: The repo contains component source code, documentation site (reactbits.dev), and creative tools (Background Studio, Shape Magic, Texture Lab). Components come in four variants (JS-CSS, JS-TW, TS-CSS, TS-TW) and are copy-paste ready.
en.stack: Built on React and JavaScript, with minimal dependencies and tree-shaking support. Installable via shadcn and jsrepo.
en.hot: With 165+ free customizable components and creative tools, it quickly gained popularity among developers, amassing 45k+ stars on GitHub, with 2,171 new stars this month, ranking #15 on the JavaScript monthly trending list.
uses: Frontend developers: quickly add animations to websites, saving development time
Designers: use creative tools to generate backgrounds, shapes, and textures
Product teams: build high-quality, memorable user interfaces with ready-made components

zh.tag: 跨平台隐私优先语音转文字工具，支持本地与云端模型
zh.what: OpenWhispr 是一款开源的桌面端语音听写应用，用户可通过全局热键在任何软件中将语音实时转为文字。它支持完全离线的本地转录（Whisper / NVIDIA Parakeet），也允许接入自有密钥的云模型，确保音频数据不出本地即可隐私可控地完成输入。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的跨平台桌面客户端源码与构建产物，覆盖 macOS、Windows、Linux 的全局热键、语音听写、会议转录、AI 笔记及 Agent 功能模块，并附带安装包、API 文档与官网。
zh.stack: 项目以 JavaScript 为主语言开发，基于 Electron 或同类跨平台桌面框架，前端采用现代 Web 技术栈，后端通过本地绑定集成 Whisper 与 NVIDIA Parakeet，并提供 REST API 以对接第三方云服务。
zh.hot: 在 WisprFlow、Granola 等付费语音转写工具备受关注的背景下，OpenWhispr 以“完全开源、零数据收集”的隐私定位成为热门替代方案，本月新增 802 Star，累计达 4,617 Star，跻身 GitHub JavaScript 月榜第 10 名。
uses: 需要高效语音输入的写作者与开发者——通过全局热键在任意编辑器中快速 dictation。
对隐私敏感的用户与团队——利用本地模型实现完全离线的会议转录与笔记生成。
寻求免费替代方案的知识工作者——以开源方案替换 WisprFlow/Granola 进行日常语音记录。

en.tag: Privacy-first cross-platform voice-to-text dictation with local & cloud models
en.what: OpenWhispr is an open-source desktop dictation app that turns speech into text anywhere via a global hotkey. It offers fully offline transcription with local engines like Whisper and NVIDIA Parakeet, or cloud processing via BYOK, keeping user audio data private and under their own control.
en.content: The repository includes the full cross-platform desktop client source and release builds for macOS, Windows, and Linux, featuring global hotkey handling, voice dictation, meeting transcription, AI note-taking, and agent modules, plus API docs and a website.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript and built on a cross-platform desktop framework (likely Electron or Tauri) with a modern web-based UI, it binds locally to Whisper and NVIDIA Parakeet for on-device inference and exposes REST APIs for optional cloud integration.
en.hot: Positioned as a free, open-source and zero-telemetry alternative to paid tools like WisprFlow and Granola, OpenWhispr gained strong traction this month with 802 new stars, reaching 4,617 total stars and ranking #10 on GitHub’s JavaScript monthly trending chart.
uses: Writers and developers needing efficient voice input — dictate into any editor via a global hotkey.
Privacy-conscious users and teams — run fully offline meeting transcription and note-taking with local models.
Knowledge workers seeking free alternatives — replace paid tools like WisprFlow or Granola for daily voice logging.

zh.tag: 非官方 ChatGPT Linux 桌面端，从 macOS 官方包提取并本地构建
zh.what: 该项目将 OpenAI 官方仅提供 macOS 版本的 ChatGPT 桌面应用（含 Chat、Work、Codex）转换为可在 Linux 运行的 Electron 应用。它通过提取上游 DMG 文件、应用 Linux 兼容性补丁并重建原生模块，最终打包成多种 Linux 发行版支持的安装格式。
zh.content: 仓库包含从 macOS DMG 提取、打补丁、构建原生模块的完整脚本，以及用于 Debian/Ubuntu、Fedora、Arch 和 Nix 的安装包配置；可选的 Linux 专属功能存放在 `linux-features/` 目录，同时提供 AppImage 自构建和本地更新管理器支持。
zh.stack: 基于 Electron 与 JavaScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 运行时；构建系统使用 Makefile 驱动，通过 CI 工作流自动化打包 .deb、.rpm、pacman 及 AppImage，并支持 Wayland 与 X11 显示协议。
zh.hot: OpenAI 迟迟未推出官方 Linux 客户端，该项目填补了空白；本周新增 395 Star 并登上 JavaScript 周榜第 5，反映出 Linux 开发者对原生 ChatGPT 桌面体验的强烈需求。
uses: Linux 开发者/用户 —— 想在 Debian、Fedora、Arch 等发行版上获得原生 ChatGPT 桌面体验
AI 重度使用者 —— 需要本地安装 Chat、Work 和 Codex 功能，而非仅使用网页版
偏好桌面端工作流的用户 —— 希望利用系统级快捷键、本地集成和离线更新管理
开源社区贡献者 —— 参与非官方 Linux 适配、Electron 跨平台补丁与打包流程改进

en.tag: Unofficial ChatGPT Desktop for Linux, extracted & rebuilt from official macOS DMG
en.what: This project converts OpenAI's official macOS-only ChatGPT Desktop app (including Chat, Work, and Codex) into a runnable Linux Electron application. It extracts the upstream DMG, applies Linux compatibility patches, rebuilds native modules, and packages the result for various Linux distributions.
en.content: The repository contains complete scripts for extracting the macOS DMG, applying patches, and rebuilding native modules, alongside packaging configs for Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch, and Nix. Optional Linux-only integrations live in `linux-features/`, with support for AppImage self-builds and a local update manager.
en.stack: Built with Electron and JavaScript, requiring Node.js; the build system is driven by Makefiles and CI workflows that automate packaging into .deb, .rpm, pacman, and AppImage formats, with support for both Wayland and X11.
en.hot: With no official Linux client from OpenAI, this project fills a critical gap; it gained 395 stars this week and hit #5 on the JavaScript Trending list, reflecting strong demand from Linux users for a native ChatGPT desktop experience.
uses: Linux developers/users seeking a native ChatGPT desktop experience on Debian, Fedora, Arch, and other distros.
Power users who need local access to Chat, Work, and Codex features instead of relying solely on the web app.
Desktop-centric workflow users wanting system-level shortcuts, local integrations, and an offline update manager.
Open-source contributors interested in unofficial Linux ports, Electron cross-platform patching, and packaging improvements.

zh.tag: 免费无广告追剧资源精选指南
zh.what: 这是一个精心整理的追剧资源合集，涵盖在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox/影视仓接口、IPTV直播源等。项目每天自动检测资源有效性，确保链接可用，并完全开源，社区共同维护。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 resources.json 数据文件（收录 94 个资源）、README 指南、以及用于自动检测和验证的 GitHub Actions 工作流。
zh.stack: 主要基于 JavaScript 和 JSON 数据文件，利用 GitHub Actions 进行自动化检测，无复杂依赖。
zh.hot: 本月新增 5418 星，总星数 5506，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（JavaScript）第 10 名。因其精准满足用户对免费无广告追剧资源的需求，且每日自动检测保证质量，迅速走红。
uses: 追剧爱好者：寻找免费无广告的在线影视和APP资源
技术用户：配置TVBox/影视仓接口或IPTV直播源
资源维护者：提交新资源或参与社区维护

en.tag: Curated guide to free, ad-free drama-watching resources
en.what: A curated collection of drama-watching resources, covering online streaming, apps, cloud search, torrents, subtitles, TVBox interfaces, IPTV sources, and more. It automatically checks resource availability daily and is fully open-source with community maintenance.
en.content: The repo contains a resources.json data file (94 resources), a README guide, and GitHub Actions workflows for automatic availability checks and validation.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript and JSON data files, with GitHub Actions for automation; minimal dependencies.
en.hot: Gained 5,418 stars this month (total 5,506), ranking #10 on GitHub Trending monthly (JavaScript). Its precise fulfillment of free, ad-free resource needs and daily automated checks drove rapid popularity.
uses: Drama enthusiasts: find free, ad-free streaming and app resources
Tech-savvy users: configure TVBox interfaces or IPTV sources
Contributors: submit new resources or help maintain the list

zh.tag: 面向AI代理的HTML交互式编辑器，支持本地人机协作反馈
zh.what: Lavish 是一款本地优先的 HTML 制品编辑器，专为 AI 代理生成的富交互内容设计。它让开发者直接在浏览器中审阅、标注和修改 HTML 文件，并通过 AXI 协议将反馈无缝回传给 Agent，替代低效的截图与长文本沟通。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Lavish Editor 的核心 CLI、AXI 接口实现、本地浏览器渲染引擎，以及面向 Agent Skills 的 npx skills 安装钩子。README 还提供了面向产品计划、技术方案等场景的内置可视化模板。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，以 CLI 形式分发，通过 npm 发布；支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 跨平台运行。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1,445 星，以 1,967 星登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 月榜第 5。它精准切中了 AI Agent 时代“生成 HTML 容易、协作修改难”的痛点，用本地优先和 AXI 协议重新定义了人机协作的编辑体验。
uses: 使用 AI 编程助手并需要可视化审阅 Agent 生成 HTML 报告/原型的开发者
需要与 Agent 进行精细化交互反馈而非截图和文字的产品经理与技术负责人
希望本地安全运行、不愿将 HTML 制品上传云端的企业与隐私敏感用户

en.tag: Local-first interactive HTML editor for human-AI collaboration on agent artifacts.
en.what: Lavish is a local-first HTML editor designed for AI agent-generated rich artifacts. It lets users review, annotate, and edit rendered HTML directly in the browser, then sends structured feedback back to agents via the AXI protocol—replacing inefficient screenshots and long text messages.
en.content: The repo contains the core CLI, AXI interface, local browser rendering engine, and npx skills install hooks for agent integration. It also ships with built-in visualization templates for product planning and technical design scenarios.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript/Node.js and distributed as a cross-platform CLI via npm, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows.
en.hot: It gained 1,445 stars this month, hitting 1,967 total and ranking 5th on GitHub's monthly JavaScript Trending. It nails the pain point that HTML is easy for agents to generate but hard for humans to collaboratively refine, redefining the human-AI editing loop with local-first principles and the AXI protocol.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants who need to visually review agent-generated HTML reports or prototypes
Product managers and tech leads seeking precise interactive feedback loops with agents instead of screenshots
Privacy-conscious users and enterprises wanting local-first execution without uploading artifacts to the cloud

zh.tag: Nuclei 引擎的社区漏洞检测模板库
zh.what: 这是 Nuclei 扫描引擎的官方模板仓库，存储由团队和社区贡献的各类安全检测模板。这些模板定义了如何检测应用中的安全漏洞，是 Nuclei 扫描器的核心部分。
zh.content: 仓库包含数千个 YAML 格式的模板，按漏洞类型、严重性、目录等分类，并提供统计文件（TEMPLATES-STATS.md 和 JSON）以及针对 CISA KEV 等已知被利用漏洞的覆盖。
zh.stack: 模板使用 YAML 编写，依赖 Nuclei 引擎（Go 编写）执行。项目本身主要包含模板文件和统计生成脚本，主语言标记为 JavaScript 可能因统计工具。
zh.hot: 拥有 12766 颗星，今日新增 9 颗，位列 JavaScript 日榜第 8。作为安全扫描的核心资源，持续吸引社区贡献，覆盖大量已知漏洞，是安全研究者的必备工具。
uses: 安全研究人员：快速检测目标应用是否存在已知漏洞
渗透测试人员：利用现成模板进行漏洞扫描和验证
DevSecOps 工程师：集成到 CI/CD 流程中实现自动化安全测试
CTF 玩家：查找和利用常见漏洞模板

en.tag: Community-curated templates for the Nuclei vulnerability scanner
en.what: This is the official template repository for the Nuclei scanning engine, storing security detection templates contributed by the team and community. These templates define how to detect vulnerabilities in applications and are the core of the Nuclei scanner.
en.content: The repository contains thousands of YAML templates categorized by vulnerability type, severity, directory, etc., along with statistics files (TEMPLATES-STATS.md and JSON) and coverage for known exploited vulnerabilities like CISA KEV.
en.stack: Templates are written in YAML and rely on the Nuclei engine (written in Go) for execution. The project mainly contains template files and statistics generation scripts; the primary language is marked as JavaScript possibly due to tooling.
en.hot: With 12,766 stars and 9 new stars today, ranking 8th on the JavaScript daily trending list. As a core resource for security scanning, it continuously attracts community contributions, covers numerous known vulnerabilities, and is essential for security researchers.
uses: Security researchers: quickly detect known vulnerabilities in target applications
Penetration testers: use ready-made templates for vulnerability scanning and verification
DevSecOps engineers: integrate into CI/CD pipelines for automated security testing
CTF players: find and exploit common vulnerability templates

zh.tag: 现代 JavaScript 实用工具库，模块化与性能兼备
zh.what: Lodash 是一个流行的 JavaScript 实用工具库，提供数组、对象、字符串等操作的模块化方法，简化日常编码。它支持多种构建（完整版、核心版、FP 版），并可通过 npm 或浏览器直接使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含源码、构建脚本（lodash-cli）、文档、测试和配置文件。主要目录有 dist/（预构建文件）、test/、以及按类别划分的模块源码。
zh.stack: 纯 JavaScript 实现，无运行时依赖。构建工具为 lodash-cli，支持 UMD 模块格式，兼容现代环境。
zh.hot: Lodash 作为 JavaScript 生态的基石，拥有 6 万+ Star，月增 106，持续稳居趋势榜。近期获得 OpenJS 基金会支持，治理重启，确保长期稳定维护，引发社区关注。
uses: 前端开发者：快速处理数组、对象、字符串等常见操作，减少重复代码。
Node.js 后端开发者：在服务端使用模块化方法提升开发效率。
学习 JavaScript 函数式编程：通过 FP 构建体验自动柯里化和数据优先风格。
维护旧项目：作为稳定依赖，提供兼容性补丁和性能优化。

en.tag: A modern JavaScript utility library delivering modularity, performance, & extras.
en.what: Lodash is a popular JavaScript utility library providing modular methods for arrays, objects, strings, etc., simplifying everyday coding. It supports multiple builds (full, core, FP) and can be used via npm or directly in the browser.
en.content: The repository contains source code, build scripts (lodash-cli), documentation, tests, and configuration files. Main directories include dist/ (pre-built files), test/, and module sources organized by category.
en.stack: Pure JavaScript implementation with no runtime dependencies. Built with lodash-cli, supports UMD module format, and works in modern environments.
en.hot: As a cornerstone of the JavaScript ecosystem, Lodash holds 61k+ stars with a monthly gain of 106, consistently trending. Recent support from the OpenJS Foundation and governance reboot to ensure long-term stability have drawn community attention.
uses: Frontend developers: quickly handle common operations on arrays, objects, strings, etc., reducing boilerplate.
Node.js backend developers: use modular methods to boost development efficiency on the server.
Learners of functional programming in JS: experience auto-currying and data-last style via the FP build.
Maintainers of legacy projects: rely on it as a stable dependency with compatibility patches and performance optimizations.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的市场营销技能包
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）设计的市场营销技能集合，涵盖转化率优化、文案写作、SEO、分析和增长工程。它帮助技术营销人员和创始人利用 AI 编码代理执行营销任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能文件（Markdown 格式），每个技能针对特定营销领域，如 SEO 审计、CRO、文案编辑、广告创意等。技能之间相互引用，以产品营销技能为基础。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，但核心是 Markdown 技能文件，遵循 Agent Skills 规范，兼容 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Cursor 等代理。
zh.hot: 4.3 万星标，今日新增 158，位列 JavaScript 趋势榜第二。它填补了 AI 代理在营销领域的空白，提供即插即用的技能，深受技术营销人员欢迎。

zh.tag: 个人智能情报终端，27 个数据源，一条命令本地运行

en.what: workmux is a highly opinionated terminal workflow tool that pairs git worktrees with tmux (and kitty, WezTerm, Zellij) windows to create isolated dev environments per task. 全栈工程师 —— 想在前端组件中直接调用 Server Functions，减少前后端语言切换成本的团队。
跨平台应用团队 —— 需要高性能、内存安全且拒绝 Electron 厚重方案的产品组。

en.what: Dioxus is a Rust-based fullstack framework that lets developers build for the web, desktop, and mobile from a single codebase. en.hot: With 36.8K stars and ranking 18th on this week's GitHub Rust Trending, Dioxus is drawing developers eager to replace JavaScript stacks with Rust. Its promise of a single codebase spanning web, desktop, and mobile—backed by hot-reload and zero-config DX—directly addresses the Rust community's demand for high-performance cross-platform UI solutions.
uses: Rust developers —— teams wanting a single codebase for web, desktop, and mobile apps without sacrificing performance.
Fullstack engineers —— those looking to colocate Server Functions with UI components to cut language-switching overhead.
Cross-platform product teams —— groups that need memory-safe, high-performance alternatives to heavy Electron-style solutions.

Data scientists: using DataFrame API for interactive analysis
Database kernel researchers: learning query optimization and execution implementations

zh.hot: 凭借“零配置”即可在任意设备间建立加密组网的能力，Tailscale 已成为远程办公和云原生时代的核心网络工具，GitHub 累计获得 34k+ Stars，本周再以 583 新增 Star 登上 Go 语言 Trending 榜第 2 名。

en.content: The repository primarily contains the core source code for the `tailscaled` daemon and the `tailscale` CLI tool, covering the networking stack and control logic for Linux, Windows, macOS, and BSD systems. en.stack: Developed primarily in Go and requiring the latest Go 1.26 release, it implements encrypted communication over the WireGuard protocol. The `build_dist.sh` script embeds version metadata into binaries, supporting packaging for multiple Linux distributions and cross-platform deployments.
en.hot: Its "zero-config" approach to encrypted mesh networking across any device has made it an essential tool for remote work and cloud-native environments. With over 34k total stars and 583 new stars this week, it ranks #2 on GitHub's Go Trending chart, reflecting strong community traction.
